As an OpenBMC Firmware Lead Engineer, you will play a critical role in the design, development, debugging, and verification of OpenBMC firmware solutions for server and storage platforms. You will provide technical leadership across the firmware development lifecycle, from requirements definition and architecture design to implementation, validation, and release.

This position requires a self-motivated engineering leader who can collaborate effectively with customers, cross-functional teams, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality firmware solutions. The successful candidate will drive technical excellence, mentor engineers, mitigate project risks, and ensure timely execution of development milestones.

As an OpenBMC Firmware Lead Engineer, you will be expected to

  • Lead OpenBMC firmware design, development, integration, and debugging activities.
  • Define firmware requirements, architecture, and implementation strategies.
  • Collaborate with project managers, firmware managers, architects, and stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
  • Drive technical planning, reviews, and risk mitigation activities.
  • Develop and execute software verification strategies to ensure product stability and quality.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and promote engineering best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to firmware development processes and quality.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to meet project objectives and release schedules.

In Your Role You Will

  • Support project estimation activities during the RFI/RFQ phase.
  • Stay current with industry technologies and development methodologies.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including design specifications and implementation details.
  • Work with firmware managers, project managers, and development teams to gather requirements and define solutions.
  • Design new software features and enhance existing firmware functionality.
  • Lead software architecture and design activities based on functional requirements.
  • Develop and execute firmware validation and verification plans.
  • Investigate, prioritize, and resolve software defects at both module and system levels.
  • Lead technical risk identification and mitigation efforts.
  • Drive detailed technical planning and execution activities.
  • Act as the technical leader for firmware development teams.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers in technical and professional development.
  • Promote software process improvements and quality initiatives.
  • Demonstrate strong ownership, accountability, and execution excellence.
  • Ensure compliance with development processes, security policies, and quality standards.

Job Qualifications & Knowledge Requirements

Technical Knowledge & Skills

  • Proficient in most of the following:
  • Strong understanding of OpenBMC architecture, development, debugging, and source code customization.
  • Hands-on experience with Aspeed BMC SoCs (AST2500/AST2600/AST2700).
  • Strong knowledge of Yocto, BitBake, and embedded Linux build systems.
  • Experience with OpenBMC platform bring-up and board porting.
  • Good understanding of Intel, AMD, and ARM server platforms.
  • Working knowledge of IPMI, Redfish, PLDM, MCTP, and SPDM protocols.
  • Experience with BMC features such as SDR, SEL, FRU, SOL, IPMB, KCS, PEF, and PECI.
  • Strong understanding of Linux kernel, device drivers, IPC, and U-Boot.
  • Experience with hardware interfaces including I2C/I3C, SPI, PMBus, LPC, UART, JTAG, GPIO, and SGPIO.
  • Hands-on experience with OpenBMC components including D-Bus, Entity Manager, BMCWeb, Phosphor services, Virtual Media, and User Management.
  • Knowledge of BIOS-BMC communication and server management architecture.
  • Ability to perform root cause analysis and debug firmware-hardware integration issues.
  • Experience creating and reviewing firmware requirements, architecture, and design documentation.
  • Proven capability to lead feature development, code reviews, and technical discussions.
  • Good understanding of firmware development lifecycle, release management, CI/CD, and quality processes.

Non-Technical Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to lead technical discussions across global teams.

title: Student Assistant - Credible Messenger Youth Mentor (Sacramento State Students or Alumni Only)
description:
The Division of Student Affairs on the Sacramento State campus is seeking to hire one Student Assistant to support Project Rebound's Restorative Justice Juvenile Diversion Program (RJJDP). The Student Assistant will serve as a Credible Messenger Mentor (CMM), providing individualized, community-based mentoring and support to youth participating in the Program.

The CMM will serve as a consistent, trusted presence who works alongside youth as they navigate the restorative justice process and address the circumstances, relationships, and goals that will support their successful participation in diversion and continued success in the community.

Conditions of Employment

This is a part-time, temporary, non-benefited, student position. Employment in all positions with University Enterprises, Inc. is dependent upon the mutual consent of University Enterprises, Inc. and the employee. This means that either University Enterprises, Inc. or the employee can, at any time, terminate the employment relationship at will, with or without cause.

Depending on the type of position you are applying for, a pre-employment background check consisting of one or more of the following may be conducted: employment history, professional references, criminal check: educational verification (degree, license, or official transcript) or DMV clearance. Applicants will be required to pass required pre-employment checks to the satisfaction of University Enterprises, Inc. (UEI) and the hiring Agency or Department.

UEI does not allow students to hold more than one UEI Job at a time, or work in more than one account per pay period. UEI employees who are considering leaving their current UEI student assistant position for a different UEI student assistant position should inform their supervisor in writing and provide at least a week’s notice.

UEI is not a multi-state employer. UEI only employs candidates who live and work in the state of California. If selected for the position you must reside in California and all work must be performed in the state of California throughout the course of employment.

Prerequisites

 Must be a college student attending classes during the regular term (Fall, Spring and Winter, if applicable), at one of the accredited colleges or universities on our affiliation list. To view our current affiliation list please paste the following URL into your browser:

Students must be enrolled in at least: six-semester units or nine quarter units for undergraduate students; four-semester units or six quarter units for graduate students.

Students declared major must match the major(s) listed in the job posting.

Majors/Fields of Study

Any major.

Work Schedule

Flexible workdays and work hours, Monday – Friday, between 7 AM – 5:00 PM. The final work schedule will be determined by the supervisor.

Additional Work Schedule

Student Assistant and Graduate Assistant employees generally work up to 20 hours per workweek (Monday– Friday) during the academic year and up to 40 hours per workweek during breaks; (winter, spring, and summer).

Compensation

$24.00 per hour.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Must possess direct, shared lived experience with the criminal justice system or marginalized community struggles, paired with demonstrated personal transformation and community trust.
  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish positive, respectful, and trusting relationships with adolescents and young adults.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, active listening, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work independently in community settings while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain confidentiality when working with youth and families.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Reliability, professionalism, cultural humility, and demonstrated commitment to supporting youth development.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience mentoring, coaching, tutoring, counseling, supporting, or otherwise working directly with youth or young adults.
  • Experience working with youth involved in the juvenile justice system or other systems of care.
  • Experience with restorative justice, diversion, reentry, youth development, conflict resolution, or related approaches.
  • Knowledge of or experience connecting young people to Sacramento-area educational, employment, recreational, and community resources.
  • Lived or professional experience that contributes to the ability to establish authentic and credible relationships with system-involved youth.
  • Experience working effectively with youth from diverse backgrounds and communities.

Duties and Responsibilities
  • Establish and maintain consistent, supportive 1:1 mentoring relationships with participating youth
  • Meet regularly with youth in community settings and other appropriate locations to provide individualized and ongoing encouragement, accountability, and problem-solving support between formal program activities over the course of program enrollment (6-12 months).
  • Serve as a trusted and credible adult role model who supports youth in identifying strengths, goals, and opportunities for positive development.
  • Build rapport and maintain authentic, respectful relationships with youth while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries.
  • Support youth throughout their participation in the restorative justice process, including helping youth understand expectations, prepare for restorative justice activities, and reflect on their experiences.
  • Help youth identify and articulate the impact of their actions, take responsibility, and develop meaningful strategies for moving forward.
  • Support youth in developing and completing individualized restoration plans and other diversion-related goals.
  • Connect youth with appropriate educational, employment, recreational, mentoring, behavioral health, and other community resources when appropriate.
  • Accompany or support youth in navigating community resources and opportunities as appropriate to the program.
  • Maintain regular communication with the program director and program team within Project Rebound regarding youth engagement, participation, progress, and barriers.
  • Participate in case staffing, team meetings, and training as required.
  • Maintain timely and accurate documentation of mentoring contacts and program-related activities.
  • Follow all Sacramento State, program, and partner-agency policies and procedures regarding confidentiality, youth safety and professional conduct (Note: the CMM is a mandated reporter)
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Physical Requirements

Sit for extended periods; frequently stand and walk; manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination; corrected hearing and vision to normal range; verbal communication; use of office equipment including computer workstations, telephones, calculators, copiers, printers, and scanners with or without reasonable accommodation.

Working Conditions

 Work is performed in a office environment.

Application Instructions

Please complete all fields of the employment application. Include your educational history in the “Educational Experience” section and any employment history in the “Employment Experience” section of our application.

title: Assoc. Director - Human Data & Computational Biology
description:
Career Category

Research

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Position: Assoc. Director – Human Data & Computational Biology

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will help establish and lead the Human Data & Computational Biology capability within the Rare Disease Research Team. You will serve as a scientific partner across multiple disease areas, integrating human genetics, multi-omics, patient-derived data, and computational approaches to identify, prioritize, and validate novel therapeutic opportunities. We are seeking a scientist who combines deep computational expertise with strong biological intuition and a passion for understanding disease mechanisms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement computational strategies that support target discovery, validation, and prioritization.
  • Analyze and interpret large-scale biological datasets, including genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, imaging, and clinical data.
  • Leverage human genetic evidence to strengthen disease understanding and therapeutic hypothesis generation.
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external partners to integrate human genetics into early-stage discovery programs.
  • Establish scalable analytical workflows and approaches that can be applied across multiple disease areas.
  • Evaluate and implement emerging computational and AI-enabled approaches that accelerate scientific insight generation.
  • Identify opportunities to integrate new technologies and analytical methods into the Rare Disease Research operating model.
  • Work closely with disease biology pods to frame biological questions and translate computational findings into actionable scientific insights.
  • Contribute to scientific evaluations of external opportunities, collaborations, and business development activities.
  • Present scientific findings and recommendations to project teams, governance forums, and leadership groups.
  • Establish processes and frameworks that promote human-data-driven decision making.
  • As the function grows, participate in recruiting, developing, and leading future computational biology team members.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is an Associate Director with the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications

  • Doctorate degree and 3 years of experience applying computational approaches to biological and translational research questions

OR

  • Master’s degree and 7 years of analytics experience applying computational approaches to biological and translational research questions

OR

  • Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of analytics experience applying computational approaches to biological and translational research questions

OR

  • Associate’s degree and 12 years of analytics experience applying computational approaches to biological and translational research questions

OR

  • High school diploma / GED and 14 years of analytics experience applying computational approaches to biological and translational research questions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated expertise in human genetics, genomics, computational biology, or multi-omics analysis.
  • Strong track record of applying computational approaches to understand disease biology and identify therapeutic opportunities.
  • Ability to translate complex computational findings into clear biological insights and actionable scientific recommendations.
  • Experience working across multiple disease areas and integrating diverse biological datasets to answer challenging scientific questions.
  • Deep curiosity about disease mechanisms and a demonstrated passion for solving biological problems.
  • Experience partnering closely with experimental scientists to drive discovery and target validation efforts.
  • Experience leveraging human genetics to support target identification, validation, and prioritization.

title: Senior Data Product Manager - EPH Digital Products
description:
Are you passionate about turning complex data challenges into clear, scalable product solutions?

Do you enjoy leading through ambiguity, shaping roadmaps, and helping teams deliver high-quality outcomes in an evolving AI-enabled environment?

About our Team

The Enterprise Data & Analytics (EDA) team’s vision is a future where every colleague has trustworthy data they confidently use to streamline processes, drive smarter decisions and accelerate growth. We develop solutions for managing master data, provide capabilities to manage and govern data assets, and provide analytical platforms to deliver valuable business insights.

The Enterprise Product Hub (EPH) is central to that vision. EPH masters Elsevier’s saleable product data – bringing books, journals and a growing range of other products under a single governed model – and currently publishes it to around thirty consuming systems across the business. As Elsevier's product portfolio grows, so does EPH's remit, and the work ahead for the analysts, engineers and product specialists behind it.

About the Role

The Senior Data Product Manager owns a defined area of the EPH product estate – the attributes that enable us to sell a product, from what it's called to how it's identified and how it's sold. You will take your functional direction from the Head of Product Data, and will report indirectly to the Senior Director of EDA.

This role complements the existing product management by taking responsibility for a current gap in our data estate: the ingestion and publication of digital product data. It's an opportunity for a greenfield build – a digital product lifecycle solution to enable publication of digital product data across A&G, Health and Corporate Markets, alongside the existing books and journals data.

This is a delivery-first role: you will work closely with EPH business and engineering colleagues and represent EPH's position in cross-team decisions, with a meaningful second strand; coaching and growing the analysts around you.

Your success will be measured by the quality of the decisions you make under ambiguity, the analysts you grow, and – above all – the extent to which the product data you own helps Elsevier go to market more effectively and makes the customer buying experience better.

Responsibilities

  • Engage direct and indirect stakeholders to elicit requirements against our evolving product data model and translate these into clear, actionable specifications from concept through to live release.
  • Capture and articulate business value, ensuring work is prioritised based on outcomes and benefit to Elsevier as a whole.
  • Make prioritisation and scope decisions across maintenance activities, programme delivery, and longer-term roadmap trade-offs.
  • Build strong relationships across business and engineering teams and manage internal consumers through adoption, training, guidance, and documentation.
  • As the team shifts towards Spec-Driven Development, write tighter, more testable requirements up front – with a core focus on clarity, constraints and success criteria, which improve AI-assisted delivery.
  • Coach and develop junior and mid-level analysts, support onboarding, and contribute to recruitment activities.
  • Take ownership of a defined product area, shaping roadmap priorities, success measures, and long-term planning.
  • Contribute to data governance practices, system onboarding, and the creation of data and data flow documentation to aid understanding in the wider business.

Requirements

  • Experience writing clear, well-constrained requirements and specifications, and genuine interest in adapting your practice to AI-assisted delivery methods.
  • A track record of operating independently – owning a product or workstream end-to-end, making prioritisation and scope calls under ambiguity.
  • Curiosity and sound judgement, with the ability to work effectively from incomplete information and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Proven senior stakeholder management experience across business and engineering teams in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Deep knowledge of data management practices, ideally encompassing master data management (MDM), data governance and metadata management.
  • Practical experience with an MDM platform is advantageous.
  • Demonstrated experience coaching and developing junior or mid-level analysts.
  • Product management, product owner experience, or familiarity with academic publishing or large federated enterprise MDM environments would be beneficial.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

About the Business

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world

title: Full Stack (AI) Developer  (Talent Pool)
description:
Viseven Group is a leading global B2B MarTech service provider, empowering Pharma and LifeScience companies since 2009. Our mission is to drive digital transformation and excellence, offering comprehensive end-to-end software and digital marketing services tailored to the pharmaceutical industry. The company's solutions, products, and services are actively used by the top 100 Pharma and Life Science companies.
At Viseven, our rapidly growing team boasts over 700 highly skilled professionals, including experts in development, design, business analysis, project management, delivery, sales, marketing, and customer success.
With a global footprint in more than 30 countries across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC, and physical offices in Ukraine, Poland, Estonia, India, and the US, we are well-positioned to serve our diverse clientele.
Join us and become part of a pioneering team dedicated to shaping the future of digital transformation in Pharma and Life Sciences across more than 50 countries around the globe.

We are looking for a Middle Full Stack Developer to join our team and contribute to the development of AI-powered solutions.

In this role, you’ll work on well-defined tasks of moderate complexity, collaborating with experienced engineers and receiving guidance and code reviews. You’ll contribute to larger AI initiatives and help build reliable, scalable applications powered by modern Generative AI technologies.

Responsibilities:

As a Middle Full stack Engineer, you'll work on well-scoped tasks of moderate complexity, with guidance and code review from senior engineers, contributing to larger AI initiatives owned by the team.
- Develop and integrate AI agents with tool-use, memory, and context management, leveraging LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith frameworks, and integrating with foundational Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Integrate LLMs with external tools, APIs, knowledge sources, and enterprise systems.
- Contribute to building retrieval layers (e.g., hybrid search, vector search, metadata filtering) optimized for LLM consumption.
- Stay up to date with modern technologies and best practices for building Gen AI-based applications.

Required skills & knowledge:

- Proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js.
- Good understanding of software design principles, design patterns, and modern development best practices.
- Experience with NoSQL databases; familiarity with vector databases (OpenSearch a plus).
- Familiarity with AI agent workflows (tool-use, memory, and context management), or a strong interest in building them.
- Basic understanding of agentic behaviors and patterns, such as planning, retrieval, and self-correction.
- Exposure to LangChain and/or LangGraph libraries (or a strong willingness to ramp up quickly).
- Understanding of RAG workflows; hands-on experience is a plus.
- Familiarity with evaluation and testing approaches for AI systems.

Nice to have:
- Experience working with a microservices-based architecture.
- Experience with AWS (S3, Lambda, ECS, Bedrock).
- Experience with Docker & Kubernetes.
- Python knowledge.

What we provide:
We know our team members are key to achieving our goals, so we value and empower them to share their vision. We reward this passion with exceptional benefits, including:
Competitive Compensation: Regular performance-based salary and career development reviews.
Experienced Team: Join a passionate, experienced team in a friendly atmosphere.

English Courses: Learning opportunities to improve your language skills.

Work Environment: Enjoy a comfortable, fully equipped office and the possibility to work from home.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Location: Dublin, Ireland

Work Arrangement:Hybrid –minimum 3 days per week office attendance required

Territory:Global
Reporting to: Technical Team Lead

About Daon

Daon is a global leader in the defence against digital identity fraud and AI-generated synthetic identities. For over a quarter of a century, we have partnered with governments and leading enterprises to deliver secure, seamless identity experiences across financial services, telecommunications, healthcare, travel, and critical infrastructure.

OurTrustXplatform enables organisations to orchestrate secure, scalable, cross-channel identity workflows, supporting identity verification, biometric authentication, and lifecycle management across complex environments. More than two billion identities worldwide have been safeguarded by Daon technology.

Recognised as a leading provider by multiple analyst firms including Gartner®, Kuppinger Cole, and Frost & Sullivan®, Daon is at the forefront of shaping the future of identity security.

Role Overview:

As a Senior Java Developer on our TrustX SaaS platform, you will design, build, and improve cloud‑based backend services that power our identity verification and authentication and voice solutions. This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, understands end‑to‑end system flows, and collaborates closely with frontend engineers, architects, DevOps, mobile teams, and QA to deliver reliable, performant, secure software.

We’re looking for strong engineers, not just deep Java specialists. You should be capable of understanding how components interact across the stack, how data flows through the system, and how to make technical decisions that balance performance, scalability, maintainability, and product needs.

You will also be expected to embrace AI‑assisted development, including GitHub Copilot and other modern AI tools, to accelerate coding, improve quality, and help the team work more efficiently.

If you want to contribute to a high‑impact SaaS platform, and you enjoy both building features and shaping technical direction, you’ll thrive here.

What you will do
  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services built primarily with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Implement REST APIs, service integrations, data processing pipelines, and backend logic supporting our core platform capabilities.
  • Write maintainable, testable, and well‑structured code using modern engineering practices.
  • Collaborate with frontend, mobile, DevOps, architects, and QA to ensure features are delivered holistically and integrate smoothly across the platform.
  • Understand how backend components interact with UIs, cloud infrastructure, data stores, and external systems.
  • Participate in design discussions and provide input on architecture, system behavior, performance trade‑offs, and scaling strategies.
  • Use GitHub Copilot and other AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.
  • Help establish best practices for responsible, high‑value AI use within the engineering team.
  • Participate in experimentation and adoption of new AI‑based development workflows.
  • Write and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and automated test scenarios in collaboration with QA.
  • Profile and optimize services for performance, throughput, and scalability.
  • Contribute to improving observability (metrics, logs, tracing) in coordination with DevOps.
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers.
  • Collaborate with service delivery managers to ensure smooth deployment and production behavior.
  • Support occasional troubleshooting efforts for complex defects or production issues.
What you have:
  • 5+ years of experience developing backend or full‑stack software, ideally in SaaS environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Java, with experience in frameworks like Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Hibernate.
  • Ability to understand end‑to‑end system design, data flows, integration points, and how cloud‑native systems behave in production.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Hands‑on experience with Git, build tools (Maven/Gradle), CI/CD pipelines, and modern development practices.
  • A mindset focused on learning, growth, and continuous improvement, including adoption of AI‑assisted development tools.
  • Exposure to observability tools (logs, metrics, traces) and performance debugging.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills—comfortable working with cross‑functional teams.
  • Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent real‑world experience.
Nice to Have:
  • Background in identity, authentication, biometrics, cryptography, or fraud prevention.
  • Experience with telephony, voice biometrics, or multi‑channel communications platforms.
What we offer
  • Work in the rapidly growing fields of identity verification, authentication, biometrics, telephony, and fraud.
  • Opportunity to influence and shape the architecture of a major SaaS platform used by global enterprise customers.
  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • A flexible, supportive environment that respects work/life balance.

Join the brightest minds from around the globe as we build the future of digital identity!

title: ML Engineer
description:
Job Description

Pay: $100–$150/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for highly skilled Machine Learning Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving model development, training and inference systems, numerical computing, performance optimization, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging machine-learning engineering tasks. A representative task may require implementing or modifying a model, constructing a reproducible training or inference workflow, optimizing memory or throughput, debugging numerical or system-level failures, and verifying that the resulting implementation satisfies objective correctness and performance requirements.

This role is designed for experienced ML engineers and researchers who understand the systems beneath high-level APIs. Candidates should have meaningful practical experience with multiple tools from the modern ML stack and be able to explain what they personally built, optimized, or operated.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Develop and validate machine-learning models, training pipelines, inference systems, and supporting infrastructure.
  2. Implement model components, data pipelines, evaluation systems, and numerical methods.
  3. Build reproducible programmatic workflows using Python and command-line tools.
  4. Work with tensor operations, automatic differentiation, model architectures, tokenization, batching, and generation.
  5. Optimize training or inference for latency, throughput, memory usage, and hardware utilization.
  6. Diagnose numerical instability, incorrect tensor behavior, memory bottlenecks, distributed-system failures, and performance regressions.
  7. Compare model implementations and determine whether results are correct and reproducible.
  8. Review AI-generated code and technical solutions for correctness, efficiency, and engineering quality.
  9. Design objective tests, benchmarks, and verification criteria.
  10. Clearly document technical decisions, trade-offs, and limitations.

Required Qualifications

  1. A master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.
  2. Strong professional or research experience in machine learning.
  3. Practical proficiency with Python.
  4. Meaningful experience with at least two relevant ML frameworks, libraries, or inference tools.
  5. Strong understanding of model training, evaluation, numerical computation, or inference.
  6. Ability to debug ML systems beyond surface-level API usage.
  7. Ability to explain implementation decisions, performance trade-offs, and failure modes clearly.
  8. Experience building reproducible technical workflows.

Relevant tools may include:

  1. PyTorch
  2. JAX
  3. NumPy and SciPy
  4. SGLang
  5. vLLM
  6. llama.cpp
  7. Hugging Face Transformers
  8. Hugging Face Tokenizers

Equivalent tools may also be considered when the candidate demonstrates directly relevant depth.

Experience at a well-established technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or other recognized engineering environment is strongly preferred. Exceptional open-source or academic experience may also qualify.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

Job Description

CAMS, Community Association Management Services is looking for a part time (20 hour per week) motivated and detail oriented individual to service a community in Columbia, SC as their Architectural Review and Community Compliance Inspector.
This position will work out of our main CAMS office in Columbia, 29201 requiring both office-based administrative work and field inspections using your personal vehicle. Typical hours will be 9-2pm, or 10-3pm Monday-Thursday.
The pay rate for this position is $20-22 hourly, plus mileage reimbursements for conducting inspections and cell phone stipend.
The Architectural Review & Community Compliance Coordinator serves as the primary liaison between the Association, homeowners, builders, boards, and committees regarding architectural review and community compliance matters. This position is responsible for administering the architectural review process, coordinating committee activities, conducting community inspections, monitoring compliance with governing documents, maintaining accurate records, and communicating decisions and violations in a professional and timely manner.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Architectural Review Administration
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Architectural Review Committees (ARC/ARB), homeowners, contractors, and builders.
  • Coordinate and manage the architectural review process from application submission through final approval.
  • Review incoming applications for completeness and ensure required documentation is provided.
  • Prepare architectural review packets, agendas, meeting materials, and supporting documentation for committee review.
  • Attend committee meetings, record detailed meeting minutes, and communicate committee decisions to applicants.
  • Draft and distribute approval letters, denial letters, and requests for additional information.
  • Maintain digital and physical records of architectural applications, approvals, denials, and supporting documents.
  • Update association software systems and document repositories with applications, decisions, permits, approvals, and related correspondence.
  • Assist in maintaining and updating architectural guidelines, forms, and homeowner resources.
Community Compliance and Inspection
  • Conduct regular community inspections to ensure compliance with governing documents, architectural guidelines, rules, regulations, and approved plans.
  • Drive through communities to inspect homesites, common areas, and construction projects.
  • Perform inspections related to new construction, property modifications, and community standards.
  • Identify, document, and monitor covenant and architectural violations.
  • Investigate homeowner complaints and compliance concerns as directed.
  • Perform follow-up inspections to verify corrective actions and closure of violations.
  • Document inspection findings using tablets, mobile applications, cameras, and association management software.
  • Conduct final inspections for completed projects and present findings as necessary.
Communication and Coordination
  • Serve as a liaison between homeowners, board members, architectural review committees, association managers, builders, contractors, and vendors.
  • Communicate compliance concerns, architectural decisions, and project status updates professionally and consistently.
  • Respond promptly to phone calls, emails, and correspondence related to architectural review and compliance matters.
  • Educate homeowners regarding governing documents, architectural standards, approval requirements, and compliance expectations.
  • Keep management and committees informed regarding pending applications, compliance trends, construction activity, and unresolved issues.
Administrative and Reporting Functions
  • Maintain accurate records, reports, and tracking systems related to architectural review and compliance activities.
  • Process and track application fees, deposits, fines, and related documentation as required.
  • Generate reports for boards, committees, and management regarding compliance activity, architectural applications, and project status.
  • Assist with special projects and administrative duties as assigned.
  • Support overall association operations through effective recordkeeping, document management, and communication.
Required Skills and Experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, administrative, and time-management abilities.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to interpret and apply governing documents, architectural guidelines, and community standards.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Adobe applications.
  • Experience using databases, document management systems, and association management software.
  • Ability to work independently while functioning effectively as part of a team.
  • General understanding of contracts, construction documents, site plans, permits, covenants, and architectural review processes.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to work both indoors and outdoors in various weather conditions.
  • Ability to drive throughout multiple communities and exit vehicles to perform inspections.
  • Ability to walk community properties and construction sites when conducting inspections.
  • Ability to lift and carry materials up to 25 pounds occasionally.
Licensing and Transportation
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
  • Reliable transportation with proof of current insurance and registration.
  • Must maintain an acceptable driving record throughout employment.

Requirements

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in homeowners association management, architectural review, compliance administration, construction, planning, or related fields.
  • Knowledge of HOA governing documents and covenant enforcement procedures.
  • Experience with SharePoint, Vantaca, or similar association management platforms.
  • Familiarity with construction plans, site plans, architectural drawings, and permitting processes.

Job Title

Business Resilience Officer – Operational Continuity

Job Description

The Business Resilience Officer – Operational Continuity is a newly created role. The position plays a central role in setting and steering the bank’s operational continuity capabilities across business lines and functions.

You & your role

The Business Resilience unit ensures that Rabobank can anticipate, withstand and recover from disruptions in a coordinated, effective and reputation‑conscious manner. It integrates the bank’s capabilities across Crisis Management, Business Continuity Management (BCM), Operational Continuity and related disciplines to create unified future-proof resilience posture.

Business Resilience provides the structures, standards and central steering needed to maintain continuity of critical services, protect clients, and safeguard the bank’s license to operate. The unit sets the resilience governance framework, drives bank-wide preparedness activities, and ensures alignment with regulatory expectations and sectoral, national and international resilience initiatives.

Operational Continuity ensures that Rabobank can maintain delivery of critical services under stress, crisis, recovery and resolution scenarios. The function provides the end-to-end governance, lifecycle, tooling, steering and strategic service mapping that form the foundation of the bank’s operational resilience posture.

The Business Resilience Officer – Operational Continuity is accountable for developing and governing a modern, integrated operational continuity framework, ensuring Rabobank can maintain and restore critical services under a wide spectrum of scenarios.

Examples from practice

  • You are responsible for defining and maintaining the bank’s critical service inventory, impact tolerances and mapping the minimum configurations to deliver critical services

  • You have to set and govern an integrated operational continuity vision, lifecycle policies and standards

  • You ensure operational continuity requirements effectively support crisis, recovery and resolution scenarios

  • You are responsible for BCM maturity through lifecycle ownership tooling training, capability uplift and continuous benchmarking

  • You also manage regulatory alignment and key stakeholders, including audit, resolvability assessments and crisis governance

Facts & figures

  • 40 hours per week.

  • Over 43,822 Rabobank colleagues worldwide.

  • Rabobank operates in 38 countries for more than 9,500,000 customers.

Top responsibilities

  • Lead and develop Operational Continuity by building a high‑performing team, fostering a strong risk culture, and embedding customer‑first values.

  • Provide strategic leadership and thought guidance, advising senior management and representing Rabobank in industry, regulatory, and peer forums.

  • Strengthen talent and capability through coaching, succession planning, crisis role preparedness, and a strong bank‑wide continuity network.

  • Own and govern Operational Continuity frameworks

  • Ensure bank‑wide readiness and resilience by driving exercises, maturity monitoring, risk mitigation, and seamless integration with crisis and resilience functions.

Together we achieve more

We believe in the power of differences. By combining the strengths of our diverse team, we become a better bank. We are curious about what you will add to our team.

The COO Chief of Staff department acts as COO’s central orchestrator and central support organization, enabling integrated execution, governance, and oversight across the domain. Ensures transparent decision-making and alignment with enterprise strategy. Collaboration is our way of working; as one focused, analytical, and result-oriented team within Rabobank.

Work on yourself & the world around you

At Rabobank, your development and that of society go hand in hand. We invest in you and work together for a better world. At Rabobank, you work on yourself and the world around you.

This is reflected in your personal development budget, our hybrid working environment, and a good balance between work and home. You can work on banking matters for our private and business customers, as well as societal issues such as food and energy transitions.

Why everyone is welcome at Rabobank

At Rabobank, we believe we are stronger by complementing each other. By embracing our differences, we bring out the best in each other. We seek diversity in knowledge, skills, and experience, as well as in gender, background, and culture. Every department strives for variety and the space to be yourself – whoever you are. That is what diversity and inclusion at Rabobank is all about.

You & your talent

  • Academic degree in business, IT, risk management, continuity, or a related field.

  • 8–12+ years of experience in BCM, ITDR, operational resilience, and large, complex organizations.

  • Deep expertise in BCM, ITDR, operational continuity, and Recovery & Resolution Planning.

  • Proven experience implementing BCM frameworks and tooling, including regulatory programs.

  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to challenge the status quo.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including board‑level advisory and regulator interaction (DNB, ECB, SRB).

  • Demonstrated change leadership, influence across matrixed organizations, and transition management under pressure.

  • Leadership aligned with Rabo values: ownership, customer focus, data‑driven insights, collaboration, change agility, and strong storytelling skills.

The Sustainability Specialist plays a key role in advancing the organization’s global sustainability program. This corporate-level position is responsible for drafting annual submissions to key sustainability raters and rankers and working to identify process and score improvement opportunities. This role also supports the calculation and documentation of the company’s GHG inventory and the maintenance of accurate ESG data, documentation and systems. The Sustainability Specialist works with cross-functional teams to support responses to a variety of ESG inquiries to ensure consistent, high quality ESG reporting and disclosures across the organization.

Key responsibilities:

  • ESG Data & Process Management: Support the collection, calculation and documentation of ESG data, including the company’s GHG Inventory.
  • Raters/Rankers Management: Draft annual submissions for sustainability raters and rankers (e.g., CDP, EcoVadis,) and support improved ESG scoring by identifying actionable gaps and collaborating on process enhancements.
  • GHG Inventory Documentation: Maintain and update the GHG Inventory Management Plan, ensuring internal procedures and assumptions are well-documented and aligned with relevant standards.
  • Disclosure Support: Assist in the development of the annual Sustainability Report and regulatory disclosures including CSRD.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve ESG data management and reporting processes. Collaborate with manager and other stakeholders to implement improvement.
  • ESG Inquiry Response: Support the response to internal and external ESG-related inquiries by facilitating with internal stakeholders, with support from manager.

  • Additional ESG Support: Provide support for evolving ESG-related activities as needed, adapting to changes in regulatory requirements, customer expectations and the broader ESG landscape.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Finance, Supply Chain, Environmental Science, Business, Engineering, Data Analytics or other related field.
  • Minimum of 1+ years of professional experience in ESG, sustainability, environmental reporting, data management, sustainability compliance, or related disciplines.
  • Experience gathering, analyzing, and interpreting sustainability or ESG-related data.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency with data management tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3 to 5+ years of experience in sustainability, ESG reporting, corporate responsibility, environmental compliance, or related areas.

Position Level: This position may be filled at varying levels based on the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and demonstrated capabilities. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to contribute across a range of sustainability initiatives, with responsibilities aligned to their experience level.

The Franklin County Auditor’s Office is seeking a Transfer & Conveyance Representative to join the Real Estate team.

Who are we?

The Franklin County Auditor’s Office is dedicated to serving the community by ensuring fairness and accuracy in weight and measures across the county. Our mission is to protect and empower consumers, making sure they receive what they rightfully pay for at gas pumps and retail store scanners. As a trusted steward of county finances, we strive to promote fiscal responsibility and innovative initiatives that benefit all residents of Franklin County.

In addition to these important responsibilities, we assess property values to determine fair property taxes, while also working to provide tax relief for senior and citizens who are disabled. We understand the importance of supporting vulnerable populations and strive to make the process as accessible and accommodating as possible.

We are committed to upholding state regulations by ensuring that our furry friends are licensed. As required by state law, we proudly license dogs, recognizing the significance of responsible pet ownership within our community.

At the Franklin County Auditor’s Office, we value the diversity of our residents and businesses and strive to create an environment of fairness, inclusivity, and equity in all our endeavors.

What will you do?

Processes deeds and legal instruments; performs data entry of conveyances using internal systems (e.g., atENT, Simplifile); verifies ownership, legal descriptions, parcel numbers, and mailing addresses; calculates conveyance fees and determines exemption status; reviews and interprets legal documents including deeds, affidavits, court orders, and trust instruments to ensure compliance with the Ohio Revised Code (ORC), County transfer policies, and Auditor’s Office procedures; ensures accuracy and completeness of submissions.

Provides information to, and answers questions from, the general public, title companies, attorneys, and taxpayers; serves walk-in, phone, and email customers by explaining procedures and documentation requirements for real estate transfers; prepares and issues return letters requesting additional or corrected documentation to complete a transfer.

Accepts payments; balances cash register receipts and reconciles daily pay-ins with accounts receivable; tracks and records conveyance numbers, fees, and exempt transfers; maintains accurate daily financial records and spreadsheets; ensures accuracy of payment and processing information; scans and indexes forms according to record retention policies.

Receives and organizes incoming and outgoing transfer-related mail; prepares and delivers documents to the Franklin County Recorder’s Office; assists with filing and preparation of documents for internal processing and retention; performs document imaging, copying, and related clerical duties.

Performs general office and clerical functions (e.g., orders supplies, adds paper to copiers, changes date on stamps, takes inventory of office supplies, etc.).

Who should apply?

Possession of an associate’s degree from an accredited college or university in a related field; one (1) or more years of related experience and/or training; or any combination of training, education, or experience which provides the desired knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Notary Public preferred. Must possess and maintain valid Ohio driver's license and have an acceptable driving record; must comply with the FCAO Driving Policy.

We believe in the power of diversity and inclusivity, and we want to create an exciting and equitable environment for all. You belong here, and we encourage you to apply today!

Why should you work here?

We believe in providing an exceptional benefits package that recognizes the value of our employees. Some of our benefits include:

1. Healthcare: We offer a competitive medical, dental, and vision plan with low-cost deductibles.

2. Public Loan Forgiveness: As a public employee, your student loans can be forgiven after making the required monthly qualifying payments.

3. Education Reimbursement & Training: We invest in your growth and development by allowing you to expand your skills.

4. Free-Parking Program/COTA Buss Pass: Take advantage of the free parking program available through a lottery process annually; employees of the County get free weekday access to the Central Ohio Transit Authority (COTA) system.

5. Wellness Incentive Program: Our wellness incentive program rewards you with monetary incentives for engaging in healthy activities and maintaining a balanced lifestyle.

6. Generous Time Off: You deserve time for yourself and your loved ones. Enjoy 32 hours of personal leave per calendar year, 2 floating holidays, and 12 paid holidays annually. Additionally, accumulate sick and vacation leave for well-deserved breaks.

7. Hybrid Work Schedule: We understand the importance of work-life harmony. For most positions, we offer a hybrid work schedule that allows flexibility in where you work, promoting a healthy integration of personal and professional life.

8. Emphasis on Diversity and Inclusivity: We celebrate and embrace diversity in all its forms. Our office is committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment where everyone feels valued and empowered.

The Emergency Room Technician (ER Tech) provides direct patient care and assists physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals in the Emergency Department. The ER Tech performs clinical and non-clinical duties to support efficient patient care, maintain a safe environment, and ensure optimal patient outcomes in a fast-paced emergency setting.

Patient Care
Assist with patient assessments and monitoring under the direction of a registered nurse or physician.
Obtain and document vital signs, weight, oxygen saturation, and other patient measurements.
Assist patients with activities of daily living, including mobility, hygiene, and comfort measures.
Perform electrocardiograms (EKGs/ECGs).

Assist with wound care, splinting, casting, dressing changes, and other procedures.
Prepare patients for examinations, tests, and treatments.
Clinical Support
Assist physicians and nurses during emergency procedures and resuscitation efforts.
Set up and maintain procedure rooms and treatment areas.
Prepare, clean, and sterilize equipment as required.
Stock and maintain supplies, ensuring readiness of patient care areas.
Transport patients to diagnostic testing areas, inpatient units, or other departments.
Documentation and Communication
Accurately document patient information and procedures performed within scope.
Communicate patient observations and concerns promptly to nursing staff.
Collaborate effectively with the interdisciplinary healthcare team.
Maintain patient confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA regulations.
Safety and Quality
Follow infection prevention and control practices.
Adhere to hospital policies, emergency procedures, and safety regulations.
Assist in maintaining a clean, organized, and safe emergency department environment.
Participate in quality improvement and patient safety initiatives.
Qualifications
Education
High school diploma or GED required.
Completion of a certified Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) program, Nursing Assistant program, or equivalent healthcare training preferred.
Certifications
Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
EMT certification preferred.
Advanced certifications may be required based on facility needs.
Experience
Previous experience in emergency care, patient care, EMS, or hospital settings preferred.
Experience working in a fast-paced healthcare environment is beneficial.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Knowledge of basic patient care principles and emergency department operations.
Ability to recognize changes in patient condition and report findings promptly.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively in a high-stress environment.
Proficiency with medical equipment and electronic health records (EHR).
Strong teamwork and customer service skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, physically demanding environment.
Ability to respond quickly during emergencies.

Hospital Emergency Department.

title: Program Supervisor
description:
Who We Are:
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.

Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.

Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

Position Overview:
We are looking for a Program Supervisor in De Soto, Kansas.

This person is the onsite leader responsible for delivering a consistent, hospitality-driven Fooda experience at a client location. As the primary point of contact for clients, consumers, and vendors, this role ensures that daily service runs smoothly, issues are resolved quickly, and the overall experience reflects Fooda’s standards of quality and care.

This role also plays an important role in shaping the restaurant network that serves your location—building strong relationships, communicating expectations, and ensuring partners are set up for success. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role blends hospitality, operational judgment, and client care, and is key to maintaining overall satisfaction and trust in Fooda’s service.

What You Will Be Doing:
  • Lead the day-to-day onsite experience, ensuring Fooda’s programs run smoothly, on time, and with a hospitality-first mindset.
  • Serve as the primary onsite contact for the client and their employees, building trust through consistency, communication, and quick problem solving.
  • Provide onsite guidance and support to staff or coordinators when needed, helping everyone stay aligned and prepared for service.
  • Partner with restaurant teams to ensure they’re set up for success each day—communicating expectations, supporting setup, and addressing issues as they arise.
  • Keep a close pulse on the customer experience, noticing trends, resolving concerns, and escalating when appropriate to the Sr Strategic Account Manager.
  • Maintain the operational details that keep service running well—menus, point-of-sale updates, signage, daily flow, and overall presentation.
  • Influence the restaurant network supporting your location by sharing feedback, reinforcing standards, and helping ensure strong vendor performance.
  • This role is 100% onsite in De Soto, KS.

Who You Are
  • You’re naturally hospitality-driven and enjoy creating a warm, smooth experience for clients and customers.
  • You’re a steady, reliable onsite presence who takes ownership and operates confidently with a high degree of autonomy.
  • You communicate clearly and professionally—whether you’re working with clients, staff, or restaurant partners.
  • You’re calm under pressure and think quickly when plans shift, viewing challenges as opportunities to problem-solve.
  • You’re organized, detail-oriented, and committed to keeping day-to-day operations running at a high standard.
  • You’re comfortable offering direction and support onsite without being a formal people manager.
  • You have experience in hospitality, food service, catering, or operations, and enjoy being the person who “keeps everything moving.”

What We’ll Hook You Up With:

  • Paid maternity and parental leave benefits
  • Flexible spending accounts

  • Work closely with multidisciplinary teams, including psychiatrists, therapists, social workers, and case managers.

title: Community Health Worker
description:
About A.C.T.I.O.N.

A.C.T.I.O.N. is a proposed community-wide overdose prevention initiative that will expand access to FDA-approved opioid overdose reversal medications (OORMs), community training, and treatment referral pathways across the twelve counties of Alabama's 4th Congressional District (Lauderdale, Colbert, Franklin, Marion, Lamar, Fayette, Walker, Winston, Cullman, Marshall, DeKalb, and Blount). This locally embedded, field-based role requires strong ties to the assigned counties.

Key Responsibilities

? Distribute FDA-approved OORMs (naloxone and nalmefene) to bystanders, community sectors, and rural first responders within Marion, Lamar, and Fayette Counties.

? Train local Training-of-Trainers cohorts to extend the training curriculum further into the community.

? Support referral and linkage follow-up for individuals identified through prevention or overdose response activities, in coordination with the Program Coordinator/Data Lead.

? Maintain local relationships with the cluster's designated community partner, healthcare providers, pharmacies, faith-based organizations, and schools.

? Complete required data collection instruments accurately and submit them to the Program Coordinator/Data Lead on the required schedule.

? Participate in the Local Community Prevention Collaborative and community-facing outreach and distribution events.

Minimum Qualifications
? Bachelor's degree in public health, social work, or a related field

title: Plasma Processing Technician
description:
Job Description Summary

Responsible for the accurate and timely sampling, testing, shipping and storage of plasma collected from donors.

Job Description

1 In compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), responsible for collecting plasma samples and moving plasma units to freezer to ensure product quality.

2 Ensures plasma units are properly stored according to SOPs, which could include unsuitable plasma units and samples.

3 Ensures accuracy of unit labeling by verifying the pre-printed label matches the dynamic label.

4 Utilizes sterile technique to draw samples and uses heat sealer to assure the sterility and quality of plasma unit samples per SOPs.

5 May ensure samples and units are packed and shipped in accordance with SOPs and center procedures. Prepares shipping and unit disposal documentation.

6 Monitors freezer and refrigerator temperatures and immediately informs appropriate personnel if equipment is not functioning properly. Records variances.

7 Conducts daily calibration of equipment according to SOPs.

8 Ensures the accurate recording of donor data in the electronic donor information management system as outlined in the SOPs.

9 Understands the policies and procedures associated with hyper immune programs at the center if applicable.

10 Maintains clean efficient work environment, and ensures sufficient operating supplies and forms are available as needed. Follows all Health Safety & Environmental (HSE) and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) policies and procedures. Promotes safety in all actions.

11 Maintains confidentiality of all personnel, donor and center information.

12 May be cross-trained in other areas to meet the needs of the business.

13 Bilingual skills may be required, at the discretion of the organization, to meet the needs of the business.

14 Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Education

• High school diploma or equivalent required

Experience

• Minimum of three (3) months experience in laboratory or warehouse environment preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience

• Must be able to perform basic math calculations

Working Conditions

(physical & mental requirements)

• Ability to understand, remember and apply oral and/or written instructions

• Ability to understand and follow basic instructions and guidelines

• Must be able to see and speak with customers and observe equipment operation.

• Occasionally perform tasks while standing and walking up to 100% of time

• Reach, bend, kneel and have high level of manual dexterity

• Occasionally be required to lift and carry up to 25 pounds

• Fast paced environment with frequent interruptions

• Frequently exposed to hazardous chemicals, extreme temperatures and to blood borne pathogens

• Required to wear Personal Protective Equipment while performing specific tasks or in certain areas

• Required to work overtime and extended hours to support center operational needs

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, national origin or other legally protected classifications.

About CSL Plasma

CSL Plasma operates one of the world’s largest and most sophisticated plasma donation networks, with nearly 330 donation centers in the U.S. and Europe. CSL Plasma is a subsidiary of CSL, a global biopharma company. Plasma collected at CSL Plasma facilities is used by CSL for the sole purpose of manufacturing lifesaving plasma-derived therapies for people in more than 100 countries. The parent company, CSL (ASX:CSL; USOTC:CSLLY), headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 29,000+ people.

Why MediGold?

MediGold is a not-for-profit Medicare Advantage insurance plan serving seniors and other Medicare beneficiaries across the United States. We’re dedicated to providing excellent customer service, cost-effective care, and exceptional healthcare coverage. We rely on talented colleagues in a wide variety of professional roles including information technology, financial analysis, audit, provider relations and more.

We know that exceptional patient care starts with taking care of our colleagues, so we invest in great people and all that we ask in return is that you come to work ready to make a difference and do the right thing.

Position Purpose:

Provider Data Management role manages the integrity of the Health Plan's provider data to maintain compliance with Federal and local requirements. This position must have knowledge and competence in regulatory requirements for the Health Plan's provider data while maintaining confidentiality and use of discretionary discernment with sensitive materials. Serves as department subject matter expert requiring knowledge of plan systems, tools, policies and procedures and acts as liaison with internal and external customers. The role will conduct audits to ensure compliance with the Centers for Medicaid and Medicaid Services (CMS) requirements. Additionally, the role will be expected to produce accurate reports of the plan's provider data as required by CMS for HEDIS purposes. The ORS-Provider Data Management role will be responsible for identification of root causes regarding any discrepancies found in the provider data while working alongside all other Operations Resolution Specialists across the plan to fully resolve issues

What you will do:

  • · Process rejection reports from PDL process and correct any errors discovered

  • · Education of CIN, groups, etc. for future expansion regarding direct and delegated roster formats to ensure accurate PDL

  • · Internal audit (monitoring) of Provider Data, such as demographic changes, TIN adds, provider terms, etc.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Associate or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

  • · Certification: N/A

  • · Experience: One to three years experience preferred in either managed care health insurance.

  • · Effective Communication Skills.

  • · Strong written and verbal communication skills in order to communicate in clear, concise terms to internal and external customer.

  • · Analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • · Experience in use of computer systems and office automation applications.

  • · Knowledgeable with provider credentialing and contracting terminology.

  • · Basic knowledge of healthcare claims process.

Mount Carmel, a member of Trinity Health, has been a transforming healing presence in Central Ohio for over 135 years. Who We Are

At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line-haul transportation, last-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.

JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Plan transportation strategies based on business needs, optimizing end-to-end processes including cargo collection, sorting, transit, and delivery. Streamline routes to minimize returns, establish standardized operating procedures, improve efficiency, and reduce costs.

title: Market Intelligence Analyst
description:
About Ameren Services (B&CS)

Ameren Services provides administrative support and services to Ameren Corporation and its operating companies, subsidiaries and affiliates. Ameren Services includes a wide range of skill sets and roles, from finance and legal experts to digital and cyber specialists, plus those charged with ensuring environmental compliance and operational safety. Together, we help execute a strategy that enables Ameren to deliver superior long-term value to customers, shareholders and the environment.

Our benefits include:

  • Medical coverage on date of hire

  • 100% employer paid cash balance pension plan

  • 401(k) with company match fully vested on date of hire

  • Minimum of 15 days paid vacation and 12 paid holidays

  • Paid parental leave and family caregiver leave

Visit our Benefits & Perks Page for more information on benefits provided to regular full-time employees. ​

About The Position

The Market Intelligence Analyst supports the supply chain function with the assessment and management of the costs of equipment and services procured by Ameren. The Analyst works within the Market Intelligence teams to update and understand cost models for major capital equipment, materials, and services utilized by all Ameren companies. The Analyst will support the Market Intelligence team in facilitating the use of cost modeling process by researching and maintaining accurate data as model inputs.

This hybrid role is located in St. Louis, Missouri.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Works independently, with guidance as needed from the Market Intelligence Manager and Specialist, for analyses and tasks, utilizes skills in clean sheet cost modeling and data analysis to assist in the development of should cost models for projects and procurement team. For complex models and analyses, assist the Market Intelligence team in category, equipment, or service level data.
  • Assists in the development of cost modeling and analysis by collaborating with sourcing teams on large construction projects, major capital equipment, high spend commodities and services sourcing events.
  • Uses data analysis techniques and templates to model quantitative information from various market data sources.
  • Research cost drivers such as production time, materials, and labor for Ameren goods and services.
  • Assist market intelligence team to update and maintain existing cost and forecast models.
  • Update prices, indexes, material costs, labor mark-ups and other important factors files using statistical analysis.
  • Design and generate Supply Chain reports and analysis via visualizations, business report methods, and internal reporting systems.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university required, preferably in an analytical discipline (e.g., Finance, Economics. Business, Engineering, etc.). One year of directly relevant work experience in cost estimating, purchasing, consulting, cost accounting, or finance preferred. Advance degree preferred. Previous Ameren experience preferred.

In addition to the above qualifications, the successful candidate will demonstrate:

Quantitative financial or economic modeling experience Strong analytical and communication skills, detailed oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously using time management skills. Thorough understanding of Ameren's systems applications (i.e. Oracle) preferred. Possess excellent math skills and be proficient with Microsoft Office Suite with an emphasis on strong to advanced Excel skills.

Additional Information

Ameren’s selection process includes a series of interviews and may include candidate testing and/or an individual aptitude or skill-based assessment. Specific details will be provided to qualified candidates.
