title: Senior Robotics Engineer
description:
The Role

Joining Moderna offers the opportunity to help advance mRNA medicines through high-impact robotics, automation, and systems engineering for Research.

This Senior Robotics Engineer is an individual contributor role provides expert technical leadership for robotics and automation platforms that enable scalable, flexible, high-throughput research workflows. You will contribute to the design, integration, and validation of robotic systems, electronic controls, custom automation software, and orchestration platforms while advising cross-functional teams, solving complex technical problems, and building consensus around practical, reliable solutions.

Here’s What You’ll Do

  • Provide expert technical leadership for robotics and automation projects supporting research discovery, experimental enablement, and high-throughput scientific workflows.

  • Contribute to system architecture across robotics, motion control, instrument control, scheduling, data flow, safety, and orchestration layers.

  • Translate scientific and operational needs into system specifications, requirements, integration plans, risk assessments, and verification strategies.

  • Design and develop automation software, electronic controls, and workflows that integrate robotics, instruments, sensors, and data systems.

  • Lead or co-lead integration of robotic platforms, new instruments, technologies, and automation modules into extensible platform architectures.

  • Identify and help manage technical risks, dependencies, and complexity while improving throughput, flexibility, reliability, reproducibility, and process efficiency.

  • Serve as a technical expert and advisor for robotics, automation, controls, and systems integration within Research and partner scientific teams.

  • Partner with Research, Delivery Science, Digital, Engineering, and scientific stakeholders to align platform capabilities with experimental goals, data needs, and evolving research priorities.

  • Apply automation best practices, external technology awareness, and emerging robotics capabilities to improve experimental workflows, research productivity, and the platform roadmap.

  • Communicate advanced technical concepts clearly, build consensus, and influence stakeholders to adopt effective technical approaches.

  • Mentor engineers and scientists and contribute to standards and best practices in robotics engineering, automation software, controls, verification, and validation.

Here’s What You’ll Need (Basic Qualifications):

  • B.S. or higher with 2+ years or more of relevant experience in robotics, automation, systems, controls, software engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Deep experience designing, integrating, and validating robotic systems, electronic controls, scientific instrumentation, and automation software.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, C#, or similar languages for automation, instrument control, robotics integration, workflow orchestration, or data-driven platform development.

  • Ability to translate complex laboratory and scientific workflows into scalable automated research systems with clear requirements, risk assessments, verification plans, and support models.

  • Proven ability to solve complex technical problems using advanced analytical judgment, cross-functional influence, and technical leadership.

  • This position is site-based, requiring you to be at Moderna’s site full-time. This position is not eligible for remote work.

Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with liquid handling robotics, collaborative or industrial robotic systems, motion control, automation safety, and instrument integration.

  • Experience with research automation, assay enablement, scientific instrumentation, or automated experimental workflows in a biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or academic research environment.

  • Experience architecting modular automation systems, orchestration platforms, reusable software frameworks, or extensible robotic workcells.

  • Familiarity with LNP development or other complex experimental systems.

  • Strong record of technical leadership, stakeholder influence, mentorship, and communication across diverse audiences.

  • A desire to make an impact in a fast-paced, mission-driven organization that is Bold, Relentless, Curious, and Collaborative.


Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

  • Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
  • A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
  • Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown
  • Savings and investments to help you plan for the future
  • Location-specific perks and extras

The salary range for this role is $145,900.00 - $234,200.00. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An individual’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, performance, and business or organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, other incentive compensation, or equity award, subject to company plan eligibility criteria and individual performance.

About Moderna

Since our founding in 2010, we have aspired to build the leading mRNA technology platform, the infrastructure to reimagine how medicines are created and delivered, and a world-class team. We believe in giving our people a platform to change medicine and an opportunity to change the world.


By living our mission, values, and mindsets every day, our people are the driving force behind our scientific progress and our culture. Together, we are creating a culture of belonging and building an organization that cares deeply for our patients, our employees, the environment, and our communities.


We are proud to have been recognized as a Science Magazine Top Biopharma Employer, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in the U.S.


If you want to make a difference and join a team that is changing the future of medicine, we invite you to visit modernatx.com/careers to learn more about our current opportunities.

title: Senior Planner
description:
Senior Planner

SP Energy Networks, Fullarton Drive, Glasgow East Investment Park, Cambuslang. G32 8FA

Salary up to £56,750 per year (depending on experience)
Permanent (37hr week) / Hybrid (Office and Site 3 days/ 2 days remote)

Closing Date: 25th September 2026

Help us create a better future, quicker

At ScottishPower we know that our people are our strongest asset, so we’re always looking for individuals whose energy, intelligence and passion can help us reach our goals.


At the heart of all business visions and activities are the people whose individual efforts and performance make it happen. We encourage our people to be proud of where they work, to share their ideas and to own their careers. We promote a safe working environment and push people to shape and progress their careers so that we grow our talent within the company.

Purpose

As Senior Planner within ScottishPower Energy Networks (SPEN) Transmission Core Projects, you will be at the centre of a vibrant and evolving project delivery team responsible for development and management of project schedules within a portfolio for the multi-billion-pound future investment plan.

Schedules have, and will in future, be generated to support ‘once-in-a-generation’ Critical National Network Infrastructure Construction projects, reinforcing the existing Electrical Transmission Asset-base and expanding the Transmission Network to meet the future UK Network electricity demand and facilitate delivery of UK Net-Zero strategy.

You will be directly responsible for the production, maintenance & update, change control, schedule risk management and reporting of high-quality Primavera P6 Schedules for over £2bn of SP Transmission Strategic Reinforcement projects.

What you'll be doing
Responsible for developing and maintaining project schedules for SP Transmission Core Projects, resolving all project scoping and project specific issues by interfacing with members of the Project Team, you will ensure all Environmental & Planning, Engineering Design and System Access requirements are taken into account whilst developing Core Project Transmission schedules.

You will interface with relevant business experts to obtain progress details required to provide adequate project scheduling updates, allowing project performance to be monitored against agreed project control measures (KPIs).

Responsible for updating project schedules at a pre-determined frequency (usually monthly), obtaining relevant inputs through collaboration with other Project Team members, you will analyse internal departmental and external contractor project schedules as required, ensuring and advising the Project Team of their suitability and any actions required to meet the overall project plan control and schedule targets.

Expected to attend internal and external meetings as required, providing planning advice, reports, KPIs and programme views to assist Project Team decision making, you will comply with the relevant Quality Management System, supporting any process improvement initiatives.

What you’ll bring

Educated to HNC level in an Engineering/Mathematical discipline or with previous experience in scheduling/programming/planning projects and a portfolio of works, you will possess knowledge of Engineering and/or Construction projects using Primavera P6 and MS Project planning software.

Experienced in working with Engineering specifications and documentation, you will be familiar with the configuration and general arrangement of electricity supply infrastructure e.g. Substations, Overhead Lines and Cables.

Possessing strong verbal and written communication skills, you will be experienced in report writing and use of MS Office tools such as Word, Excel and Access.

An appreciation of quality assurance processes is beneficial.

What's in it for you

As well as a competitive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we’ll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.

At ScottishPower, we believe it’s the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family’s wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action – our benefits are designed to help you do just that - so that you have everything you need to take care of your world – today and tomorrow. That’s why our benefits include:

  • 36 days annual leave

  • Holiday purchase – perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave

  • Share Incentive Plan and Sharesave Scheme

  • Payroll giving and charity matched funding

  • Technology Vouchers – save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases

  • Count us in – pledge to reduce carbon emissions and help fight climate change

  • Electric Vehicle Schemes – to help you transition to green/clean driving

  • Cycle to Work scheme and public transport season ticket loans

  • Options to purchase dental insurance, private medical insurance, health cash plan and annual health assessments

  • Life Assurance (4x salary)

  • Access to ‘nudge’ financial wellbeing support

  • Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more

Why SP Energy Networks

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world’s largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make-up the transmission network – connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It’s a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland’s ambition to be Net Zero by 2044. And we’re taking it very seriously.

We’re investing >£10.5 billion into our transmission network, directly supporting the rapid growth needed in renewable energy. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.

Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you’ll fit right in.

title: Sr Associate Data Analytics & Reporting
description:
Career Category

Supply Chain

Job Description

ABOUT AMGEN

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Engineering Data Analysis & Reporting Analyst is an individual contributor role responsible for delivering trusted, standardized analytics, reporting, and insights across Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) and Engineering Operations Services (EOS) domains.

This role enables data-driven decision-making by designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, KPI frameworks, and analytics solutions that provide actionable insights into operational performance, compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Reporting to the Engineering Data analysis and Reporting Lead, this role partners closely with Engineering, EHS, EOS, Master Data Management, Data Engineering, and Technology teams to ensure reporting solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise data and analytics strategies. The role will leverage Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Enterprise Data Lake (EDL), Power BI, and Tableau platforms to integrate data, build reporting solutions, and maintain KPI governance standards.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance standardized dashboards, scorecards, and reports supporting EHS and EOS governance, operational performance, compliance monitoring, and business decision-making.

  • Design and implement interactive reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, and Microsoft Fabric to provide actionable business insights.

  • Integrate and transform data from Enterprise Data Lake (EDL), Databricks, enterprise applications, and other data sources to create scalable reporting and analytics solutions.

  • Build and maintain datasets, semantic models, and reporting layers that ensure consistent KPI calculations and reporting standards across EHS and EOS.

  • Establish, maintain, and continuously improve the EHS and EOS KPI Registry, including KPI definitions, business rules, calculations, ownership, targets, thresholds, source systems, and reporting governance.

  • Define, document, and maintain leading and lagging indicators that support proactive risk management, operational performance monitoring, and compliance reporting.

  • Support the Data Analysis and Reporting Lead in managing and maintaining SharePoint sites, reporting content, document libraries, permissions, and data resources; requires proficiency in SharePoint administration, information architecture, data organization, access management, and stakeholder support.

  • Ensure analytics and reporting solutions are accurate, traceable, validated, and audit ready.

  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure data integrity and reporting reliability.

  • Translate business, operational, compliance, and stakeholder requirements into reporting and analytics solutions.

  • Analyze data to identify trends, performance gaps, risks, opportunities, and emerging signals that support continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Develop executive-level reporting, management scorecards, and ad-hoc analytics to support strategic and operational decision-making.

  • Collaborate with Systems, Master Data Management, Data Engineering, and Technology teams to improve data quality, governance, and reporting capabilities.

  • Support reporting governance processes, KPI standardization, metric alignment, and reporting best practices.

  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes, streamline workflows, and improve reporting efficiency through analytics and technology solutions.

  • Create and maintain reporting documentation, data dictionaries, KPI definitions, and process documentation to support sustainable operations and knowledge management.

  • Engage stakeholders across Engineering, EHS, EOS, Operations, Quality, Compliance, and Technology organizations to ensure reporting solutions meet business needs and drive adoption.

  • Interpret data using sound analytical methods and business context to provide meaningful recommendations and actionable insights.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, Business Analytics, or related fields.

  • 5–9 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, data visualization, or data management roles.

  • Hands-on experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI and Tableau.

  • Experience developing KPI frameworks, metric definitions, reporting standards, and governance processes.

  • Experience integrating and analyzing data from multiple enterprise systems and data sources.

  • Demonstrated experience translating business requirements into reporting and analytics solutions.

  • Experience performing data validation, quality assurance, and reporting controls within a regulated environment.

  • Ability to work on site in Hyderabad and collaborate with stakeholders across global time zones when required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • Advanced expertise with Power BI, Tableau, Microsoft Fabric, and Databricks analytics environments.

  • Experience building and maintaining KPI registries, metric catalogs, data dictionaries, and reporting governance frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of leading and lagging indicators, operational performance metrics, and risk-based reporting methodologies.

  • Experience supporting EHS, Engineering, Facilities, Manufacturing, Operations, or Quality business functions.

  • Experience working with EHS platforms such as Cority, Sphera, Enablon, or similar systems.

  • Knowledge of enterprise data governance, master data management, and data quality best practices.

  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced global environment.

  • Experience supporting continuous improvement, automation, and digital transformation initiatives.

  • Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics, predictive reporting, and advanced visualization techniques.

  • Experience working across regions and time zones with global stakeholder teams.

PROFESSIONAL CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Certifications in Microsoft Power BI, Tableau (Certified Professional), or Databricks (Data Analyst/Data Engineer) are advantageous and considered a plus.

As the largest Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) in Southeast Texas, Legacy Community Health has been delivering comprehensive, high-quality, and affordable health care for nearly 40 years.

At Legacy, we know our success is powered by our people. We're always looking for talented, passionate individuals who want more than a job—they want a meaningful career that makes a real impact.

Explore our open positions and see if a career at Legacy is right for you.

Core Employee Expectations

At Legacy Community Health, our mission—Driving healthy change in our communities—guides everything we do. To fulfill this mission, every team member is expected to embody the following core attributes in their daily work, regardless of role or department:

Approachable & Collaborative

We bring our expertise without ego. In a collaborative healthcare environment, humility fosters trust and teamwork. Our employees value diverse perspectives, seek input from others, and are unafraid to acknowledge when they need help. We stay grounded in our purpose: to serve patients and communities with compassion and humility.

Driven & Committed

We are driven by a deep commitment to excellence in patient care and organizational improvement. Our employees take initiative, embrace challenges, and go the extra mile to support our mission. Whether improving patient outcomes, streamlining processes, or stepping up in times of need, we are always striving to drive healthy change—within ourselves, our teams, and the communities we serve.

Our team members demonstrate sound judgment, cultural sensitivity, and the ability to navigate complex situations with empathy and professionalism. They communicate clearly and respectfully with patients, families, and colleagues, building trust and fostering a safe, inclusive environment for all.

title: Specialist Mfg 1
description:
Career Category

Manufacturing

Job Description

Job Summary

The Specialist, Manufacturing – AI-Enabled Innovation (IVI) is an individual contributor within the Amgen India Capability Center (AIN), supporting the design, development, and deployment of digital and data-enabled solutions across Amgen’s global manufacturing network. In the initial phase, this role supports manufacturing sites in the deployment of core capabilities, contributing to transition readiness, knowledge transfer, stabilization activities and adoption of new ways of working. In the steady state, this role operates within the Innovation Velocity Interface (IVI), contributing to the end-to-end lifecycle of innovation—from intake and requirements definition through MVP development and scaling. The Specialist brings deep domain expertise in specific manufacturing systems or processes (e.g., MES, finite scheduling, sensing, performance management) and acts as a bridge between manufacturing SMEs and technical development teams.

This role is critical in ensuring that solutions are technically sound, compliant, and aligned to real manufacturing needs, while enabling scalable and reusable digital capabilities across the manufacturing network.

Key Responsibilities

1. Transition & Deployment Support (Startup Phase)

  • Support deployment of Amgen’s Technology and Workforce Strategy (TWFS) manufacturing capabilities at sites, including MES standardization, documentation automation, and performance management solutions

  • Participate in knowledge transfer (KT), onboarding, and stabilization activities to ensure successful transition to AIN-supported capabilities

  • Work with site SMEs to capture process knowledge, system requirements, and operational constraints

  • Identify and escalate risks related to process gaps, system readiness, or compliance considerations

2. Manufacturing Systems & Process Expertise

  • Provide deep subject matter expertise in one or more manufacturing domains, such as:

    • Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES / MBR design and lifecycle)

    • Finite scheduling and planning systems (e.g., PP/DS, S/4HANA)

    • Sensing, data integration, and digital control towers

    • Performance management and KPI frameworks

  • Translate manufacturing processes into structured system and data requirements

  • Define guardrails and design principles to guide solution development (e.g., what can be automated, standardized, or scaled)

  • Support evaluation of system impacts, dependencies, and integration requirements

3. Requirements Translation & Solution Development Support

  • Work closely with Sr Managers, Product Leads, and SMEs to translate business needs into detailed functional requirements

  • Partner with technical teams (AI/Data, UX/UI, engineering) to ensure solutions are aligned to manufacturing realities and constraints

  • Contribute to solution design, prototyping, and MVP development

  • Validate that proposed solutions are fit-for-purpose, scalable, and aligned to enterprise standards

4. GxP, Validation & Compliance Alignment

  • Assess whether solutions require GxP controls, validation, and documentation

  • Ensure requirements incorporate data integrity, auditability, and regulatory expectations

  • Partner with Quality and technical SMEs to ensure compliance-by-design in all solutions

  • Support preparation of validation inputs and documentation requirements where applicable

5. Innovation Lifecycle Execution (IVI Model)

  • Support use cases through the IVI lifecycle: intake → evaluation → MVP → pilot → scale

  • Contribute to business case inputs, including feasibility, constraints, and expected benefits

  • Participate in testing, user validation, and deployment activities

  • Support development of solutions designed for multi-site reuse and standardization

6. Stakeholder Collaboration & Integration

  • Collaborate with site SMEs, manufacturing leaders, and cross-functional partners

  • Act as a technical translator between manufacturing stakeholders and development teams

  • Ensure clear communication of requirements, assumptions, and constraints

  • Support structured engagement that balances speed of delivery with quality and compliance

Basic Qualifications

  • Doctorate/Master's /Bachelor's degree and 8 - 13 years of experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, manufacturing systems, or related technical roles

  • Demonstrated expertise in at least one domain:

  • MES / electronic batch records (e.g., Körber PAS-X or similar)

  • Finite scheduling / planning systems (e.g., SAP PP/DS, S/4HANA)

  • Manufacturing data systems, sensing, or digital dashboards

  • Manufacturing performance management and KPI frameworks

  • Strong understanding of GxP environments, validation concepts and data integrity principles

  • Experience translating manufacturing processes into system or digital requirements

  • Strong fluency in product management and modern delivery practices (roadmapping, prioritization, user-centered design, adoption at scale).

  • Ability to work effectively with technical teams (data engineers, developers, UX/UI) without being a coder

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and system-level thinking

  • Experience supporting system implementations, process improvements, or digital initiatives

  • Effective communication and collaboration skills in a cross-functional, global environment

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and contribute to fast-paced, iterative delivery models

Additional Information

  • Travel: as needed to support global stakeholder engagement (limited/periodic).

  • Work Style: global collaboration across time zones; strong partnering across sites, functions, and technology teams.

title: Centralized Leasing Specialist
description:
Centralized Leasing Specialist - Dallas, TX

Position Summary
The Centralized Leasing Specialist directly supporting high-priority leasing activity, the position serves as a portfolio-level leasing resource, using performance data, market intelligence, and independent judgment to recommend interventions and improve leasing results across assigned properties.
This role owns fast, consistent, human follow-up across the entire leasing funnel - leads, applicants, and renewals - with a relentless focus on urgency and conversion. The role is central to hitting pre-leased occupancy goals, particularly during renewal season and high-need leasing pushes.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead Management
  • Pull and review leads by property; identify any prospect not contacted in the past two days.
  • Execute timely outreach via call, email, and text, tailored to where the prospect is in their journey.
  • Review prior notes before each contact and log detailed, contextual notes after every interaction.
Application Follow-Up
  • Review activity notes to determine true application status (started, partially completed, pass, fail, pass with conditions, relet, approved).
  • Chase incomplete applications by contacting guarantors, emergency contacts, and potential roommates to move them forward.
  • Identify roommate gaps and follow up with all parties to close out groups.
Renewals
  • Work started, partially completed, and unsigned renewals; contact residents and guarantors directly.
  • Confirm rates and floor plan availability and communicate deadlines on pending renewal offers.
Platform Outreach
  • Conduct prospect outreach and maintain clean, well-managed conversation records.
  • Audit message history for quality and consistency, flagging gaps for property managers.
Tracking & Reporting
  • Log all conversations and notes in Entrata.
  • Track performance against the UP Leasing Performance Report.
  • Document market feedback (on-campus waitlist status, dorm capacity, communication preferences) and overall observations per site.
Prospect Feedback
  • Gather and analyze feedback from prospects and residents to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Translate feedback and key insights into actionable recommendations for corporate leadership and operational teams.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage prospect insights to strengthen the property’s value proposition and enhance the prospect experience.
Standards & Expectations
  • Maintain a high volume of meaningful daily activity - well above minimum call thresholds.
  • Treat every lead with equal urgency regardless of source.
  • Operate with an "all hands-on deck" mindset.
  • Prioritize tour follow-up, recognizing tours as the hottest leads.
  • Additional duties and tasks as assigned.
  • Follow Fair Housing standards and company policies in all interactions and documentation
Qualifications
  • Experience in leasing, sales, or customer-facing roles, preferably in student or multifamily housing.
  • At least one year of Leasing Consultant experience preferred.
  • Proficiency with Entrata and Bonfire (or comparable leasing/CRM platforms) strongly preferred.
  • Strong phone presence, written communication, and organizational skills.
  • High sense of urgency, self-motivation, and comfort working independently in a remote/centralized capacity.
  • Ability to interpret pipeline data and prioritize outreach accordingly.

Work Schedule & Location
  • This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position.
  • Employees work on-site Monday through Thursday at University Partners’ downtown Dallas office and remotely on Fridays.
  • Candidates must be available to work this required hybrid schedule.

Why Join University Partners
Join University Partners and build a rewarding career where your contributions matter, your growth is supported, and your work helps shape the future of student living.
As one of the nation’s leading owners and operators of student housing, we combine the stability of an established company with the opportunity and momentum of a growing organization.
Whether at one of our communities or on our corporate team, you’ll be empowered to grow, contribute new ideas, and make an impact alongside experienced, collaborative leaders.

title: Associate Dean, Collaborative Excellence
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview

The Associate Dean for Collaborative Excellence at Yale School of Medicine is responsible for managing the strategic deployment of resources and the coordination of activities across the Office of Collaborative Excellence (OCE) and engages with all YSM students, trainees, faculty, and staff. The incumbent will supervise a staff of three with the potential for future expansion. The incumbent will work in close partnership with the Associate Dean of Student Engagement and Development at GSAS, to ensure effective implementation of programming and alignment with the offices’ missions and visions.

The Associate Dean will develop and implement initiatives and programs that advance collaborative excellence within the Yale Combined Program in the Biological and Biomedical Sciences (BBS), a partnership between YSM, GSAS, and West Campus. These efforts will include recruitment and presentations at regional and national conferences, including professional association meetings. The incumbent will create professional and leadership development modules to support retention, foster belonging, and strengthen community. The associate dean will assist in data collection and evaluation for both OCE and BBS, using a combination of qualitative and quantitative methodologies.

SCHOOL OF MEDICINE OFFICE OF COLLABORATIVE EXCELLENCE PROGRAMS: 30%

Oversee the execution of initiatives and programs that impact the mission of the Office of Collaborative Excellence (OCE) across Yale School of Medicine (YSM).

Direct the strategic allocation and deployment of OCE resources.

Support dissemination of information across OCE, organize and set the agenda for team meetings, and organize the logistics when hiring new team members.

Supervise the three Clerical and Technical (C&T) staff within OCE (SHM location). Provide guidance and mentorship when needed to ensure staff can fulfill the mission of the office.

Represent the Deputy Dean for Collaborative Excellence at meetings with executive-level university leadership and among external audiences and stakeholders.

Partner proactively, strategically, and collaboratively with key stakeholders including student engagement groups, faculty engagement groups, employee resource groups, and other stakeholders across the School and University.

BBS PROGRAM RECRUITMENT, DEVELOPMENT AND EVALUATION RESPONSIBILITIES: 50%

Work in partnership with the Deputy Dean for Collaborative Excellence, BBS leadership (Director of BBS, Assistant Dean for the BBS Program, and Faculty Director of BBS Collaborative Excellence), and the Associate Dean for Student Engagement and Development at GSAS, to develop a strategic framework for recruitment, retention, and professional development that aligns with both the mission of OCE and the goals of GSAS and BBS.

Design and oversee the execution of initiatives for outreach, with the goal of recruiting students who have the credentials to matriculate into Yale’s BBS program and who will advance YSM’s Collaborative Excellence mission.

Develop and maintain strategic partnerships with minority-serving institutions (HBCUs, HSIs and Tribal Colleges), rural colleges and local universities and colleges.

Work in partnership with the OCE Deputy Dean, Director of BBS, Assistant Dean for the BBS Program, and Faculty Director for BBS Collaborative Excellence, to reevaluate the current mission, structure, and priorities of the Yale BBS Development and Involvement Community (YBDIC) to ensure strategic alignment with OCE, GSAS, and BBS missions, along with optimization of efficiency and use of resources.

In collaboration with the Faculty Director, co-advise and mentor YBDIC fellows and committee members. Oversee the stewardship of YBDIC’s budget and administrative support.

Participate as a member of the BBS Executive Committee. Provide updates on initiatives, program development, and outcomes data.

GRANT SUPPORT AND OUTCOMES EVALUATION 20%

Identify and apply for funding opportunities that align with the mission of OCE and YSM in collaboration with the BBS Program.

Develop quantitative and qualitative tools and metrics to evaluate initiatives and programs related to collaborative excellence, within OCE and BBS.

Collaborate with BBS leadership to advance training grant assessments Collect, analyze, and report on programmatic outcomes to capture BBS students’ experiences and perceptions of the quality of their training. Qualitative and quantitative methodologies may include surveys, focus groups, individual interviews, etc. (when appropriate and workflow allows).


Required Skills and Abilities

1. Demonstrated supervisory and employee relations experience which includes mentoring, sponsoring and training of staff and trainees.

2. Demonstrated program and new initiative development.

3. Management and evaluation experience for new and existing academic, career and networking programs.

4. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point, Outlook and other related software programs. Excellent oral, written and presentation skills.

5. Strong analytical, research and organizational skills with the ability to manage decision making for multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced work environment.

Preferred Skills and Abilities

1. PhD preferred. Experience running pathway programs.

Principal Responsibilities

1. Plays an essential role in advancing strategic and tactical priorities. 2. Takes a lead role in implementing new strategies. 3. Leads and manages major programs, committees or staff. 4. Represents the school on major University programs, committees and projects. 5. Takes on other duties as assigned and as needs of the school evolve over time. title: Quality Technician I (1st shift)
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Location/Division Specific Information

** On-site at our Prince George, VA facility. **

This role is to support a new factory in Prince George, VA (onsite) startup manufacturing large form-factor equipment. The product will be large (shipping container size), heavy (50+ tons), and complex. This position will be part of the core factory startup and onboarding team responsible for building the operations and manufacturing staff, fitting out the building, and creating the process flow/work instructions/etc. from the ground up. Skills to include panel and point to point wire assembly, Medium Voltage, Low Voltage, and High-Power Electronic assemblies.

How will you make an impact?

You will help build a culture of quality by performing inspections, identifying and containing issues before they reach the customer, and supporting the implementation and continuous improvement of quality controls. Through inspection, data analysis, problem-solving, and collaboration with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Quality teams, you will play a key role in supporting the successful launch and growth of a world-class manufacturing operation.

What will you do?

  • Perform in-process and final inspections of assemblies, components, and materials as required to support production and quality objectives.

  • Conduct visual, dimensional, and functional inspections using measuring and test equipment.

  • Verify products meet engineering drawings, specifications, work instructions, and quality standards.

  • Identify, document, and report nonconforming materials, processes, and products.

  • Support containment activities, nonconformance investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation.

  • Maintain accurate inspection records, quality documentation, and test data.

  • Partner with Production, Engineering, and Supply Chain teams to resolve quality concerns and drive continuous improvement.

  • Assist in developing and improving inspection procedures, quality plans, work instructions, and quality controls.

  • Support internal audits, process audits, and quality system activities as required.

  • Support factory startup activities, including process validation, training, and operational readiness.

  • Ensure compliance with all safety, quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.

How will you get here?

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

  • Associate degree or technical certification in Quality, Manufacturing, Electronics, Engineering Technology, or a related field preferred.

Experience

  • 0-2 Years experience in a Quality Technician, Quality Inspector, Quality Control, Manufacturing, or Quality Assurance role within a manufacturing environment.

  • Experience performing inspections in an industrial, electrical, electronics, or manufacturing setting.

  • Experience supporting large assemblies, industrial equipment, power systems, heavy manufacturing, or other complex manufacturing environments preferred.

  • Experience in a startup manufacturing environment is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, schematics, and technical specifications required.

  • Proficiency using inspection and measurement tools such as calipers, micrometers, tape measures, height gauges, and related inspection equipment.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify defects and nonconformances.

  • Strong communication, teamwork, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting electrical assemblies, panel assembly, wiring, electro-mechanical assemblies, or similar manufacturing environments.

  • Knowledge of ISO 9001 or similar quality management systems.

  • Familiarity with root cause analysis, corrective action methodologies, and continuous improvement tools.

  • Experience working with large fabricated, mechanical, electro-mechanical, or other large form-factor assemblies.

description:

Lead Firmware Test Automation Engineer

Location: Bengaluru, India
Business Unit: Intelligent Infrastructure

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Lead Firmware Test Automation Engineer to lead the automation and validation strategy for OpenBMC firmware across enterprise server and storage platforms. This role will be responsible for architecting scalable automation frameworks, establishing validation methodologies, driving CI/CD integration, and ensuring firmware quality throughout the product lifecycle.

The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in OpenBMC, firmware validation, Python automation, Robot Framework, server management technologies, and test infrastructure development. This position requires strong technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to drive automation transformation initiatives across multiple projects and customer programs.

How Will You Make an Impact?

As a Lead Firmware Test Automation Engineer, you will:

  • Define and drive automation strategies for OpenBMC validation activities.
  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable automation frameworks and validation infrastructure.
  • Improve firmware quality, reliability, and release efficiency through automation.
  • Drive technical decisions related to validation architecture, test coverage, and CI/CD integration.
  • Partner with firmware development teams to improve product quality and accelerate delivery.
  • Guide and mentor automation engineers while establishing engineering best practices.
  • Act as the technical lead for OpenBMC validation initiatives across multiple programs and customer engagements.

Key Responsibilities

Automation Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute the OpenBMC automation roadmap and validation strategy.
  • Lead automation architecture and framework development efforts.
  • Establish automation standards, coding guidelines, and validation best practices.
  • Drive automation adoption across firmware development and validation teams.
  • Mentor and guide engineers on automation technologies and validation methodologies.
  • Lead technical reviews and validation readiness assessments.

OpenBMC Validation & Quality Engineering

  • Lead validation activities for OpenBMC firmware and platform management features.
  • Develop and maintain validation plans, automation suites, and test strategies.
  • Ensure comprehensive validation coverage across:
    • Functional Testing
    • Regression Testing
    • Stress Testing
    • Performance Testing
    • Security Testing
    • Compliance Testing
    • Interoperability Testing
  • Drive defect triage, root-cause analysis, and issue resolution.
  • Support customer escalation analysis and field issue investigations.

Framework & Infrastructure Development

  • Develop and maintain enterprise-scale automation frameworks.
  • Create reusable automation libraries and test abstractions.
  • Develop infrastructure for:
    • Automated firmware deployment
    • Test execution orchestration
    • Platform provisioning
    • Log collection and analysis
    • Automated reporting and dashboards
  • Design and maintain validation lab infrastructure and test environments.

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

  • Integrate automated validation into firmware release pipelines.
  • Support continuous integration and continuous testing initiatives.
  • Improve automation execution efficiency, scalability, and reliability.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to optimize build and deployment workflows.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with firmware, hardware, platform architecture, and program teams.
  • Participate in requirements reviews and feature discussions.
  • Collaborate with OpenBMC developers to improve feature testability and quality.
  • Support project planning, effort estimation, and risk mitigation activities.
  • Partner with customers on validation requirements and quality objectives.

Technical Skills & Qualifications

Required Technical Expertise

  • Strong hands-on experience in OpenBMC validation, automation, and debugging.
  • Expert proficiency in Python and Robot Framework for test automation framework development.
  • Experience automating and validating Redfish, IPMI, PLDM, MCTP, and SPDM interfaces.
  • Strong understanding of OpenBMC architecture, including D-Bus, BMCWeb, Entity Manager, phosphor services, Virtual Media, Firmware Update, and User Management.
  • Experience validating OpenBMC platforms based on AST2500, AST2600, and AST2700 BMC SoCs.
  • Strong knowledge of server platform architecture, BIOS-BMC interaction, inventory management, sensor monitoring, power and thermal management.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux, shell scripting, networking, system services, and log analysis.
  • Experience with firmware validation including functional, regression, stress, performance, security, and interoperability testing.
  • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills for firmware, software, and hardware integration issues.

Automation & DevOps

  • Experience designing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with Jenkins, Git, GitHub/GitLab, Gerrit, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience developing automation for firmware deployment, provisioning, test execution, log collection, and reporting.
  • Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA .

Leadership Competencies

  • Ability to define validation strategies and automation roadmaps.
  • Proven experience leading automation initiatives and improving test coverage.
  • Strong planning, estimation, execution, and risk management skills.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and driving engineering best practices.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with OpenBMC upstream development or testing.
  • Experience supporting enterprise server, storage, or datacenter platforms.
  • Familiarity with containerized test environments and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience building reusable automation libraries and validation frameworks.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in firmware validation, automation, or embedded systems testing.
  • 5+ years of hands-on BMC/OpenBMC validation and automation experience.
  • Proven experience leading automation initiatives and validation programs.
  • Strong experience with enterprise server, storage, or datacenter platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
Who We Are:
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.

Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.

Powered by technology and a network of 1500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

Position Overview:

The Senior Program Manager is the dedicated leader responsible for the success of Fooda’s largest and most strategic client partnerships. This role owns the day-to-day operations across a portfolio of clients and locations, while playing a key role in strengthening the relationship, driving account growth, and ensuring an exceptional experience for clients and consumers.

This is a highly visible, hands-on role that blends operational oversight, stakeholder coordination, and data-driven decision-making. You’ll be accountable for execution across locations and driving value through strategic insights and collaboration. You won’t just manage the account; you’ll help shape its long-term success. This role will require onsite presence in Burlington, TX Monday-Friday.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Own the operational performance of your portfolio of locations.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for client needs, ensuring proactive communication, timely execution, and high satisfaction.
  • Coordinate, prepare, and organize Quarterly Business Reviews working closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment, share insights, and support long-term goals.
  • Analyze and track key operational and usage metrics to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities; use data to make informed decisions and present strategic recommendations.
  • Identify, support, and coordinate upsell and expansion opportunities within the client’s portfolio.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Restaurant Partnerships, and Market Operations to meet and exceed client expectations.
  • Manage hiring, training, and day-to-day oversight of any dedicated onsite support staff required at portfolio locations, ensuring consistent performance and alignment with Fooda standards.
  • Develop and improve processes that scale while achieving operational success.
  • Monitor and manage account-level financial health, including receivables and payables, and resolve issues promptly.
  • Available to work ONSITE daily, Monday-Friday.


Who You Are:

  • You have 4–6 years of experience in account management, operations, or multi-location client support ideally in a service, hospitality, or tech-enabled environment.
  • You’re a proactive relationship builder. You anticipate client needs and bring strategic value without waiting to be asked.
  • You’re highly data-driven, capable of pulling insights from usage reports, KPIs, and dashboards to inform operational decisions and account strategy.
  • You’re organized and detail-oriented, with proven ability to manage multiple locations, priorities, and timelines at once.
  • You have experience hiring, training, and managing staff, with a leadership style that’s supportive, clear, and accountability-driven.
  • You’re a strong communicator who can coordinate stakeholders, contribute to executive-facing meetings, and guide teams through change.
  • You’re a natural collaborator who thrives in cross-functional environments and understands how to get things done through influence and teamwork.
  • You’re comfortable in Excel and internal tools, and you use data to solve problems and drive improvements.

title: Deputy Chief Technology Officer, Infrastructure
description:
SteerBridge is a modern technology company delivering innovative, mission‑focused solutions to the U.S. Government and private sector. Leveraging deep expertise in federal acquisition, digital transformation, and emerging technologies, we deliver agile, commercial‑grade capabilities that accelerate operational effectiveness and drive measurable mission success.
At the core of SteerBridge is our people—especially the veterans whose leadership, problem‑solving mindset, and commitment to excellence elevate every project we support. We don’t simply hire exceptional talent; we cultivate it, creating meaningful career pathways for veterans, military spouses, and professionals who share our passion for advancing technology and strengthening the missions we serve.

Position Overview
SteerBridge Strategies is seeking a Deputy Chief Technology Officer (DCTO), Infrastructure to own the cloud architecture, security compliance, corporate network, and IT foundation that underpin SteerBridge's federal technology portfolio. This role sits at the center of the company's technical operations, providing the secure, scalable, and compliant infrastructure that SteerBridge's mission programs, including VA disability claims modernization, aviation readiness analytics, and federal fintech platforms, are built on, as well as the internal IT and security posture of the company itself.

The Deputy CTO, Infrastructure reports to the CTO and works alongside the other Deputy CTOs and Architecture Review Boards to ensure every program inherits a consistent, defensible security and cloud foundation. This person will represent SteerBridge to government security authorizing officials and internal leadership alike, translating infrastructure and compliance decisions into business and mission risk terms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cloud Architecture Leadership: Direct the design, governance, and continuous improvement of SteerBridge's cloud architecture across all program environments, ensuring consistent standards for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.

  • Security Compliance & Risk Management: Own the security compliance posture of SteerBridge's infrastructure, including RMF/ATO packages, continuous monitoring, and remediation of findings across all programs and corporate systems.

  • Corporate Network & IT Operations: Lead corporate network architecture and operations, including connectivity, segmentation, identity and access management, and endpoint protection for SteerBridge's internal IT environment.

  • Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a credible representative of SteerBridge's technical posture to government authorizing officials, auditors, and executive leadership, translating infrastructure and security decisions into mission and business risk terms.

  • Governance & Standards: Chair or participate in Architecture Review Boards and the Technical Risk Committee, ensuring infrastructure and security decisions across AICES, AIRES, SteerFi, and corporate IT remain aligned and auditable.

  • Program & People Leadership: Guide and mentor infrastructure, network, and security engineers; build career pathing and technical growth plans in partnership with SteerBridge's Career Ladder framework.

  • Vendor & Tooling Strategy: Evaluate and manage the vendor and tooling landscape for cloud, network, and security operations, ensuring cost-effective and compliant solutions across the company.

  • Cross-Program Coordination: Collaborate with program technical leads to identify, capture, and prioritize infrastructure and security requirements ahead of delivery milestones.

  • Delivery Management: Coordinate planning, sprint execution, and release management for infrastructure and security initiatives, and report progress, risks, and dependencies to executive leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud architecture, or security engineering, including at least 5 years supporting federal or highly regulated environments.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (required). Advanced degree preferred.

  • Proven ability to design and lead delivery of cloud-native infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting FedRAMP, RMF, and ATO requirements.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise network architecture, corporate IT operations, identity and access management, and endpoint security.

  • Strong command of NIST 800-53 controls, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and the federal Authority to Operate lifecycle.

  • Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional infrastructure, network, and security teams across multiple concurrent programs.

  • Exceptional communication, documentation, and executive stakeholder engagement skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

  • Experience with enterprise vulnerability scanning and compliance tooling (e.g., Tenable.SC/Nessus), SIEM platforms, and Zero Trust architecture.

  • Experience operating within VA Enterprise Cloud (VAEC), DoD IL4/IL5, or other federal accreditation boundaries.

  • Background managing security compliance across multiple concurrent ATO packages and program boundaries.

  • Familiarity with SOC operations, incident response planning, and corporate network segmentation strategy.

Benefits

  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with matching
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Federal Holidays

Job Description

About The Position

The Business Planning and Performance Execution team serves as a strategic partner to leaders across Ameren Utilities, helping translate strategy into execution. The team provides performance insights through scorecards, leads function- and segment-level strategic business planning efforts, coordinates complex cross-functional initiatives, and drives leader and coworker engagements that strengthen collaboration and alignment. As part of this team, the Performance and Engagement Analyst supports Ameren Utilities scorecard reporting, leader and coworker engagements, and strategy execution initiative tracking by compiling information, preparing analyses, coordinating activities, maintaining documentation, and supporting recurring processes.

The role performs defined assignments within established frameworks, identifies issues and trends, and escalates exceptions as appropriate. The position develops increasing independence and professional expertise while contributing to accurate reporting, effective engagements, and successful initiative execution.

Key responsibilities include:

Performance Management and Reporting

  • Compile, validate, and maintain KPI and scorecard data, investigating discrepancies and escalating unresolved data-quality issues.

Strategy Execution Initiatives

  • Gather and organize data, conduct standard analysis, and identify risks, issues, and dependencies for escalation.

  • Maintain assigned schedules, trackers, decision logs, action items, and supporting documentation.

  • Contribute to process improvements and special projects using established methods and guidance.

Qualifications - Performance & Engagement Analyst

Bachelor's degree required. Two or more years of relevant professional experience. Or advanced degree with 1 or more years of relevant professional experience. Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications required. Demonstrated experience preparing reports, analyzing data, coordinating meetings or projects, and managing multiple deadlines.

Qualifications - Senior Performance & Engagement Analyst

Bachelor's degree required. Five or more years of relevant professional experience. Or advanced degree with 3 or more years of relevant professional experience. Strong analytical, reporting, and communication skills. Demonstrated experience independently leading recurring performance-reporting processes or cross-functional initiatives.

In addition to the above qualifications, the successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Ability to organize, analyze, and interpret information accurately while completing defined assignments within established processes.

  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify discrepancies, trends, and issues requiring follow-up.

  • Ability to prepare clear reports, summaries, presentation materials, and supporting documentation.

  • Ability to collaborate productively with team members, metric owners, leaders, and other stakeholders.

  • Ability to coordinate activities, maintain accurate trackers and records, and meet multiple established deadlines.

  • Ability to apply established methods, identify practical process improvements, and escalate exceptions appropriately.

  • Ability to work independently on routine assignments while seeking guidance for new, complex, or unfamiliar work.

  • Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, adaptability, learning agility, and commitment to delivering high-quality work products.

Additional Information

This role requires in person participation, including supporting and participating in meetings and strategic engagements in the AHQ St. Louis and Collinsville, IL offices on a frequent basis.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Salary range: 80-100,000€


Applications will only be considered from candidates who are currently residing in Ireland.


About the job

If you want to shape the future of energy, we are looking for two Full Stack Software Engineer to join our DR Platforms Software Engineering team at Enel X. In this role you will design, build, and deliver end-to-end features across the full technology stack, from responsive user interfaces in TypeScript to scalable backend services using Node.js, all running on AWS.


You will own components from conception through to production, work closely with product and business stakeholders, and help maintain high standards of code quality in a Scrum environment. This is a genuinely balanced full-stack position with strong emphasis on both frontend and backend development using TypeScript across the stack.


We are a global leader in Demand Response and flexibility services, building the real-time platforms that help grids accommodate more renewables. Our work spans intelligent demand optimization, distributed energy resources, and smart electric mobility — giving engineers the opportunity to build technology that directly accelerates the energy transition.


If you enjoy building scalable, modern applications with real impact on sustainability and want to work in a collaborative international team, we’d love to hear from you.


What you will do

  • Design and develop responsive frontend applications using TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and a modern JavaScript framework (React, Angular or Vue)

  • Build and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js and TypeScript, ensuring clean architecture, performance and scalability

  • Integrate frontend interfaces with backend services and AWS cloud components (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, etc.)

  • Own features and services from initial design through to production deployment and ongoing support

  • Write well-documented, tested, and maintainable code following agreed architectural standards

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver business value

  • Contribute ideas for new features and proactively identify technical improvements

  • Mentor and support less experienced team members where appropriate

  • Ensure high code quality through reviews and monitoring of automated analysis tools


What you will bring

  • BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or comparable area

  • 6-10 years of professional software development experience with a strong, balanced track record in both frontend and backend development using TypeScript (ideally around 8 years)

  • Strong hands‑on experience building backend services and RESTful APIs with Node.js and TypeScript

  • Strong proficiency in frontend development with TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and at least one modern JavaScript framework (Angular, React or Vue)

  • Solid experience working with AWS cloud services (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EC2, RDS, Kinesis, S3)

  • Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing

  • Proven ability to work effectively in Scrum/Agile teams, collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to document technical decisions clearly and explain concepts to different audiences

  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly as the platform evolves

  • Experience working with a variety of development patterns, technologies, platform stacks

  • Understanding of the Microservice Architecture

  • Experience running and administering applications on Amazon Web Services

  • Relational, NoSQL database exposure and graph databases (e.g. Neo4j, RedisGraph, etc.)

  • Experience working in an agile environment (Scrum, Kanban, etc.)

  • Experience in API Documentation tools (like Swagger)


Life at Enel

  • Employee Support: Health & Life insurance, Employee Assistance Program and Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Policy

  • Future Planning: Pension Scheme contribution up to 4% company match

  • Learning: Up to 1,500€ training & development allowance and access to internal development initiatives

  • Wellness & Culture: 25 days’ annual leave, (increasing with length of service), flexible working policy and social events


Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and the Selection Process

This opportunity is open to everyone. We value the \"uniqueness\" of each individual because we believe that different perspectives, diverse experiences, and viewpoints are key drivers of innovation.


At Enel X, we regard diversity, equity, and inclusion as pillars of our culture, inspiring open, dynamic, and collaborative workplaces that foster a genuine sense of belonging. These principles are integrated into every stage of people management, including the selection process, which is tailored for each role to recognize and enhance the talents, skills, and experiences of every candidate. We are looking for individuals who embody our values: trust, respect, innovation, proactivity, and flexibility.


The selection process usually starts with an introductory interview with our Talent Acquisition team, followed by a technical interview and/or assessment with the hiring team. In most cases, the process includes 2-3 interview stages, designed to give you and the team a better mutual understanding. If your profile matches the requirements of the role, we’ll be in touch to share all the details of the next steps.


Who we are

Enel X is the Group’s arm dedicated to customers around the world with the aim of effectively providing products and services based on their energy needs and encouraging them towards a more conscious and sustainable use of energy. It provides electricity, gas and integrated services to more than 29 million customers globally including households, enterprises, industries and public administrations. In addition, it offers flexibility services aggregating 10.2 GW and has over 34,000 owned public charging points for electric mobility.


You can find out more about us here.


This announcement is addressed to all individuals in line with Enel’s commitment to equity and inclusion, with particular attention to promoting gender equality. #LI-MB1

  • To jointly assess the architectural impact of new business requirements across processes, integrations, data models, applications, and the broader enterprise landscape, and to co-design scalable, supportable solutions that align with strategic architecture direction and standards.
  • To collaborate with product teams on design changes to existing configurations to ensure continued uninterrupted operations.
  • To evaluate custom solutions within the SAP ERP landscape to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles and SAP best practices.

  • To provide architecture support such as troubleshooting complex performance issues.
