title: Software Engineer II - Mobile App Development , Devops Engineer
description:
At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

About the Role

A Day in the Life

Our Global Diabetes Capability Center in Pune is expanding to serve more people living with diabetes globally. Our state-of-the-art facility is dedicated to transforming diabetes management through innovative solutions and Technologies that reduce the burden of living with diabetes.

This position is an exciting opportunity to work with Minimed’s Diabetes business. Medtronic has announced its intention to separate the Diabetes division to promote future growth and innovation within the business and reallocate investments and resources across Medtronic, subject to applicable information and consultation requirements. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investments to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care.

#BetterDaysStartNow

We are seeking a talented Tools & Automation Software Engineer to develop and maintain software tools, automation frameworks, and CI/CD platforms that accelerate the development of next-generation embedded medical devices. This role focuses on improving engineering productivity, software quality, test automation, compliance, and release efficiency within a regulated environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop tools and automation solutions that support the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Build and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines for embedded firmware, cloud, and application software.
  • Automate software build, test, validation, release, and compliance workflows.
  • Integrate automated testing frameworks, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments.
  • Develop solutions that improve traceability between requirements, source code, testing, and releases.
  • Implement automated quality gates, static analysis, security scanning, and compliance reporting.
  • Support development and test infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, etc.).
  • Create dashboards and metrics that provide visibility into software quality, testing, and pipeline performance.
  • Evaluate and apply AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows to improve productivity and efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, developer tools, test automation, or CI/CD.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, C, C++, JS and scripting for automation.
  • Experience with Git, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Linux-based development environments and container technologies such as Docker.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation).
  • Strong troubleshooting, collaboration, and technical communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in regulated industries such as Medical Devices, Aerospace, or Automotive.
  • Familiarity with IEC 62304, FDA software lifecycle processes, and compliance automation.
  • Experience with embedded software development, ARM-based microcontrollers, and cross-compilation toolchains.
  • Experience integrating SIL, HIL, simulators, and emulators into automated test environments.
  • Knowledge of static analysis, MISRA compliance, cybersecurity scanning, and quality engineering tools.
  • Exposure to AI technologies, including Generative AI, RAG, MCP, AI agents, or AI-assisted software development tools.

What You'll Bring

A passion for automation, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement, with the ability to develop innovative solutions that enhance product quality, accelerate development, and support the delivery of safe, reliable medical devices.

TECHNICAL SPECIALIST CAREER STREAM:

An individual contributor with responsibility in our technical functions to advance existing technology or introduce new technology and therapies. Formulates, delivers and/or manages projects assigned and works with other stakeholders to achieve desired results. May act as a mentor to colleagues or may direct the work of other lower level professionals. The majority of time is spent delivering R&D, systems or initiatives related to new technologies or therapies – from design to implementation - while adhering to policies, using specialized knowledge and skills.

DIFFERENTIATING FACTORS

Autonomy: Established and productive individual contributor. Works independently with general supervision on larger, moderately complex projects / assignments.

Organizational Impact: Sets objectives for own job area to meet the objectives of projects and assignments. Contributes to the completion of project milestones. May have some involvement in cross functional assignments.

Innovation and Complexity: Problems and issues faced are general, and may require understanding of broader set of issues or other job areas but typically are not complex. Makes adjustments or recommends enhancements in systems and processes to solve problems or improve effectiveness of job area.

Communication and Influence: Communicates primarily and frequently with internal contacts. External interactions are less complex or problem solving in nature. Contacts others to share information, status, needs and issues in order to inform, gain input, and support decision-making.

Leadership and Talent Management: May provide guidance and assistance to entry level professionals and / or employee in Support Career Stream.

Required Knowledge and Experience: Requires practical knowledge and demonstrated competence within job area typically obtained through advanced education combined with experience. Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)( 4)(iii)(A) and minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with 0 years of experience.

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.


Benefits & Compensation


MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package

At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.



About MiniMed

We want to make every day a better day for people living with diabetes. Our team of creative innovators around the globe share a passion for finding the simplest solutions to the problems that people with diabetes face on a daily basis. For more than 40 years, we've been redefining what's possible, from intelligent dosing systems designed for real life to predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and we're dedicated to continuing to support our customers through every step of their journey — meeting them where and how they need it.

Job Description Summary

The Senior Data Engineer is responsible for the design, architecture and support of systems, services and applications required for the collection, storage, processing, and analysis of all forms of data to enable data-driven decisions and outcomes across the enterprise.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Work collaboratively with other engineers, data scientists, analytics teams, and business product owners in an agile environment.
  • Architect, build, and support the operation of Cloud and On-Premises enterprise data infrastructure and tools.
  • Design robust, reusable, and scalable data driven solutions and data pipeline frameworks to automate the ingestion, processing and delivery of both structured and unstructured batch and real-time streaming data.
  • Build data APIs and data delivery services to support critical operational processes, analytical models and machine learning applications.
  • Assist in selection and integration of data related tools, frameworks, and applications required to expand platform capabilities.
  • Understand and implement best practices in management of enterprise data, including master data, reference data, metadata, data quality and lineage.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, math, engineering, or relevant technical field
  • Four years of collective experience in the application of data engineering, data analytics, data warehousing, business intelligence, database administration, and data integration concepts and methodologies
  • Three years of experience architecting, building, and administering big data and real-time streaming analytics architectures in on-premises and cloud environments
  • Two years of experience architecting, building, and administering large-scale distributed applications
  • Two years of experience with Linux operations and development, including basic commands and shell scripting
  • Two years of experience with execution of DevOps methodologies and continuous integration/continuous delivery
  • Expertise in SQL for data profiling, analysis, and extraction
  • Familiarity with data science techniques and frameworks
  • Creative thinker with strong analytical skills
  • Results oriented with a strong customer focus
  • Ability to work in a team environment
  • Strong technical communication skills
  • Ability to prioritize work to meet tight deadlines
  • Ability to learn and keep pace with the latest technology advances and quickly grasp new technologies to support the environment and contribute to project deliverables


Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in a technical field (e.g. computer science, math, engineering)
  • Solid understanding of big data and real time streaming analytics processing architecture and ecosystems
  • Practical experience with data warehousing architecture and implementation, including hands on experience with source to target mappings and developing ETL code
  • Experience with advanced analytics and machine learning concepts and technology implementations
  • Experience with data analysis and using data visualization tools to describe data
  • Relevant technology or platform certification (AWS, Microsoft, etc.)
  • Software development experience in relevant programming languages (i.e. Java, Python, Scala, Node.js)

The Senior Health Economics Analyst is responsible for identifying and delivering data-driven insights and analytical support to executive leadership of ChenMed. Success in the role will be achieved through the ability to leverage data and analytic skills to create business intelligence—identifying risks to be mitigated or opportunities to be seized. The incumbent serves as the primary medical cost analytics consultant to our Finance, Clinical, Operations, and Specialty Care leadership and will make data-driven strategy recommendations in the Medicare Advantage and healthcare industry. This senior-level analyst position has the opportunity for impact and advancement within the Finance organization and the broader enterprise.

​ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Analyzes and interpret enrollment, revenue, and claims (utilization and unit cost) data to identify and solve business problems and continuously improve data-driven strategies and processes to improve financial results.
  • Partners with finance and business leaders to create benchmarks to monitor medical cost trends and variances. Assists in the design and evaluation of company KPIs for potential replacement or evolution as the company grows.

  • Tracks performance of medical cost Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for assigned Divisions/Departments.
  • Leverages data analytics and modeling to test, validate and track return of investment of existing and proposed medical cost strategies and initiatives.
  • Works with Analytics and IT teams to validate data, enhance medical cost reports and tools, and help design new products for enterprise consumption.
  • Builds strong and trusting relationships with leaders to support problem resolution and ensure overall awareness of medical cost issues and challenges.
  • Supports finance in the annual and multi-year planning process including development of medical cost targets, key metrics, and projections.
  • Analyzes emerging medical cost results and forecast the impact of those results on future periods (including identification and execution of actions to improve those results).
  • Prepares ad-hoc analysis for claims and KPIs of medical costs for executive leadership
  • Develops a deep understanding of the economic impact of the components, drivers, and indicators of the ChenMed core model and external factors.
  • Performs other duties as assigned and modified at manager’s discretion.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, critical-thinking, communication, and relationship skills
  • Effective organization skills with the ability to work in a very fast-paced, team-oriented environment with minimal supervision
  • Ability to interpret the needs of the organization and communicate actionable insights through analytics
  • Ability to develop presentations to drive action/impact
  • Ability to model financial concepts of ROI, IRR, etc.
  • Strong financial acumen, problem-solving and analytical skills with keen attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to analyze multiple data sources to develop deep understanding of market dynamics, identify and prioritize opportunities, and spot trends
  • Extensive knowledge of healthcare/medical economics data such as hospital/physician /ASC claims, utilization data, and healthcare industry coding systems ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, Revenue Codes, MS/APR-DRGs and APCs
  • Excellent communication skills across verbal, written, and presentation applications (Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, etc)
  • Experience with PowerBI, Qlikview & SQL preferred
  • Spoken and written fluency in English
  • This job requires use and exercise of independent judgment

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE CRITERIA:

  • Bachelor’s degree: experience may substitute for education on a year-for-year basis above the minimum experience required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Data Analytics or Economics and/or MBA preferred
  • Minimum of four (4) years of related experience

description:
CSL is looking for a Head of International Communications to lead strategic communications for its Commercial & Medical International business — a $13 billion operation spanning 39 countries and five regions, treating roughly 19 million patients with therapies for haemophilia, hereditary angioedema, and other rare and complex conditions. This is a senior communications leadership role, reporting to the Head of Global Communications, CSL Behring, Vifor and Plasma and serving as the direct communications partner to the SVP of International, with oversight of a team of five.

Hybrid based (3 days a week) from our UK office in Maidenhead, with Switzerland and Germany other potential locations

Why It Matters

CSL holds the leading global position, and much of that position depends on trust — from regulators, from healthcare systems, from the employees and affiliate markets who carry the strategy into 39 different countries. This role sits at the point where business strategy becomes communication: shaping how leadership is understood internally, how the company responds when issues get complicated, and how a genuinely global organisation holds a coherent identity across very different markets. It's a role for someone who sees communications as a strategic function, not a support one.

What You'll Be Responsible For

The role covers the full range of strategic communications for the International Region — from executive counsel to crisis response to the internal narrative that keeps a dispersed organisation aligned. Specifically, you'll:

  • Lead development and execution of the International communications strategy, aligned with CSL's global priorities
  • Advise the International Leadership Team and senior executives, including messaging, speeches, and leadership positioning
  • Lead communications planning and response for significant business, regulatory, and reputational issues
  • Own the International internal communications strategy, including employee engagement platforms and leadership forums
  • Provide communications leadership for key brands and therapeutic areas across international markets
  • Build and lead a communications team, and establish standards and governance across international markets

Experience Required

  • 15+ years of communications experience, including corporate, executive, and issues management
  • Experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or a similarly regulated industry
  • Demonstrated experience advising senior executives and leadership teams
  • Experience leading communications programs in a global or multinational environment
  • Track record managing complex, sensitive, or high-profile communications issues
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with fluency in English required

Note on Travel

Approximately 15% travel, predominantly pan-European.

About CSL Seqirus

CSL Seqirus is part of CSL. As one of the largest influenza vaccine providers in the world, CSL Seqirus is a major contributor to the prevention of influenza globally and a transcontinental partner in pandemic preparedness. With state-of-the-art production facilities in the U.S., the U.K. and Australia, CSL Seqirus utilizes egg, cell and adjuvant technologies to offer a broad portfolio of differentiated influenza vaccines in more than 20 countries around the world.

title: Director, Talent Management (Leadership, Learning & Growth)
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Job Summary

The Director, Leadership, Learning & Growth leads Jabil’s leadership development strategy and creates a connected development experience across leader levels. This role defines the capabilities and experiences leaders need as they grow and ensures development solutions build intentionally from one level to the next.

Leading the Leadership, Learning & Growth COE, this role owns the design and effectiveness of the leadership development portfolio—strengthening what works, simplifying or stopping what does not, and ensuring investments have a clear purpose and measurable value. The Director also brings a future-focused perspective on AI, technology, skills, and new approaches to learning that make development more relevant, personalized, and scalable.

Location

This role will be based on-site at our St. Petersburg, FL Corporate Headquarters.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Leadership Development Strategy & Portfolio

  • Define the leadership development strategy and framework across leader levels, creating clear pathways that build capability as leaders grow.

  • Manage the development portfolio as a whole, ensuring each program has a clear purpose, audience, and connection to business and talent needs.

  • Identify gaps, overlap, and opportunities to simplify, combine, scale, or stop programs based on value and impact.

  • Connect leadership development to Talent Reviews, Succession, Skills, Assessments, and other Talent priorities.

  • Identify external market learning trends, compare them to internal development programs and results, and provide data-driven insights to the Talent Management team.

Learning Solutions & Effectiveness

  • Lead the design and evolution of leadership and learning solutions, setting standards for instructional design, learning experience, and application on the job.

  • Define clear outcomes and measures for programs and use data, feedback, and talent insights to understand what is working.

  • Articulate the value and impact of development investments and use evidence to guide future decisions.

  • Partner with Talent Partners to turn recurring business and capability needs into scalable development solutions.

Future of Learning

  • Stay ahead of changes in leadership, work, technology, and learning and translate them into practical changes to Jabil’s development approach.

  • Evolve the learning model as AI changes how employees access content, build skills, practice, and receive support.

  • Evaluate emerging learning technologies, AI-enabled tools, content, and partners based on the value they create.

  • Lead the learning portion of AI enablement, partnering across the business and managing relationships with external vendors to build practical learning experiences that help leaders and employees understand, adopt, and apply AI responsibly.

  • Expand personalized, skills-based, and on-demand approaches that improve relevance and scale.

Team & COE Leadership

  • Lead and develop the Leadership, Learning & Growth team and build strong expertise in leadership development and learning design.

  • Lead the strategy for external learning partners, content providers, facilitators, and development resources.

  • Partner with Talent Strategy & Operations to create common ways of working across communications, nominations, reporting, measurement, and delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Learning & Development, Organizational Development, Psychology, Business, or a related field.

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Leadership Development, Learning & Development, Talent Management, Organizational Development, or related disciplines.

  • Experience designing and leading leadership development strategies and portfolios in a complex, global organization.

  • Experience leading teams/people management and working across multiple businesses, functions, or geographies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree preferred.

  • Experience leading global learning or leadership development teams.

  • Experience implementing AI-enabled, skills-based, or personalized learning approaches.

  • Experience leading learning strategies, enablement programs, or adoption efforts that support enterprise AI deployment.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Strong expertise in instructional design, adult learning, leadership development, and learning effectiveness.

  • Demonstrated ability to use data and outcomes to evaluate programs, communicate value, and make portfolio investment decisions.

  • Strong understanding of emerging learning technologies, AI, and evolving approaches to workforce development.

  • Strong leadership, communication, influencing, and vendor-management skills.

title: Head Miller II
description:
Job Title: Head Miller II

Role Overview:

The Head Miller II is responsible for leading operations at high complexity milling facilities that handle multiple wheat classes, oats and produce a broad portfolio of base and specialty flours. In most cases, the Head Miller II leads milling operations independently, without additional managerial support from a Senior Head Miller or Head Miller. You will oversee the full scope of milling operations—including production, maintenance, sanitation, and team development—while upholding Ardent Mills’ standards for safety, quality, and efficiency. You will be a key driver of continuous improvement and operational excellence, ensuring compliance with company policies and fostering a high-performance culture. As a visible leader, you will play a critical role in positioning Ardent Mills as the flour supplier of choice in your region.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operational Management: Identify and resolve operational discrepancies, implementing focused solutions with clear timelines.
  • Process Improvement: Collaborate with the milling team to enhance production efficiency, reduce costs, and improve product quality.
  • Maintenance Oversight: Develop and execute maintenance plans to ensure optimal operation of milling equipment and identify critical spare parts.
  • Training & Development: Partner with the Milling Center of Excellence (COE) to create effective training programs for millers and interns, fostering skill development across the workforce.
  • Project Leadership: Act as project manager for capital improvements and lead larger-scale projects in collaboration with the engineering team.
  • Performance Metrics: Utilize key performance metrics to benchmark and drive operational improvements.
  • Safety & Compliance: Maintain compliance with company policies, regulatory standards, and safety protocols, ensuring a clean and safe work environment.

Essential Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 5-8 years of milling and leadership experience, or a high school diploma/GED with 10-12 years in similar roles, or relevant experience in similar roles.
  • Advanced expertise in equipment maintenance and troubleshooting.
  • Proven ability to implement LEAN practices in complex, high-volume environments.
  • Mastery of cleaning, milling, and conveying systems, with advanced pneumatic system knowledge.
  • Extensive proficiency in CMMS and CAD software for detailed system designs.
  • Strong track record of leading process improvement initiatives and training programs.
  • Proven experience in successfully leading mid-scale capital projects, effectively managing associated contractors while operating with minimal on-site engineering support.

This job description outlines the primary responsibilities and qualifications for the Head Miller role at Ardent Mills. Duties and requirements may evolve based on the organization's needs.

Physical requirements and working conditions (with or without reasonable accommodation):

  • Ability to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) as is required by the operating areas (i.e. safety glasses, protective footwear, hearing protection and, at times, a respirator)
  • Ability to work a rotating schedule including nights, weekends and holidays
  • Ability to work a machine paced continuous process that operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with conditions which include:
  • Heat/cold temperatures (inclement weather)
  • Indoor/outdoor environment
  • Dusty environment
  • Noisy environment
  • Frequent moving/vibration/ or other motion of equipment/processes
  • Elevated places, to include stairs/ladders
  • Ability to perform work at a computer and other administrative/managerial tasks

Other considerations:

  • Ability to travel 5-10%
  • Willing to relocate as promotional opportunities exist throughout career
  • Willing to work weekends, holidays, 7-day weeks, and opposing shifts, when needed
  • Must be authorized to work in Canada

Except where prohibited by law, all offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a pre-employment background check

Team members must be clean-shaven in order to perform tasks where respiratory protection is required and the use of a respirator (including N-95 dust mask) requires a proper seal for adequate protection.

title: Inventory Associate - Auditor
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Inventory Associate - Auditor is a full-time position responsible for maintaining accurate and compliant records of all cannabis plant materials and products. As a certified agent for the state's track-and-trace system, this role ensures the seamless movement, labeling, and reporting of cannabis inventory from propagation through post-harvest. This position demands high attention to detail, strong organizational and problem-solving skills, and an understanding of cultivation workflows. The Inventory Specialist reports to the Inventory Manager and works cross-functionally with cultivation, processing, and compliance teams.

Schedule: 6:00 am - 4:30 pm, Monday - Thursday

Pay: $20.87/hour

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Conduct daily, weekly, and monthly audits of inventory to ensure full traceability and accuracy between physical counts and compliance software records
  • Monitor and troubleshoot discrepancies in inventory data and escalate as needed
  • Verify product counts for supply chain management
  • Maintain accurate inventory to include verifying physical counts

OTHER JOB RESPONSIBILITES

  • Assist leadership in maintaining inventory compliance during internal and external audits
  • Record inventory totals and movements in the state's track-and-trace system (e.g., Metrc) and internal inventory software
  • Create digital inventory batches, assign package tags, and ensure documentation is accurate and timely
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant work environment
  • Participate in ongoing training and compliance initiatives
  • Perform other duties as assigned

MINIMUM JOB REQUIEMENTS

  • Must be at least 21 years of age
  • Must obtain and maintain a valid Registered Agent Card issued by the state
  • Strong math skills reconciliation skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast paced, highly regulated environment
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

PREFERED JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Proficiency using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word
  • Prior experience using cannabis compliance tracking software (e.g., Metric, Biotrack, etc.)
  • Experience working in a highly regulated industry with SOP adherence
  • Ability to effectively and efficiently track, analyze, and troubleshoot digital batch and product movement records

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Ascend Wellness Holdings (AWH) is a vertically integrated cannabis cultivator, processor and provisioning center operator with assets in Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, Ohio and Pennsylvania. We seek to foster a robust and inclusive cannabis industry through a premium, unmatched customer-focused retail experience. We are looking to build a world-class team that will help carry out our mission of helping to shape the future of cannabis as a leading healthcare solution. We are committed to improving the quality of our patients’ lives by offering unrivaled quality, consistency and meticulously curated products that satisfy our customers’ unique, individual needs. A team that is committed to our values, our people, and our communities; we are looking for people who are inspired by our vision and stay dedicated to our mission as we continuously expand.

title: Director, Talent Management (BU & Function)
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Job Summary

The Director, BU & Function Talent Partner leads Talent Management across Jabil’s global Business Units and enterprise Functions, including IT, Legal, HR, Communications, Supply Chain, and Finance. The role works with leaders and HR to identify the talent issues that matter most, put clear actions against them, and show measurable progress.

Leading a team of Talent Partners, this role connects talent across BUs and Functions—helping leaders build stronger succession pipelines, move talent across the company, close capability gaps, and turn development needs into action. The Director also brings these individual views together so leadership can see the biggest talent risks and opportunities across the portfolio.

Location

This role will be based on-site at our St. Petersburg, FL Corporate Headquarters.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Business & Function Talent

  • Partner with senior leaders and HR to identify the most important talent, succession, and capability issues and agree on what needs to change.

  • Turn those issues into specific actions, owners, measures, and next steps, and drive progress against them.

  • Use Talent Reviews, Succession Planning, Assessments, Development, Skills, Internal Mobility, and hiring to address business talent needs.

  • Provide clear visibility to what is improving, what is at risk, and where leadership action is needed.

Talent Pipelines & Movement

  • Strengthen succession pipelines for critical roles and turn succession plans into meaningful development actions and experiences.

  • Identify opportunities to move talent across BUs and Functions, creating broader talent slates and development opportunities across the company.

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR Business Partner teams to identify internal candidates and strengthen visibility to talent across the organization.

  • Identify common capability gaps and connect them to development, experience, skills, or hiring solutions.

  • Identify talent trends in the external market, compare them to internal talent trends, and provide data-driven insights to BU and Function HR Business Partners to continuously improve talent gaps.

  • Advise and lead on learning program needs as they arise, partnering with the L&D team and HR Business Partners to offer practical solutions for BUs and Functions.

  • Partner with Talent COEs to bring broader solutions to needs shared across multiple businesses or functions.

Portfolio & Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop the Talent Partners supporting BUs and Functions and set clear expectations for strong Talent Partnership.

  • Bring individual BU and Function views together to highlight the biggest talent risks, actions, and opportunities across the portfolio.

  • Identify talent and development opportunities that may not be visible when organizations are viewed independently.

  • Focus leadership attention on the decisions that require sponsorship, talent movement, investment, or removal of barriers.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business, Psychology, or a related field.

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Talent Management, Leadership Development, Organizational Development, HR Business Partnering, or a related HR discipline.

  • Experience partnering with senior and executive leaders in a complex, global, matrixed organization.

  • Experience leading teams/people management and working across multiple businesses, functions, or geographies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree preferred.

  • Experience supporting global Business Units or enterprise Functions.

  • Experience with executive talent, leadership assessment, and development.

  • Experience working within a manufacturing culture.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • Demonstrated expertise in succession planning, talent management, leadership development, internal mobility, and organizational effectiveness.

  • Strong ability to use talent data and insights to identify issues, recommend actions, and measure progress.

  • Strong consulting, influencing, facilitation, communication, and relationship management skills.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Come Join Cisco Software Solutions

Cisco Software Solutions (CSS) is the software development arm of Cisco's Collaboration platform organization (CCPS). We develop and maintain the platforms and related tools required for our products and the people who operate them to shine.

Our World is a mix of old and new - a new unified platform to replace our various legacy platforms, old tools at all points in lifecycle, new tools to differentiate and enhance our platform offering. It is messy in places, sometimes because parts are so new, sometimes because parts are so old.

We are forming a new team that will help drive consistency, reliability and observability across that World.

You should join!

Who You’ll Work With

We are a distributed and diverse team of developers with an operational mindset, united under the charter to make running virtualized and containerized workloads easy and frictionless for our tenants, and to make the platforms that do that easy and frictionless to manage for our operators.

Who You Are

You are an experienced developer who also is familiar with operations. You have worked on data centre and cloud infrastructure, tools and services at scale. You understand that software is for people, and are here to help.

What You’ll Do

As a member of our new tools team, you’ll work with the rest of the organization to mature our World. That includes everything from lifecycle automation through to observability and other operability improvements, through to unifying or even retiring tools, through to building new tenant or operator facing functionality.

Agentic AI tool use will play a significant part in your day to day.

Minimum Requirements

In the interest of saving everyone time, this role does have some minimum requirements to apply:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

  • 7+ years

  • 1+ years of experience working with a public or private cloud such as AWS, Azure, GCP, OpenStack or OpenShift

  • 1+ years of experience working with Docker and/or virtualization

  • 1+ years of experience working with CI/CD or DevOps systems

Preferred Requirements

This role could be a good fit for you if you bring experience with some of:

  • Agentic AI development tools e.g. Claude CLI, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode

  • Programming languages such as Python, Golang, Java, Javascript or Typescript

  • Lifecycle / deployment tools such as Ansible or Terraform

  • Network administration

  • Linux administration (especially Linux networking)

  • Design, implementation and operation of distributed software

  • Infrastructure or service operations at scale

  • HTTP, REST, the DOM

  • Virtualization technologies

  • Containerization technologies e.g. Docker

  • Management and operations of the OpenStack or Kubernetes platforms

  • Infrastructure management tools such as Intersight and UCS Manager

This role could be a great fit for you if you also bring a growth mindset and the desire to do what's best for your team.

Let's make CSS excellent together.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale, because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The Business Planning and Performance Execution team serves as a strategic partner to leaders across Ameren Utilities, helping translate strategy into execution. This role strengthens the integration of business planning and performance management and helps leadership understand performance trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. The role independently leads assigned processes, workstreams, and initiatives; analyzes complex business issues; develops recommendations; and partners with stakeholders to improve performance and execution. Work is performed independently with review at critical points and requires sound judgment, adaptability, and effective communication with leaders and business partners.

Business Planning and Execution

  • Support leadership decision-making through clear, concise analysis and recommendations.

  • Develop execution strategies for assigned areas that translate organizational priorities into coordinated actions, clear accountabilities, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders, interdependencies, and competing priorities; structure the work, evaluate options, and drive issues to resolution or escalation.

  • Conduct research and analysis to support business recommendations and implementation planning.

Bachelor's degree required. Five or more years of relevant professional experience. Or advanced degree with 3 or more years of relevant professional experience. Strong analytical, reporting, and communication skills. Demonstrated experience independently leading complex cross-functional workstreams, synthesizing information for senior leaders, and developing recommendations that influence business decisions.   • Ability to provide workstream direction, quality review, and coaching to analysts contributing to assigned efforts.

  • Demonstrated sound judgment, executive communication, adaptability, and initiative in resolving issues and escalating significant risks or decisions.

This role requires in person participation, including leading cross-functional planning and leadership-review sessions in the AHQ St. Louis and Collinsville, IL offices on a frequent basis.

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

SENIOR ASSOCIATE, WAREHOUSE PLANNING & MASTER DATA

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will support planning and operational readiness for the ANC Warehouse by providing rigorous capacity modeling, external warehouse planning, and master data management. You will help the organization make timely, data-driven decisions that enable safe, compliant, and reliable material availability for manufacturing and patients.

The Senior Associate, Warehouse Planning & Master Data reports to the Senior Manager of the ANC Warehouse organization within Supply Chain. This role is accountable for developing and maintaining warehouse capacity models including logistics across other Amgen warehouses, planning local external warehouse requirements, and managing warehouse-related master data to enable accurate planning and execution.

The successful candidate will work closely with Planning, Warehouse Leadership, Procurement, Site Industrial Engineering, Global Master Data, and AIN teams. The role requires strong analytical discipline, collaboration, and a curiosity for learning and applying AI-enabled tools to simplify modeling, improve data quality, and reduce manual work.

Drive Warehouse Capacity and External Warehouse Planning

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve warehouse capacity models across relevant storage types, material flows, receiving, shipping, and operational constraints.
  • Translate manufacturing plans, inventory strategies, and material requirements into clear warehouse capacity scenarios, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Support planning and management of external warehouse capacity, including demand projections, storage requirements, inventory movements, and associated operational readiness.
  • Partner with Warehouse Leadership, Planning, Procurement, and Industrial Engineering to evaluate material flow, layout, storage utilization, and future capacity needs.
  • Provide timely analysis to support operational decisions, capital planning, network discussions, and site readiness activities.
  • Establish and maintain capacity planning assumptions, standard work, and recurring reporting to ensure consistent, transparent decision-making.
  • Identify constraints and opportunities to improve warehouse utilization, material flow, service levels, and execution reliability.
  • Support cross-functional problem solving for material availability, space constraints, inventory disposition, and warehouse execution issues.
  • Communicate warehouse capacity outlooks, external warehouse plans, risks, and required actions clearly to site and network stakeholders.

Own Warehouse Master Data and Digital Capability

  • Manage and maintain warehouse-related master data in partnership with Global Master Data, AIN, and site teams, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely change execution.
  • Perform data quality checks and resolve master data issues that affect warehouse capacity, storage assignments, material movement, planning signals, or execution.
  • Define and document data standards, ownership, and governance routines for warehouse master data and planning inputs.
  • Learn and apply AI-enabled tools and methods to streamline capacity modeling, scenario analysis, reporting, and data validation.
  • Identify practical opportunities to reduce manual analysis and reporting through automation, digital tools, and reusable models.

Footprint / Scope of Responsibility

  • Provide analytical and planning support for ANC warehouse capacity and external warehouse requirements, from current-state operations through future demand scenarios.
  • Serve as a key site contact for warehouse master data and data-quality matters, coordinating with Global Master Data and AIN teams.
  • Enable aligned decisions across Warehouse, Planning, Procurement, and Industrial Engineering through reliable models, structured analysis, and clear communication.
  • Support a safe, compliant, and scalable warehouse operation by improving visibility to capacity, material flow, and master data risks.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school/GED + 4 years Supply Chain, Warehouse Operations, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Systems work experience OR​
  • Associate’s + 2 years Supply Chain, Warehouse Operations, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Systems work experience OR​
  • Bachelor’s + 6 months Supply Chain, Warehouse Operations, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Systems work experience​ OR
  • Master's ​

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, manufacturing, logistics, or other GMP-regulated environment.
  • Experience with warehouse capacity analysis, inventory management, material flow, warehouse operations, or external warehouse planning.
  • Experience working with master data in SAP, an ERP system, warehouse management systems, or planning tools.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to build, maintain, and explain capacity models and scenario analyses.
  • Experience collaborating across Warehouse, Planning, Procurement, Industrial Engineering, and/or Digital and Technology functions.
  • Ability to learn and apply AI-enabled tools, automation, or advanced analytics to improve modeling, reporting, or data quality.
  • Knowledge of warehouse storage types, utilization, receiving, shipping, and material flow principles.
  • Strong attention to detail, data governance discipline, and ability to identify and resolve data-quality issues.
  • Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to operational and leadership audiences.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and data visualization or reporting tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI); experience with SAP, Kinaxis RapidResponse, or similar systems is preferred.
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement, compliance, and patient-focused operational excellence.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

title: Director of Safety
description:
A-1 Electrical Contractors, Inc. is seeking a Director of Safety to develop, implement, and administer the company's safety and health programs and ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations. The Director of Safety maintains a safe work environment for employees, subcontractors, and visitors, and works closely with management and field leadership to proactively identify risks and ensure safe work practices are followed on all electrical construction projects.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Safety Programs and Compliance: Develop, implement, and maintain the company's safety policies, procedures, and programs in accordance with OSHA, NFPA 70E, the NEC, and other applicable safety standards.

• Inspections and Audits: Conduct regular job site safety inspections and audits to identify hazards and unsafe practices, recommend corrective actions, and monitor subcontractor activities for compliance with company and project-specific safety requirements.

• Incident Investigation: Lead investigations of all accidents, incidents, and near-misses, prepare detailed reports, and track corrective actions to completion.

• Training and Safety Culture: Coordinate and deliver new hire orientation, toolbox talks, and task-specific training, and reinforce a culture of safety through communication, coaching, and recognition programs.

• Project Safety Planning: Work with project managers and foremen on job-specific safety plans, Job Safety Analyses (JSAs), and lockout/tagout procedures, and ensure electrical safety protocols including arc flash protection, grounding, and PPE compliance are followed on every job site.

• Documentation and Regulatory Response: Maintain training logs, inspection reports, and incident records in compliance with company and regulatory requirements, and serve as the company's representative during OSHA inspections, coordinating responses to any citations or violations.

• Analysis and Continuous Improvement: Analyze safety metrics and trends to recommend improvements in processes, training, and hazard prevention. Perform additional duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum of three (3) years of experience in construction safety management, preferably within the electrical contracting industry. High school diploma or equivalent required.

• Comprehensive knowledge of OSHA 1926 regulations and NFPA 70E safety standards, with working familiarity with the National Electrical Code. OSHA 30-Hour Construction Certification required.

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence positive safety behaviors at all levels of the organization and to collaborate effectively with team members, management, and clients while adhering to company policies.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs and safety management software, and the ability to travel to various job sites as required.

• Must comply with a criminal background check and drug test.

• Preferred: Additional safety credentials such as CHST, COSS, or COSM, and an OSHA 500/510 credential.

POSITION AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Ability to walk, stand, and climb for extended periods, navigate uneven or rough terrain, and lift up to 25 pounds.

• Tolerance for outdoor working conditions including heat, cold, and inclement weather, and exposure to construction sites and equipment noise and vibration.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

• Negotiable based upon experience, with bi-annual performance awards, medical, dental, vision, and supplemental insurance, paid time off, and 401k matching.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Description

Senior Full Stack Engineer

Location: Ireland (Dublin)

Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Work Model: Hybrid, 3 days per week in the Dublin office

The Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality software across the full stack, from reactive front-ends to Python and Django services for the RapidRatings platform. You will work to direction from the Product and Architecture teams and deliver through the RapidRatings AI Development Life Cycle (RR-AI-DLC), with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and agents and skills as a core part of daily delivery.

You will deliver features end to end across reactive front-ends (SPA), Python and Django APIs, and PostgreSQL data models, applying modern engineering practices across Kubernetes, AWS, and Docker. You will work closely with cross-functional colleagues to build scalable, reliable, and performant applications.

Key Responsibilities Design and Delivery
  • Design and build features end to end, with Claude as a close collaborator and orchestrator, across reactive front-ends (SPA) and Python and Django services spanning RiskPulse, FastTrack, ActionPath, and the FHR Network.
  • Model and evolve data in PostgreSQL and design well-versioned REST APIs (dbapi2) that power the platform.
  • Deliver work through the RapidRatings AI Development Life Cycle (RR-AI-DLC), running bolts from Inception to Construction to Close-out with Claude Code and agentic tooling, and contributing Skills and Agents to the RR-AI-DLC Framework, with your orchestration and governing the decisions and outcomes.
Quality, Security, and Ownership
  • Critically review and take full accountability for AI-generated plans, code, and tests, owning every human approval gate. Nothing ships on the AI's say-so alone.
  • Build quality and security in from the start through automated tests, Playwright UI verification, and passing the mandatory security-review gate.
  • Deploy and operate services on AWS and Kubernetes with Docker, use Datadog for observability, and drive rapid resolution of production defects. We own what we ship.
Collaboration and Shared Assets
  • Collaborate with teams to turn Product Requirements and customer escalations into shipped, signed-off outcomes.
  • Contribute to shared engineering assets, including reusable Skills, Agents, and rr-codex decision memory, so the whole organisation delivers faster and more consistently.

The CI HUMINT Research Analyst is an expert-level analyst responsible for developing, refining, and validating Counterintelligence (CI) and Human Intelligence (HUMINT) doctrine that supports cyber‑domain operations. title: Lead Pharmacy Tech
location: Saint Alphonsus Medical Center - Nampa, Idaho
description:
Employment Type:

Full time

Shift:

Day Shift

Description:

PHARMACY TECH LEAD

NAMPA MEDICAL CENTER

SUMMARY:

Support pharmacy management by guiding daily pharmacy technician operations. Ensure other pharmacy technicians have the resources and training necessary to perform their jobs effectively. Oversee either pharmacy automation, packaging, or a dedicated pharmacy technician operations in tandem with pharmacy leadership and serves as a leader and mentor to pharmacy technician peers.

HOURS: You will enjoy three days off each week! The position will be four 10-hour days, M-F.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be licensed as a Certified Pharmacy Technician with the Idaho State Board of Pharmacy.

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience as a pharmacy technician required; hospital experience required; preferred to have 6 months with Saint Alphonsus.

  • National Certification (CPhT, ExCPT or equivalent) required.

  • Completion of college level certificate or bachelor’s degree preferred.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Supervises and assists pharmacy technicians with their roles in the pharmacy.

  • Provides structure and oversight for pharmacy technician orientation, training, and competency assurance. Coaches less experienced staff.

  • Schedules pharmacy technicians, finds replacements for technicians out sick or on vacation and ensures shift changes run smoothly.

  • Reviews and adjusts workflow to meet work demand (ex. sick calls, high patient volumes). Appropriately utilizes resources to ensure shifts are adequately covered.

  • Conducts technician huddles and participates in department quarterly and annual meetings.

  • Assists in hiring/recruitment (in coordination with pharmacy management)

  • Counsels staff members on their performance and provides documentation of exemplary and unsatisfactory work performance at time of occurrence. Assists in performance evaluations in coordination with pharmacy management.

  • Monitors monthly technician tasks (e.g., outdates, unit inspections) and provides follow up.

  • Provides administrative and clerical support with regards to keeping records, running reports, and maintenance of data

  • Supports timekeeping functions.

  • Provides automated systems oversight and delegates duties, as appropriate.

  • Maintains security and confidentiality of passwords for automated systems.

  • Maintains system user files ensuring addition of new users, assignment of passwords and appropriate user privileges, and removal of terminated users in a timely manner.

  • Ensures that look-alike, sound-alike medications are segregated in automated distribution equipment.

  • Generates appropriate reports at specified times.

  • Maintains outdated medication tracking function, ensuring appropriate expiration dates are entered, stock is rotated, and expired items removed.

  • Oversees the filling of medications on restock lists and quarantines until checked and verified by a pharmacist; oversees the loading of medications from restock lists into automated distribution system correctly.

  • Oversees processes for establishing and maintaining any medication kits/boxes/carts outside of automated dispensing cabinets.

  • Maintains appropriate par levels for inventories in automated distribution equipment.

  • Conducts controlled substances inventories and reconciliation in automated distribution system in accordance with state laws and regulations and facility policy.

  • Reviews controlled substances discrepancy reports daily and reconciles unresolved discrepancies appropriately and in a timely manner as specified

  • by facility policy.

  • Utilizes data mining software to analyze data and identify inappropriate use of the automated distribution system.

  • Ensures that automation processes are aligned with hospital policy (i.e., storage of controlled substances, hazardous medications, etc…).

  • Provides oversight of drug shortage management as they relate to pharmacy automation processes.

  • Assists with communicating with hospital colleagues regarding pharmacy automation processes.

  • Participates in quality assurance and continuous quality improvement activities.

  • Develops and enforces policies and procedures that promote safe, appropriate, and cost-effective medication use.

  • Prepares trending reports as appropriate for quality improvement activities based on analysis of data.

  • Provides courteous, cooperative, and timely service to patients, visitors, and staff members; demonstrates good oral and written communication.

  • Aids in the day-to-day needs of the department (in coordination with pharmacy management)

  • Demonstrates effective oral and written communication skills.

  • Effectively uses available software and information systems.

  • Adheres to health-system policies and procedures; complies with all requirements related to risk management, safety, medication-use safety, security, fire safety, and infection control; complies with all applicable federal/state/local laws, rules, and regulations; and performs all duties under the direct supervision of a registered pharmacist.

  • Performs essential duties of pharmacy technicians when needed and as assigned.

Ministry/Facility Information:

Saint Alphonsus Health System is a faith-based ministry and not-for-profit health system serving Idaho, Oregon, and northern Nevada communities. The health system boasts 4 hospitals, 609 licensed beds, and 73 clinic locations. Through innovative technologies, compassionate staff, and healing environments, Saint Alphonsus' goal is to improve the health and well-being of people by emphasizing care that is patient-centered, physician-led, innovative, and community-based.

title: Data Scientist 3
description:
Position Overview

BLOC Resources is seeking an experienced Data Scientist 3 – Nuclear Operations to support Southern Company and Southern Nuclear's Nuclear Technology Solutions organization.

This senior-level position is responsible for developing, validating, deploying, and maintaining advanced analytical and machine learning solutions that support nuclear operational performance, equipment reliability, predictive maintenance, and economic outcomes.

The Data Scientist will transform complex plant telemetry and operational data into actionable insights delivered through a secure, governed, cloud-native analytics environment. A major focus of this position is the production-grade implementation of analytics solutions within the Southern Nuclear Azure Databricks Lakehouse.

Because this work supports a highly regulated nuclear environment, the successful candidate must demonstrate exceptional attention to accuracy, model validation, documentation, data governance, security, traceability, auditability, and formal change management.

The ideal candidate will have approximately 10–15 years of data science and advanced analytics experience, with significant experience developing and deploying production machine learning solutions using Python, SQL, Spark, cloud technologies, and large-scale datasets.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Analytics & Machine Learning

  • Develop, test, validate, deploy, and maintain advanced statistical and machine learning models.
  • Develop analytical solutions supporting nuclear operational performance, equipment reliability, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and related operational use cases.
  • Analyze large, complex datasets to identify patterns, trends, relationships, risks, and actionable insights.
  • Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to solve complex operational and business problems.
  • Develop predictive models using appropriate machine learning techniques, including ensemble methods, neural networks, deep learning, and other advanced approaches where appropriate.
  • Develop and optimize algorithms to address complex analytical challenges.
  • Lead feature engineering activities to identify and develop meaningful variables that improve model performance.
  • Formulate and test hypotheses using rigorous statistical methods.
  • Design analytical experiments and, where appropriate, evaluate results using structured experimentation or A/B testing methodologies.
  • Ensure analytical approaches are appropriate for the intended operational application.

Model Validation & Reliability

  • Apply rigorous validation techniques to ensure analytical models are accurate, reliable, explainable, and suitable for operational decision support.
  • Document model assumptions, limitations, intended uses, validation results, and operational considerations.
  • Evaluate model performance against established requirements and success criteria.
  • Monitor deployed models over time for changes in performance.
  • Identify model drift, data-quality issues, and changes in underlying operational conditions.
  • Support controlled model updates as data and operating conditions evolve.
  • Ensure model outputs can be traced to approved source data.
  • Promote reproducibility and repeatability throughout the analytical lifecycle.

Azure Databricks Lakehouse & Cloud Analytics

  • Design and implement end-to-end analytics workflows within the Southern Nuclear Azure Databricks Lakehouse environment.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize analytical data pipelines.
  • Develop feature datasets supporting machine learning and advanced analytics.
  • Work within enterprise medallion architecture standards and established data-management practices.
  • Leverage Apache Spark and distributed computing technologies to process large and complex operational datasets.
  • Integrate data from approved enterprise data sources, data lakes, warehouses, and operational systems.
  • Develop scalable analytical solutions capable of supporting production workloads.
  • Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams on data availability, architecture, integration, and performance.
  • Apply approved experiment tracking and model-lifecycle practices to support governance and repeatability.

MLOps & Production Model Deployment

  • Support the development and implementation of repeatable machine learning training and deployment workflows.
  • Deploy analytical and machine learning models into controlled production environments.
  • Participate in the development and improvement of MLOps practices.
  • Establish repeatable processes for model training, testing, validation, deployment, monitoring, and controlled updates.
  • Ensure production models are maintainable, traceable, and appropriately documented.
  • Coordinate with platform, engineering, and IT teams to ensure successful model integration.
  • Support production analytics used for operational and business decision-making.

Time-Series & Nuclear Operational Analytics

  • Analyze industrial and operational time-series datasets.
  • Develop models capable of identifying abnormal equipment or system behavior.
  • Apply predictive analytics to support equipment reliability and predictive maintenance.
  • Evaluate historical and real-time operational data to identify meaningful performance patterns.
  • Work with nuclear engineers and operational subject-matter experts to understand plant telemetry and operational context.
  • Translate engineering and operational questions into measurable analytical problems.
  • Ensure statistical conclusions appropriately reflect the characteristics and limitations of the underlying data.

Applied AI & Advanced Analytics

  • Support approved AI-enabled analytical and search capabilities.
  • Evaluate retrieval-based and other advanced AI techniques when appropriate for approved use cases.
  • Ensure AI-assisted solutions are transparent, verifiable, traceable, and aligned with enterprise and regulatory expectations.
  • Evaluate emerging data science and AI technologies for potential business and operational applications.
  • Promote responsible and controlled implementation of advanced AI capabilities.
  • Ensure AI-enabled solutions operate within established security, data-governance, and change-management requirements.

Data Governance, Security & Compliance

  • Design analytical solutions in accordance with enterprise data-governance standards.
  • Maintain appropriate data access controls and security requirements.
  • Ensure analytical outputs are traceable to approved data sources and inputs.
  • Follow established data-handling and information-security standards.
  • Operate within platform security controls designed to limit unauthorized data ingress, egress, and access.
  • Support auditability of data science models, analytical processes, and outputs.
  • Apply appropriate data privacy, ethical data-use, and compliance practices.
  • Ensure analytical solutions meet Southern Company requirements for quality, accuracy, documentation, and auditability.
  • Work in accordance with nuclear safety culture and formal change-management practices.

Data Visualization & Communication

  • Develop clear and effective visualizations that communicate complex analytical findings.
  • Present analytical insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Use tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Python visualization libraries, or other approved enterprise tools as appropriate.
  • Translate highly technical statistical and machine learning results into understandable business and operational information.
  • Clearly communicate model assumptions, methodologies, limitations, risks, and conclusions.
  • Develop presentations and supporting documentation for engineering, technology, analytics, and leadership stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with nuclear engineers, IT leaders, data engineers, platform teams, business analysts, domain experts, and analytics professionals.
  • Participate in technical design, architecture, and solution-development discussions.
  • Translate operational and engineering requirements into appropriate analytical approaches.
  • Collaborate with IT and data engineering teams to integrate approved data sources.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders throughout model development, validation, deployment, and operational support.
  • Build effective relationships across technical and operational organizations.
  • Serve as a senior data science resource on complex analytical initiatives.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

As a senior-level Data Scientist, the successful candidate may also:

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists and analytics professionals.
  • Review analytical methodologies, model designs, and technical solutions.
  • Promote data science standards and best practices.
  • Help improve organizational capabilities in machine learning, advanced analytics, MLOps, and AI.
  • Contribute to longer-term analytics and data science strategy.
  • Evaluate new technologies, techniques, frameworks, and tools.
  • Encourage innovation while maintaining appropriate governance and operational controls.

Required Qualifications

  • Approximately 10–15 years of professional data science, advanced analytics, machine learning, or closely related experience.

description:

We’re Finding Better Ways to provide materials the world needs, now and in the future. Our values, care, courage and curiosity, guide how we work and how we treat each other.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Mining Systems Technician to join the Asset Health team at Marandoo Operations, maintaining, troubleshooting and improving the critical technology systems that support safe and productive mining operations across the site.

This is a great opportunity for a technically capable and safety-focused professional to support the availability and reliability of Marandoo’s Mining Systems assets. This permanent position operates on an 8 days on, 6 days off fly-in fly-out roster, working dayshift only.

What you’ll be doing

Reporting to the Supervisor Asset Health Mobile Equipment Maintenance and working collaboratively with Operations, Engineering, Asset Health, Autonomous Haulage and external vendors, you will be:

  • Maintaining Caterpillar MineStar systems, including Terrain, Command, Site Awareness and associated heavy mobile equipment interfaces.

  • Supporting LTE communications infrastructure, AVI data radios, onboard networking equipment and machine connectivity systems.

  • Troubleshooting software, hardware and network-related issues affecting fleet production and autonomous operations.

  • Conducting breakdown repairs and restoring systems safely and efficiently to minimise operational downtime.

  • Monitoring system health, supporting technology commissioning and upgrades, and managing maintenance work orders, notifications, task confirmations and asset history through SAP.

About you

We’re looking for someone whose experience aligns with the key requirements below. You do not need to meet every “helpful for success” item to apply — if you bring relevant experience and are excited by the opportunity, we encourage you to submit an application.

Required for success

  • A commitment to the safety of yourself and your team.

  • Demonstrated experience maintaining Mining Systems technologies within mining, heavy industry, rail or autonomous operations.

  • Strong working knowledge of Caterpillar MineStar applications, including Terrain, Command and Site Awareness.

  • Experience supporting onboard machine hardware, GNSS systems, LTE and wireless communications, networking principles, machine interfaces and fleet management technologies.

Be recognised for your contribution, your thinking and your hard work, and go home knowing you’ve helped the world progress.

The Marandoo mine is located at the foot of Mount Bruce, adjacent to Karijini National Park and 50 kilometres east of Tom Price. Marandoo is known for its picturesque hills and mountain ranges. Our operation currently employs a fly-in fly-out workforce.

Rio Tinto is a leading global mining and materials company. We operate in 35 countries where we produce iron ore, copper, aluminium, critical minerals, and other materials needed for the global energy transition and for people, communities, and nations to thrive.

Work Remote Position

Basic understanding of Microsoft Office Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
