title: Associate Director, Data Capability Lead Blanchardstown Road North, Dublin, Ireland Data Engineering
description:
Job Description

This is what you will do:

The Data & AI Capability Lead reports to the Senior Director, RDU IT Data & AI and is a critical role in Alexion IT RDU organization. The focus of this role is to take stakeholder-centric data-driven approach to deliver large Data & AI (D&AI) Programs in Operations encompassing Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality.

Alexion is looking for a sharp-minded, assertive, and energetic D&AI leader who will be responsible for establishing the strategy, functional plans, and delivery of these products/ projects/programs to meet the short- and long-term goals and metrics of the organization. Should be able to conceptually architect and design data and analytics solutions to meet specific business demands, driving value from information and ensuring end-to-end delivery.

We are looking for adaptable candidates with a broad set of technology skills to be able to lead robust data solutions that leverage disparate datasets, data lake repositories, engineering workflows, visualization, and Data Science toolkit. The candidate will have to oversee Operations demands and work with internal and vendor delivery organizations to ensure the right delivery approach/model has been followed.

The candidate needs to be client-oriented, capable of independently developing sophisticated data foundation, business analytics, data engineering & integration solutions, and skilled at presenting solutions to broad audiences within IT and business groups.

The right candidate for this position should have a proven track record delivering Data & AI capabilities in Operations for an international Pharma/Biopharma company. They should have superior program delivery and team management capabilities, strong technical skills, and the ability to manage vendor relationships. Alexion RDU is looking to build the next generation of patient-centric digital health products and we are looking for a qualified individual whose passion is understanding how to best utilize healthcare data and platforms to drive business innovation.

You will be responsible for:

Data Capability Lead will be responsible for supporting IT and business-driven activities which will include the following:

  • Understand business, conceptualize analysis framework, define Data & AI requirements, and coordinate implementation with IT business partners, business stakeholders, and external partners for delivering enhanced digital experience to stakeholders
  • Responsible to drive initiatives in Data Management, deploy Data & AI enablement practices for master, reference and metadata and execute key strategies in building taxonomy/ ontologies and FAIR data products using multi-modal datasets
  • Responsible to deliver data engineering services, ingesting data in the Alexion Data Platform, creating data hubs to integrate and distribute data in the form of products, and supporting integration to digital applications to generate insights through AI/ML
  • Drive operationalization and adoption of data products and AI/ML solutions in generating insights supporting Alexion functions
  • Provide consultancy advice, as a trusted partner, to both the global and regional stakeholders within the business and other technology teams from strategic partners / vendors for on-going and new implementation projects and ensure they are aligned with organization goals
You will need to have:
  • Strong technical delivery management experience in Data Engineering, Data Foundation and Observability and AI/ML across functions and geographies
  • In-depth working knowledge of data domain modelling and expertise in designing taxonomy and ontology, that facilitate the management of key master/reference data products like Material, Product and their associated hierarchies
  • Organize data at the macro level using conceptual/logical data models as a standard for the trusted source and for consuming applications to inherit, with the ability to extend the data model to bridge internal Alexion and AstraZeneca systems and data
  • Ability to successfully lead a team of Business Analysts, Data Engineers and Analytics and AI Developers through all phases of the development life cycles, including concept definition, product design, development, implementation, and testing
  • At least 8 years of experience in leading, designing, and developing data lake and data integration architectures, using FAIR data set and prior experience in managing end-to-end engagements in BI using Qlik Sense or PowerBI, and Data Science languages like R and Python; should possess knowledge of Cloud platforms like AWS, modern data storage layer like Snowflake, dbt, FiveTran and cloud data management applications like Immuta, Collibra and Reltio/ Veeva Network
  • Knowledge of Privacy and healthcare interoperability standards like GDPR, HIPAA and HL7, FHIR
  • Familiarity with Git, Data-Ops, and Continuous Integration /Continuous Deployment pipelines and experience in Agile project execution
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field of study (Computer Science/Engineering preferred) and have excellent communication, analytical and logical thinking skills, detail-oriented with an ability to take a macro view
We would prefer for you to have:
  • A Master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent level of experience
  • 8+ years of digital and data transformation experience within biopharma industry with at least 5 years of managing complex transformations
  • Experience with AI-ready Data Products
  • Prior experience working on digital health initiatives

Date Posted: 28-Aug-2026

  • Plan and execute system integration, specialized, user acceptance, stress, performance, and other testing activities.
  • Develop and maintain test strategies, test plans, test scripts, test cases, and test data.
  • Execute functional, integration, system, regression, non-functional, and acceptance testing.
  • Validate that systems perform as expected under various conditions.
  • Identify, document, track, and manage software defects using tools such as ALM, JIRA, Bugzilla, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar.
  • Work closely with developers to reproduce, troubleshoot, and resolve defects.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using tools such as Selenium, Micro Focus/OpenText UFT, TestComplete, Postman, or similar.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

title: Managing Director, Yale Alumni Fund
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview

Founded in 1890, the Yale Alumni Fund is one of the world’s oldest continuously operating annual giving programs. Its purpose is to secure flexible, unrestricted support that advances Yale’s core mission: to create, disseminate, and preserve knowledge through research and teaching. As part of the recently concluded For Humanity campaign, the Alumni Fund contributed more than $375 million through over 350,000 gifts—demonstrating the extraordinary collective impact of Yale alumni, parents, and friends. With an annual goal of securing more than $50 million from constituents across Yale College, the Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, and Yale’s professional schools, the Alumni Fund is a cornerstone of Yale’s philanthropic tradition and a vital source of support for the university’s highest priorities. Its work is championed by university leadership and carried out in close partnership with schools, units, volunteers, and colleagues throughout Yale.

Reporting to the Associate Vice President for Development, the Managing Director of the Yale Alumni Fund will provide strategic vision and operational leadership of Yale's annual giving program. The Managing Director will develop and execute comprehensive, data-informed strategies for donor cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, acquisition, retention, pipeline development, and volunteer engagement, ensuring that the Alumni Fund consistently achieves ambitious annual goals while advancing the broader priorities of the Yale University Office of Development. The role will strengthen participation and philanthropic support across Yale’s constituencies, expand the pipeline of future volunteers and leadership-level donors, and foster meaningful, lifelong relationships between Yale and its alumni, parents, and friends. Success will require close coordination with colleagues across Development, Alumni Affairs, Yale College, the Graduate School, the professional schools, and other university partners to align strategy, share insights, and deliver a cohesive donor and volunteer experience.

The Managing Director will lead, inspire, and develop a team of approximately 25 professionals, including three deputy directors, who design and implement comprehensive annual giving and engagement strategies. The team partners with volunteers, alumni, parents, students, and colleagues across Yale to achieve fundraising and participation goals while deepening donor loyalty and volunteer commitment. The Managing Director will establish clear priorities and performance expectations, promote collaboration and innovation, support professional growth, and cultivate an inclusive, high-performing culture grounded in accountability, creativity, and shared purpose. The role will also ensure that resources, systems, communications, and programmatic efforts are aligned to maximize results and position the Alumni Fund for sustained success.

The Managing Director serves as the principal staff leader for the Alumni Fund Board of Directors, a volunteer body of nearly 100 members that convenes three times each year. In this capacity, the Managing Director will work closely with board leadership to shape agendas, advance strategic priorities, strengthen member engagement, and equip volunteers to serve as effective ambassadors and advocates for Yale. The Managing Director will also foster strong relationships with class, school, and regional volunteer leaders and will serve as an invited guest of the Yale Alumni Association Board of Governors, helping to connect annual giving priorities with Yale’s broader alumni engagement strategy.

The principal responsibilities outlined below provide a broad framework for the position. Candidates should give particular attention to the position focus, which describes the leadership priorities, strategic opportunities, and organizational needs most relevant to the Managing Director’s success.


Required Skills and Abilities

1. Proven ability to mentor and guide fundraising staff to collaborate with colleagues and execute immediate strategies and long-term projects. Experience in leading, coaching and motivating other professionals. Ability to maintain strict confidentiality.

2. Proven track record in fundraising. Demonstrated accomplishment in managing or executing a wide range of solicitation, marketing, and stewardship activities.

3. Possesses excellent written, oral and presentation skills. Experience synthesizing and prioritizing information from a wide array of sources while maintaining attention to detail and effectively managing workflow. Excellent organizational and analytical skills and the ability to improve business practices and processes.

4. Proactive, productive team leader with a positive attitude

5. Possesses initiative, creativity, a data-driven work ethic, and willingness to take personal responsibility for outcomes. Results-oriented, driven to succeed, innovative, and inspired by challenging goals.

Preferred Skills and Abilities

1. Experience in a university setting or with development work; advanced degree; familiarity with Yale.

Principal Responsibilities

1. Responsible for planning, managing, and executing all aspects of development effort. 2. Works closely with senior management to develop both short- and long-term fundraising goals and strategies, including a strategic plan for building a post-campaign pipeline in anticipation of the next campaign. 3. Works with staff to develop and implement plans to carry out the organization's goals and strategies, including establishing specific activity goals for all phases of the donor/prospect life-cycle (cultivation, solicitation, closure and stewardship). 4. Directs and grows a team of development professionals responsible for generating an increased volume of successful development activities and establishing a culture that encourages ever-improving levels of performance and responsiveness to donors. 5. Develops strong ties with the faculty in order to understand and support the organization's programs and mission. 6. Manages engagement of faculty, administrators, and University officials in fundraising efforts. 7. Manages and staffs the senior management development activities and calendar to ensure maximum deployment. 8. Personally maintains a significant portfolio of leadership and principal gift prospects. 9. Participates in the development of strategy and content for all development publications and events. 10. If requested, develops and maintains relationships with members of the School Fund Board, if in existence. 11. Works regularly and cooperatively with other development offices to ensure overall development priorities, plans, and initiatives are coordinated. 12. Serves as the liaison with other development offices to provide information on organization needs and to develop strategies for prospects that are staffed centrally. 13. May perform other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience Bachelor’s Degree and ten plus years of relevant experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

title: Counsel - Trust & Estates
description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

The Opportunity

A rare opportunity for an accomplished trusts and estates attorney to become the legal voice behind a premier private wealth franchise. As Counsel, you will be the day-to-day coverage attorney for our two National Trust Companies and our Cayman Trust Company within our Capital Partners line of business — advising senior management, shaping policy, negotiating agreements, and guiding the administration of our most complex fiduciary matters. Substantive, sophisticated work with a genuine seat at the table.

What You'll Do

  • Advise our trust companies on business acceptance and all aspects of fiduciary administration, from review of governing instruments to advising on policies, procedures, operations and workflows.
  • Review and negotiate a broad range of instruments including trust agreements, Wills, entity formation documents, release and account settlement agreements, engagement letters, intercompany agreements and vendor contracts entered into in a fiduciary capacity.
  • Partner with Trust Officers, Office Heads, Wealth Planners, Relationship Managers and external counsel on complex trust and estate administration matters, and serve as subject matter expert to internal counsel covering litigation and other areas.
  • Track legal and regulatory developments and translate them into practical guidance, memoranda, and multistate law reviews.
  • Serve as legal advisor to Trust Company Boards, Committees, and key projects, and provide counsel during audits and regulatory examinations.
  • Present at firmwide Legal Developments Meetings and Trust Officer training, and represent the firm in bar association and industry groups.

What You'll Bring

  • JD and active bar admission in good standing, with 10+ years of relevant experience.
  • Deep command of trust and estate law and the practical application of trust and estate document provisions; knowledge of one or more state-specific trust and estate laws preferred.
  • Practical experience in the administration of complex trusts and estates, including knowledge of investment structures.
  • Fluency in the rules, regulations, and best practices governing trust, estate, and entity administration, including state and federal banking requirements.
  • A track record of applying legal principles to complex fact patterns and developing creative solutions to complex business problems.

title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
description:
At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. ASAPP’s AI Engineering team is seeking an enterprising, talented and curious machine learning engineer.

The AI Engineering team is responsible for working closely with the research and modeling teams to create state-of-the-art NLP models for specific tasks, and deploy them in a production setting designed to serve our customers at scale. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to help build and evaluate the core intelligence behind our agentic AI systems. This role will play a key part in designing and owning evaluation frameworks that ensure quality, safety, and performance across complex agentic systems.

We're looking for a Lead Machine Learning Engineer to own and grow the evaluation platform that measures quality, safety, and performance across ASAPP's agentic AI systems- the infrastructure that tells us, with confidence, whether a model or agent change is actually an improvement before it reaches customers.

This a hybrid role with 10-12 days of in-office presence per month to balance flexibility with collaboration.

What you'll do

  • Help develop the technical roadmap and architecture for the evaluation platform, from offline benchmarking to online/production monitoring of agentic and LLM-based systems.

  • Design eval methodologies appropriate to different stages of the pipeline: golden/regression test sets, human-in-the-loop review workflows, LLM-as-judge approaches, and automated metrics for task success, safety, and hallucinations.

  • Build the data infrastructure evaluation depends on: annotation and labeling pipelines, dataset versioning, data quality checks, and tooling that lets researchers and product teams run and interpret experiments without needing platform team help.

  • Partner closely with Research, Product, and Platform teams to productize experiments into robust AI solutions

  • Represent the eval platform to stakeholders outside the immediate team- set expectations on what "good" looks like for a model/agent release, and report on platform health and coverage.

  • Stay current with advancements in ML, NLP, voice, and LLM systems, and contribute actively to technical discussions across teams.

  • Mentor and support other engineers through design reviews, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

What you'll need

  • Deep, hands-on experience building and operating evaluation systems for modern ML/LLM/agentic systems- not just consuming existing eval tools.

  • Demonstrated experience leading the technical direction of a project or small team: setting architecture, driving design reviews, and being accountable for a system's long-term health (not just shipping features).

  • Strong architectural skills, with proven experience designing complex, data-intensive software systems and production experience with Python, AWS, Kubernetes, and/or Docker.

  • Experience designing data pipelines for ML evaluation- labeling/annotation workflows, dataset versioning and quality control, and reproducible benchmarking.

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in CS or other related fields

  • Demonstrated technical mentorship of junior and mid-level engineers, driving adoption of best practices and architectural alignment for scalability and extensibility.

  • Desire to learn, teach, and collaborate closely with cross-functional peers.

What we'd like to see

  • Experience building and evaluating agentic systems at scale.

  • Experience with voice/audio quality evaluations.

  • Production experience with LLM-centric services (e.g., inference, orchestration, evaluation, monitoring)

  • Familiarity with large-scale ML experimentation, benchmarking, or simulation frameworks.

  • Experience with conversational/customer-support AI domains (e.g., containment rate, conversation quality, goal completion).

  • Knowledge of techniques for optimizing model architectures for faster inference.

  • Experience with AWS, CI/CD, Kafka, Athena

Competitive compensation with stock options
Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental insurance
401k matching
Fitness and wellness stipend
Mental well-being benefits
Professional learning and development stipend
Parental leave, including adoptive and foster parents

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our mission experience in space runs deep, we know our customers well, and our capabilities are unmatched. This is what allows us to provide reliable, agile and affordable space solutions to best serve our customers.

From defending freedom to advancing human discovery, we are defining what is possible in space every day.

A co-op at Northrop Grumman is unique. Sure, you’ll learn new skills, explore our enterprise, network with experts, connect with thought leaders, and finish with a resume that opens doors. But you’ll gain something even more valuable: pride in what you’ve done. Join us and launch your career. We’ll support you with training, professional development and networking opportunities, and our shared vision of global security.

Northrop Grumman is seeking a Mechanical Engineer to join the Space Systems Sector for a Co-op. This position will be located in Chandler, Arizona. The successful candidate should plan to work full time during the Summer and Fall semesters (June-December 2027).

As a co-op, you’ll participate in a co-op program to develop competencies in a variety of Mechanical engineering specializations that may include:

Roles and Responsibilities

Performs a variety of duties in the mechanical areas. Constructs, troubleshoots, calibrates, adjusts, tests, and maintains equipment, components, devices, or systems. Works from engineering drawings and written or verbal instructions. Operates related equipment; conducts tests and reports data in prescribed format. Performs calibration and alignment checks; makes adjustments, modifications, and replacements as directed; prepares prescribed compounds and solutions.

Basic Qualifications

A candidate, regardless of age and hiring source, must meet ALL of the below criteria. The candidate must:

  • • Be enrolled full-time and pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree from an accredited college/university AND graduating after December 2027
  • • Be majoring in Mechanical Engineering or related field
  • • Be available to work full-time (40 hours per week) from June - December 2027
  • • Be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)

Intern and Co-op Pay Range:

Bachelor’s: $18.50 to $33.50 per hour

Master’s: $26.25 to $41.50 per hour

At Northrop Grumman, our internship and co-op pay rates are standardized and take into account three main factors: the anticipated graduation date of the individual, the cost of labor of the geographic location, and whether the internship is considered technical or administrative.

Primary Level Salary Range: $1.00 - $1.00

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

You will help shape the Transmission Innovation Strategy, manage innovation projects, and drive the adoption of innovative solutions that support a smarter, more resilient and sustainable electricity network.

  • Lead stakeholder engagement activities to identify innovation opportunities and business challenges across SP Energy Networks Transmission.

What You'll Bring

  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, influencing and relationship management skills.

At ScottishPower, we believe it’s the little things we do in life that make a big difference. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make-up the transmission network – connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. title: Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE)/ AWS Data Engineer
description:
Hello,

Role: Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE)/ AWS Data Engineer
Client: Accenture/Amazon
Location: - Redmond, WA
Work Arrangement: Onsite, 5 days per week
Duration: 12+ months
Employment Type: W2 Contract
Pay Rate: $80–$87/hour W2 (No C2C)
Experience: 5–8+ years
Work Authorization: U.S. Citizen or Green Card holder only. No sponsorship is available for this position.



Position Overview
Accenture is seeking an experienced Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) / AWS Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain automated AWS data pipelines supporting analytics, KPI reporting, and business intelligence.
This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong experience with AWS data services, Python, SQL, ETL, and API integrations. The engineer will integrate data from multiple enterprise applications and APIs, transform and model that data within AWS, and make it available for KPI reporting and dashboards.
The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering capabilities with enough business intelligence experience to understand how the data will ultimately be consumed by business stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable AWS data pipelines.
  • Develop automated ETL/ELT processes using AWS services.
  • Integrate data from multiple REST APIs, SaaS applications, and enterprise systems.
  • Work with Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Redshift and/or Athena, Lambda, and IAM.
  • Develop Python-based data ingestion, transformation, and automation processes.
  • Write advanced SQL for data transformation, validation, modeling, and analysis.
  • Build integrations with platforms such as Jira, Smartsheet, Qualtrics, or similar systems.
  • Develop analytical datasets supporting operational reporting and business KPIs.
  • Design and maintain dashboards using Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, Power BI, or similar BI tools.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to define KPIs, reporting requirements, and data definitions.
  • Implement data quality, monitoring, security, and access-control practices.
  • Apply data governance principles including IAM, security, access controls, and data-retention policies.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline, API integration, performance, and data-quality issues.
  • Document data sources, integrations, transformations, dependencies, and reporting logic.
Required Qualifications
  • 5–8 years of Data Engineering, Business Intelligence Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related experience.
  • Strong hands-on AWS data engineering experience.
  • Strong experience with Amazon S3 and AWS Glue/ETL.
  • Experience with Amazon Redshift and/or Athena.
  • Experience with AWS Lambda and IAM.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Strong Python development skills for data engineering and automation.
  • Proven experience building automated data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating multiple REST APIs or SaaS applications.
  • Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, pagination, error handling, and automated ingestion.
  • Experience defining or supporting business KPIs and analytical datasets.
  • Experience with Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, Power BI, or comparable BI/dashboard technology.
  • Understanding of data governance, security, access controls, and retention requirements.
  • Ability to work onsite in Redmond, WA, five days per week.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen or Green Card holder. Sponsorship is not available.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Direct API integration experience with Jira, Smartsheet, or Qualtrics.
  • Experience with multiple BI platforms, including Tableau, QuickSight, or Power BI.
  • Experience consolidating data from multiple enterprise systems into centralized analytical datasets.
  • Experience working in large enterprise or consulting environments.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into technical data solutions.
What Accenture is Looking For
  • This is not primarily a dashboard developer or BI analyst position.
  • Accenture is looking for a hands-on engineer who can take data from APIs and enterprise applications, automate ingestion into AWS, transform and model the data using Python and SQL, implement appropriate security and governance controls, and deliver datasets that support KPI reporting and dashboards.
  • Candidates whose experience is primarily Tableau or Power BI development without strong AWS data engineering and API integration experience will not be a fit.

title: Senior Scientist - Targeted Protein Degradation
description:
Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Scientist – Targeted Protein Degradation

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. Amgen’s Induced Proximity Platform (IPP) is pioneering transformative drug modalities that harness proximity biology to address previously undruggable targets and expand therapeutic opportunities across multiple disease areas.

Within IPP, the Targeted Protein Degradation function integrates E3 ligase biology, chemical biology, and molecular pharmacology to discover next-generation protein degradation therapeutics. We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Scientist to advance E3 ligase-focused molecular glue screening and drive novel target discovery.

You are a creative and critical-thinking scientist with expertise in biochemistry, molecular and cellular biology, assay development, and target discovery. In this role, you will develop and execute molecular glue screening and validation strategies, identify novel degradation targets, characterize E3 ligase: target relationships, and translate screening findings into new therapeutic opportunities.

You will collaborate across disciplines to evaluate emerging targets and chemical matter, leveraging your scientific expertise and disease biology experience across oncology, cardiovascular biology, and immunology to identify high-value target opportunities and advance the therapeutic potential of molecular glue degraders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and execute workflows to validate molecular glue screening hits, including mechanism characterization and understanding of target biology.
  • Evaluate molecular glue hits in disease-relevant models to identify novel targets and therapeutic opportunities.
  • Collaborate with chemistry, proteomics, and other IPP teams to build and screen E3 ligase focused molecular glue libraries.
  • Develop cell-based and biochemical assays to study E3 ligase biology, target engagement, and molecular glue activity.
  • Contribute to project goals and timelines and communicate results across teams and research sites.
  • Present scientific findings at conferences and through publications.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a critical-thinker with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree [and relevant post-doc where applicable]

OR

Master’s degree and 4 years of relevant scientific experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of relevant scientific experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Chemical Biology, Cell Biology or a related field, with 1-2 years of relevant postdoctoral and/or industry research experience
  • Broad knowledge of cell and molecular biology with demonstrated independent research eminence through first author publications in top journals
  • Experience working with disease relevant models
  • Knowledge of mechanism of action studies for induced proximity
  • Experience with high-throughput screening and assay automation
  • Prior experience generating stable cell lines, CRISPR technologies and sample preparation for mass spectrometry
  • Experience with high-throughput screening and assay automation
  • Experience with cell-based imaging approaches to investigate target biology, protein localization, and cellular responses
  • Exposure to targeted protein degradation or induced proximity concepts
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills in a matrixed research environment
  • Flexibility to work in teams to achieve project goals and meet timelines
  • Strong experience with interpreting and analyzing complex data sets

What you can expect from us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

title: BIM-Modelleur/ Werkvoorbereider
description:

Bij Kemtec werken we met ruim 50 enthousiaste collega’s aan middelgrote en grote utiliteitsprojecten (tot 15 miljoen euro) in Noord-Brabant en Limburg. We zijn gespecialiseerd in HVAC- en GAWALO-installaties en realiseerden onder andere duurzame oplossingen voor het Koning Willem II College in Tilburg.

Ben jij technisch sterk, werk je graag nauwkeurig en vind je het leuk om betrokken te zijn bij verschillende installatieprojecten? Dan hebben wij een mooie plek voor jou op ons bedrijfsbureau. Als Modelleur/ Werkvoorbereider werk je aan het ontwerpen én voorbereiden van uiteenlopende installaties. Van het uitwerken van tekeningen tot het bestellen van materialen: jij zorgt ervoor dat projecten technisch goed voorbereid zijn en soepel uitgevoerd kunnen worden.

Wat we je bieden:

  • Een goed salaris afgestemd op jouw kennis, achtergrond en ervaring;

  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Technisch Installatiebedrijf, inclusief: 25 verlofdagen, 13 ADV-dagen en pensioenopbouw bij het pensioenfonds PMT;

  • Flexibele secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden via de Alleo-app;

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering, op basis van het bedrijfsresultaat;

  • Direct een contract voor onbepaalde tijd;

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Zowel binnen Kemtec, maar ook breder binnen (de bedrijven van) de VDK Groep;

  • Een informele, gezellige werksfeer met regelmatig leuke uitjes, zoals dit jaar het familiefeest in Phantasialand te Bruhl en diverse personeelsfeesten.

Wat je gaat doen:

Als Modelleur/ Werkvoorbereider werk je op ons bedrijfsbureau, waar installaties worden ontworpen en voorbereid. Je ontvangt opdrachten en instructies van de projectleiders en werkt deze zelfstandig of in overleg met collega's uit.

Je bent betrokken bij het project van ontwerp tot uitvoering. Je hebt regelmatig contact met projectleiders, collega's op het bedrijfsbureau, monteurs en leveranciers. Omdat je tegelijkertijd aan meerdere projecten werkt, is geen dag hetzelfde. De ene keer werk je aan een groot project, terwijl je tussendoor ook een kleinere opdracht voorbereidt.

We vinden het belangrijk dat je niet alleen achter je bureau werkt, maar ook regelmatig op de bouw aanwezig bent. Daar zie je in de praktijk hoe jouw voorbereiding en tekenwerk daadwerkelijk tot uitvoering komen.

Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Het maken van principetekeningen, sparingstekeningen, werktekeningen en revisietekeningen in Stabi-CAD;

  • Het maken van technische berekeningen met VABI;

  • Ondersteunen bij het calculeren van projecten en het selecteren van leveranciers;

  • Aanvragen en vergelijken van offertes;

  • Het uittrekken en bestellen van materialen;

  • Het modelleren en uitwerken van verwarmings-, koel-, ventilatie- en sanitaire installaties, waaronder leidingen, luchtkanalen, appendages en apparatuur;

  • Het controleren en coördineren van installaties binnen het bouwkundige en constructieve ontwerp en het signaleren en oplossen van clashes tussen verschillende disciplines;

  • Het maken van plattegronden, doorsneden, details, werktekeningen en sparingsopgaven en waar nodig het opstellen van materiaalstaten;

  • Het verwerken van wijzigingen vanuit de opdrachtgever, engineer en uitvoering en het bijwerken van tekeningen en modellen;

  • Het afstemmen met andere disciplines, zoals elektrotechniek, bouwkunde en constructie, om tot een goed en integraal ontwerp te komen;

  • Het verwerken van revisies na uitvoering, zodat de tekeningen en modellen aansluiten bij de daadwerkelijk gerealiseerde installatie;

  • Het uitvoeren van de complete werkvoorbereiding van projecten;

description:
ConOps & Architecture Engineer - Experimental Space Programs (Associate or Experienced)

Company:

The Boeing Company

The Boeing Experimental Systems Group (ESG) has an exciting opportunity for an Associate or Experienced ConOps & Architecture Engineer to join our team located in Seal Beach, CA, with potential options to work from El Segundo, CA, Aurora, CO, or Herndon, VA based on candidate eligibility. As a ConOps & Architecture Engineer in ESG, you will have the opportunity to personally contribute to the development of new first-of-kind space vehicles and missions. The ESG portfolio consists of a range of platforms and technologies including the X-37B, the world’s first fully autonomous reusable spaceplane, which is continuing to shape the future of space technology while currently flying its eighth mission.

As a member of our Systems Engineering Integration & Test (SEIT) Mission Design team, you will join a diverse team of system architects, Concept of Operations (ConOps) developers, fault and autonomy designers, and recommended operating procedure (ROP) authors.

As a ConOps and Architecture Engineer, you will be expected to lead coordination across all internal and external stakeholders to drive development and implementation of an operational concept for an executable space mission. You will serve as a core point of contact for customers and will work directly with subject matter experts across the business to quickly iterate and converge on achievable solutions that meet our customers’ needs. Our development timelines are aggressive and you will be asked to develop solutions to previously unsolved problems.

In this role, you will work in multidisciplinary teams to bring concept of operations to fruition in support of our customers’ mission objectives. You will work both as an individual contributor and as a project lead. An ideal candidate has a strong technical background across all spacecraft subsystems with particular depth in spacecraft operations, as well as a strong system background spanning both space and ground domains. You will need to be able to dive into broad, minimally-defined design spaces and effectively lead integrated efforts.

· Support technology integration for and development of first-of-kind space vehicles and missions

· Develop and present review packages to internal and external senior leadership

· Work proactively and independently in a fast-paced, demanding atmosphere

· Lead and drive complex system trade studies to closure

· Ensure proper system architecture is in place to support mission objectives

· Lead functional analysis and decomposition for mission activities

· Coordinate with diverse stakeholders to resolve cross-segment issues

· Utilize Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools to capture the system architecture and operational concept

This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at one of the listed location options.

· Master’s degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or chemistry

· 3 years of systems engineering experience

· 2 years of project management experience

· Strong oral, written, and visual communication skills

· Experience working with cross-functional teams and external customers

· Experience in spacecraft, launch vehicles, or highly autonomous unmanned systems

· Experience with spacecraft mission operations

· Experience with applying Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) to space programs

· Broad knowledge across spacecraft subsystems

· Experience with spacecraft ground development

Ardent Mills insists on hiring talented individuals looking to cross train in multiple areas within the Mill operation. The Bulk Plant Loader (Night Shift) reports to the Production Supervisor and will be expected to carry out all their activities with reliability, integrity, compliance in a safe, environmentally responsible, and efficient manner.

To succeed, you must be able to:

  • Deliver results in first-time situations by inspiring others and working to earn trust every day.

  • Serve others with understanding, respect, and care.

  • Operate with simplicity, clarity and transparency.

  • Deal with and drive change.

  • Organize, prioritize and own multiple tasks while meeting or exceeding deadlines.

  • Learn and apply new technology, and share your knowledge with others.

Above all you will be expected to carry out all your activities with reliability, integrity, compliance and in a safe, environmentally responsible, and efficient manner.

Your responsibilities:

  • Perform as lead person as needed.

  • Must be a self-starter and work as a team player.

  • Must have excellent planning and organization skills.

  • Responsible for understanding and following all personnel and equipment safety policies; all GMP, HACCP, Sanitation policies; following all Business Unit policies and procedures.

  • Must be trained in the performance of Preventative Maintenance.

  • Understand written customer specifications and blend flour to meet customer specifications.

  • Analyze flour with lab instruments. Safely operate lab analytical instruments.

  • Must have good computer skills.

  • Enter data into plant control system for record keeping. Create COA as needed.

  • Must have good communication skills for interaction with CSR’s, truck drivers and railroad switch crew and all other employees.

  • Be available for overtime as required for daily and weekend operations of the plant.

  • Assist in operations on an as needed basis as directed by the Production Supervisor.

  • Actively participate in department meetings and facility teams relating to the improvement of plant safety, quality, innovation and efficiency.

  • Perform any tasks reasonably assigned.

Essential skills and experience:

  • Follow verbal and written instructions (English).

  • Communicate with peers and supervisors (English).

  • Basic computer skills and have the ability to learn new software for production.

  • Climb ladders (both step and extension).

description:

  • Strong scientific writing and communication skills.
  • Ability to prepare research results for presentation and publication.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and collaboratively within a research team.

Experience and Education:

  • Master’s degree in atmospheric science, chemistry, physics, or a closely related discipline.

description:
Join EmergeOrtho as a Physical Therapy Technician - Hiring Now in the Blue Ridge Region!

EmergeOrtho is committed to being the trusted leader in innovative, quality-focused comprehensive musculoskeletal care. The Physical Therapy Technician supports both the Physical Therapist and their Assistant in planning and implementing patient care. The Technician is responsible for administering physical therapy modalities of treatment under the direct supervision of the Physical Therapist. The primary functions of this role include assisting with patient preparation before treatment, responding to patients’ requests for assistance while performing the exercise program, and maintaining the equipment used during the treatment session. Additional responsibilities include maintaining patient confidentiality, cleaning, and sterilizing treatment areas, performing laundry services, and clerical tasks as requested.

Why Join EmergeOrtho?

Whether you're a recent graduate or an experienced technician, we welcome your passion for helping patients recover and thrive. Be part of a team that values your skills and supports your professional journey - apply today and help shape the future physical therapy!

Qualifications and Experience

  • High school diploma required
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required
  • Previous experience in an orthopedic clinic setting preferred
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and prioritize multiple tasks and demands
  • Ability to maintain composure when confronted with stressful situations
  • Ability to establish and maintain an effective working relationship with co-workers, providers, and patients
  • Strong customer orientation
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following

  • Maintain adequate knowledge base regarding precautions for the patient undergoing physical medicine services and treatments
  • Manage and operate equipment safely and correctly
  • Observe patients during therapy sessions to assess their progress, noting any challenges they may be experiencing
  • Prepare patients for treatment by helping them get into position on treatment tables
  • Prepare equipment and supplies necessary for treatment sessions
  • Communicate patients’ progress or any concerns about their health status to the supervising Therapists

From the mountains to the coast, EmergeOrtho is North Carolina’s premier provider, recognized for offering world-class, comprehensive, and compassionate care serving patients with 60 locations in 28 counties. As the largest physician-owned orthopedic practice in the state and the 6th in the country, EmergeOrtho’s medical team includes upwards of 170 highly trained orthopedic specialists and nearly as many advanced practice providers. Our subspecialty orthopedic teams offer advanced expertise in conditions of the bones, muscles, and joints. Providing multiple locations, extensive orthopedic services including therapy, and focusing on continuity of care are among the top priorities of EmergeOrtho. title: Agentic AI Engineer Intern
description:
Corteva Agriscience™ is seeking innovative and highly motivated students to join our Research & Development organization as an AI Engineering Intern for our 2027 Summer Internship Program in Indianapolis, IN.

As artificial intelligence continues to transform scientific research, Corteva is expanding the use of AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and agentic workflows to accelerate discovery and decision-making across our R&D portfolio. This internship offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI deployment, helping to design, optimize, and scale AI-powered solutions that support research teams across the organization.

The selected intern will contribute to the development and governance of our growing AI ecosystem by organizing reusable agent capabilities, supporting Model Context Protocol (MCP) server deployments, and improving the efficiency of AI agent operations. A key focus of this role will be evaluating and optimizing LLM token consumption, helping reduce operational costs while maintaining high-quality agent performance.

This position provides hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, agent orchestration frameworks, enterprise AI infrastructure, and real-world R&D applications.

What You’ll Do:

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of scientists, engineers, data scientists, and software developers to support AI-driven research initiatives.
  • Assist in the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of AI agents and supporting infrastructure.
  • Organize, document, and manage reusable AI resources, including MCP servers, agent Skills, prompts, and tool integrations.
  • Analyze LLM usage patterns and identify opportunities to improve token efficiency, response quality, and operational cost management.
  • Develop dashboards, metrics, and reporting processes to monitor agent performance, utilization, and effectiveness.
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of agentic workflows that automate research and business processes.
  • Support testing, evaluation, and continuous improvement of AI agents across multiple R&D use cases.
  • Participate in the development of best practices, governance standards, and documentation for enterprise AI systems.

What Skills You Need:

  • Currently enrolled as a full-time student at an accredited college or university.
  • Pursuing a Master’s, or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience with Python programming and software development fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with machine learning, large language models, generative AI, or natural language processing concepts.
  • Experience working with data analysis, APIs, or cloud-based technologies (AWS, Azure).
  • Have the right to work in the U.S. without restriction.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar agent frameworks.
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), agentic AI concepts, or AI orchestration platforms.
  • Experience working with AWS, or other cloud computing environments.
  • Knowledge of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, or AI evaluation methodologies (e.g. MlFlow, sandbox environments).
  • Experience using Git, DevOps practices, and collaborative software development workflows.

Behind every smile is a highly skilled professional with deep expertise and an unwavering dedication to what matters most — caring for the health and well-being of people and communities across the greater Phoenix area.

Responsibilities:



JOB SUMMARY

The Coordinator Clinical Research I manages day-to-day execution of clinical trials across the research institute. Position provides clinical data support for the conduct of clinical research at HonorHealth Research Institute. The position works closely with all Research Staff to collect, store and maintain data in accordance with FDA Regulations, International Council of Harmonization, and Good Clinical Practices.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Assists in the coordination and management of inpatient and outpatient studies, according to protocol and sponsor amendments. Provides clinical management project support for multidisciplinary clinical research, including patient screening for study eligibility, obtaining informed consent and subject registration. Collects, verifies, organizes and records clinical information and data in case report forms. Abstracts data from necessary sources to complete all forms to the required quality. Performs the following data related activities: CRF tracking, reviewing validation, updating, SAE reconciliation, lab data reconciliation and safety coding. Assists with subject follow-up for clinical protocols. Works with the research team to track study progress and may be involved in the development of periodic status reports. May assist with the preparation of annual reports and statistical information on clinical research as required by the Institute, System. IRB, or investigators.
  • Assists with the creation and implementation of tools to continuously improve team’s performance. Communicates department’s measurable improvements and positive trends to management. Assists with team guideline adherence to timely preparation of study documents, data entry and data locks. Participates in tracking and reporting of workload and progress. Assists in development and implementation of departmental operation procedures. Represents coordination team in study feasibility, implementation, and close out activities. May assist in creation of business development proposals by supplying data and or patient management related information. Maintains communication flow through the term of the study.
  • Assists with obtaining all reports and submits data forms and materials according to protocol requirements. Identifies the achievement of key milestones such as draft or final database. Provides assistance as needed to peer to ensure that study deadlines are met. Mentoring and training on new systems and programs applicable to the coordinator role. Provides support to Research Staff in execution of pharmaceutical or investigator initiated clinical protocols within scope of role. Handles and labels samples and ships samples according to protocol requirements.
  • Maintains communication with the Research Staff regarding regulatory and safety issues as well as any concerns that reflect upon Good Clinical Practices. Provides input and assistance to the Research Staff in maintaining the Regulatory Binders for all ongoing research studies in accordance with FDA regulations and sponsor requirements. Maintains working relationships with external customers (e.g. professional research organizations and physicians).
  • Assists leadership with conduct of monthly quality check of data recorded and submitted. This may include verification of proper documents of clinical data, deviations within a specific time period. Assists with identification and documentation of regulatory and protocol deviation findings. Analyzes findings and communicated possible solutions to leadership. May be involved in verification of proper reporting of events, including IRB reporting. Performs other related duties as assigned.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • High School Diploma or GED Required
  • Bachelors Preferred

title: Remote Full-Stack Engineer (Backend-Focused)
description:
Description

Our client is a seed-stage enterprise software company building an AI-native ERP platform for defense manufacturing. Founded in 2025, the company has raised $12M and grown to a 15-person team tackling the operational and financial systems behind mission-critical hardware production. This is a ground-floor opportunity to build a clean-slate product in a sector seeing generational investment.

We are hiring a backend-focused Full-Stack Engineer to architect the data models, APIs, and services behind new finance and accounting modules. You will bring domain knowledge from ERP, fintech, or accounting software, own meaningful greenfield work from design through deployment, and help expand the platform from operational inventory and supply-chain management into a complete financial reporting system.

What you'll do

- Design data models for invoicing, payments, P&L reporting, and other complex financial workflows

- Build client-facing APIs that connect the platform with HR, payroll, accounting, and other external systems

- Architect backend services in Python and FastAPI with PostgreSQL, choosing thoughtfully between OLAP and OLTP approaches

- Aggregate operational data with labor, subscription, and finance inputs to produce reliable reporting

- Own substantial features end-to-end, from technical design and schema decisions through deployment and iteration

- Contribute to the React frontend when needed while maintaining primary ownership of backend systems


Requirements

What we're looking for

- 3 to 7 years of backend or full-stack engineering experience building production systems, with 5+ years preferred

- Mastery of Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and GraphQL

- Experience at an ERP, fintech, or accounting software company, including data modeling for invoicing, payments, or financial reporting

- Strong schema design skills and a practical command of OLAP versus OLTP trade-offs

- A track record of driving greenfield features from design to deployment, not only maintaining existing systems

- Fluency with accounting and finance concepts and the ability to collaborate directly with domain stakeholders

Bonus points

- Experience designing clean, client-facing APIs for integrations with HR, payroll, or accounting tools

- Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, React, or WebSockets

- Experience working in defense technology or manufacturing software


Benefits

Compensation and work model

- Base salary of $170K to $230K, with potential flexibility for exceptional candidates

- Competitive early-employee equity

- Full-time position

- Open to candidates based in the United States, with a preference for the West Coast

- Remote employees attend quarterly team on-sites in San Diego

- Candidates based in San Diego work in the office three days per week

- Visa sponsorship is not available;
candidates must be US citizens or green card holders

title: Inventory Control & Material Handling Technician
description:
Summary

The Inventory Control & Material Handling Technician performs a variety of procurement and manual duties in the operation of the Facilities department and for the Piedmont Triad Airport Authority (PTAA). An employee in this role is responsible for tasks such as identifying vendors, obtaining prices, maintaining and updating facility and maintenance records, and ordering, receiving, sorting, issuing, and organizing materials and equipment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identify vendors and suppliers, obtain price quotes, and place orders in accordance with PTAA purchasing policy
  • Complete requisition and order forms
  • Inventory materials and supplies in a warehouse-type environment, determine when to reorder as necessary, and initiate purchase requests
  • Receive, store, and issue equipment, materials, and supplies to employees
  • Load and unload supplies and materials
  • Operate necessary equipment to support a variety of facilities and warehouse-type functions, such as a forklift, computer, vehicle, etc.
  • Organize supplies into specific bins or assigned areas and make necessary records and entries in the inventory system
  • Conduct periodic physical inventory of the contents of the facility
  • Maintain detailed and accurate records of the flow of materials and supplies throughout the facility
  • Maintain equipment used in the operation of the facility and physically clean the facility storage areas
  • Participate in snow removal operations
  • Perform a variety of maintenance tasks when needed
  • Other duties as assigned

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Considerable knowledge of general facilities operations and related organizational purchasing policies and practices
  • Considerable knowledge of the materials, parts, and supplies needed in Facilities operations
  • Considerable knowledge of the occupational hazards involved and the safety precautions necessary to operate large equipment
  • Experience with the methods, tools, and equipment used in the assigned trades
  • Demonstrated ability to follow established policies and procedures
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain, record, and keep accurate records
  • Demonstrated ability to operate computer, forklift, cell phone, two-way radio, and other office and warehouse equipment
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with vendors, suppliers, and coworkers
  • Demonstrated ability to perform some mechanical functions
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve problems in a timely manner; gather and analyze information skillfully; develop alternative solutions; work well in group problem-solving situations
  • Demonstrated ability to operate motorized equipment of various types and sizes
  • Demonstrated ability to understand and follow oral and written instructions
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent initiative
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate courteously with the public, coworkers, and supervisors

Minimum Requirements

  • High school or equivalent, associate’s degree, or trade education and 3+ years of relevant experience required
  • Ability to obtain a forklift operator’s certification (specific to PTAA) when hired
  • Final candidates must pass a pre-employment drug-screening test and fit-for-duty examination
  • Hold and maintain valid U.S. driver's license with 3 years of verifiable driving history

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Possess a degree from an accredited college or university
  • Proficiency in Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)
  • Ability to use a scissor lift, bucket truck, pallet jack, etc.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

  • This position requires grasping, stooping, squatting, kneeling, crouching, reaching, pushing, lifting, walking, standing, talking, hearing, seeing, and other repetitive motions when performing tasks and for extended periods of time
  • This position requires the ability to exert up to 100 lbs. of force occasionally, up to 50 lbs. of force frequently, and/or 20 lbs. of force constantly to move objects
  • Adequate vision, hearing, range of motion, and speech required
  • Ability to operate in an environment with frequent interruptions from people and or noises, which in return could result in some level of stress, fatigue, or strain
  • Ability to operate outdoors in all seasons and occasionally extreme temperatures
  • Ability to work at heights sometimes exceeding 40 feet

description:

Full time

Description:

Saint Alphonsus Health System is seeking a dynamic, community-centered leader to serve as President, Eastern Oregon, overseeing Saint Alphonsus Medical Center - Ontario, a regional hospital with approximately 49 licensed beds, and Saint Alphonsus Medical Center - Baker City, a 25-bed critical access hospital. Maintain awareness of new industry developments and standards. Provides decision support, operations &/or optimization leadership focus.

​

title: Intern - Oncology Medical Affairs
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world.   • Support medical and scientific projects by conducting literature reviews, summarizing clinical evidence, and assisting in the development of scientific materials, presentations, and educational resources for internal and external stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3-6 months previous internship, research, clinical, or laboratory experience

  • 2 years of undergraduate coursework completed by the start of the internship.
  • 1 year experience reviewing scientific literature, conducting research, or analyzing data in an academic or laboratory setting.
  • 1 year experience with scientific publications, poster presentations, or medical communications.

Additional Job Standards:

  • Interest in oncology, molecular diagnostics, precision medicine, or Medical Affairs.
  • Maintains professionalism, including punctuality, accountability, and appropriate conduct in a corporate healthcare environment.
  • Exhibits strong attention to detail and accuracy when reviewing scientific literature, preparing materials, and completing assigned projects.
  • Shows initiative, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to learn new scientific concepts, technologies, and business processes.
  • Works effectively both independently and as part of a cross-functional team under general supervision.
  • Communicates clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing, with internal stakeholders.
  • Actively participates in training and development opportunities and applies newly acquired knowledge to assigned responsibilities.
  • Demonstrates strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Maintains confidentiality and handles sensitive scientific and business information appropriately.
  • Approaches challenges with a positive attitude, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize and communicate scientific and medical information clearly.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment while also completing independent projects.

Join Labcorp’s 2027 Global Internship Program and take the first step toward a meaningful career in healthcare innovation! The Medical Affairs team serves as the scientific and clinical bridge between Labcorp Oncology's diagnostic testing portfolio and the healthcare professionals, researchers, and industry partners we support. title: Classified Cybersecurity Analyst
description:

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. In rapidly changing global security environments, Northrop Grumman brings informed insights and secure technological solutions to enable strategic objectives. We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we will support yours by expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you will have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career.

The Northrop Grumman CIDO Classified Solutions team is seeking a Classified Cybersecurity Analyst to support information system lifecycle activities. The selected candidate will be required to work on-site, full-time at our Linthicum, MD location.

The responsibilities of this role will include but not limited to the following:

  • Conduct system audits and continuous monitoring activities, covering all security controls, configurations, and operational processes to evaluate the security posture of the information systems.

  • Perform assessments of systems and networks within the networking environment or enclave and identify where those systems and networks deviate from acceptable configurations, enclave policy, or local policy.

  • Perform analyses to validate established security requirements and to recommend additional security requirements and safeguards.

  • Assist in the implementation of the required government policy, make recommendations on process tailoring, and participate in and document process activities.

  • Work within strict program control processes to ensure mitigation of risks and support the Assessment and Authorization (A&A) of systems; this will include process support, analysis, coordination, security certification testing, security documentation, investigations, software research, hardware introduction and release, emerging‑technology research, inspections, and periodic audits.

  • Support the formal Security Test and Evaluation (ST&E) required by each government accrediting authority through pre-test preparations, participation in the tests, analysis of the results and preparation of required reports.

  • Document the results of A&A activities and technical or coordination activities, and prepare the Risk Management Framework body of evidence.

Note: Due to the classified nature of the work being performed, this position does not offer any virtual or telecommute working options. Applicants are encouraged to apply only if they are willing to work on-site, full-time at our Linthicum, MD campus.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree with 0 years of experience, or a Bachelor's degree with 2 years of experience, or an Associate’s degree with 4 years of experience; a High School Diploma/GED with 6 years of experience may be considered in lieu of a completed degree.

  • Candidates must have a current U.S. Government Secret security clearance (at a minimum), to include a closed investigation date completed within the last 6 years, or must be enrolled in the U.S. Government Continuous Evaluation (CE) Program to be considered; maintaining the required security clearance will be a condition of continued employment.

  • Candidates must meet the U.S. Government 8140 requirements for a Cybersecurity Analyst – Security+; the required certification must be maintained as a condition of continued employment.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity or related field.

  • Experience in cybersecurity compliance (ex., Assessment & Authorization under RMF).

  • U.S. Government Top Secret security clearance.

  • Knowledge of security tools such as ACAS, Nessus, Splunk, Trellix, and SCAP.

  • Knowledge of security frameworks and documentation such as NIST, JSIG, DAAG, SSPs, POA&Ms, and SCTMs.

We offer flexible work arrangements, phenomenal learning opportunities, exposure to a wide variety of projects and customers, and a very friendly team environment. At Northrop Grumman, we are on the cutting edge of innovation. Our diverse portfolio of programs means there are endless paths to cultivate your career. We also offer exceptional benefits/healthcare, a 9/80 work schedule, and a great 401k matching program. Come join us!

Primary Level Salary Range: $87,600.00 - $131,400.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

title: DevOps Specialist

emergiTEL is hiring for DevOps Specialist
Location: Edmonton, Remote – Canada (may require onsite meetings in Edmonton up to 15%)
