title: Clinical Trials Project Manager
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview

The Clinical Trials Project Manager provides sponsor level project management and operational leadership for investigator-initiated clinical trials (IITs) and clinical trials conducted through the NCI Experimental Therapeutics Clinical Trials Network (ETCTN) for which the institution and/or investigator has sponsor, coordinating center, or National Principal Investigator responsibilities.

Reporting directly to the Director of Operations, this position serves as the central sponsor level project management resource across the full lifecycle assigned oncology trials. The Project Manager partners closely with Principal Investigators, Clinical Research Managers, regulatory and clinical operations teams, contracting and finance, pre-award, laboratories, external vendors and funders, and participating institutions to move studies from concept and feasibility through activation, conduct, closeout, and required reporting.

The role is responsible for establishing project plans, timelines, milestones, and accountability structures; coordinating cross-functional deliverables; identifying and mitigating operational and administrative risks; and ensuring that sponsor and institutional responsibilities are completed in accordance with applicable regulations, Good Clinical Practice, institutional policies, study-specific requirements, and contractual obligations.

This is a remote position. Job seekers who live within one of Yale’s approved work states are encouraged to apply.

Required Skills and Abilities
1. Ability to manage time effectively and work independently and within a team to meet objectives, with strong attention to detail.
2. Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and the ability to interpret federal, state, local, and sponsor policies and regulations.
3. Ability to hold self and others accountable to achieve timebound results, with a flexible approach to adapting to shifting demands.
4. Demonstrated ability to provide proactive, customer service-focused communication and advice, with a commitment to protecting research participants.
5. Strong computer skills, including competency with Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Preferred Skills and Abilities
1. Proven experience with oncology research.
2. Certification as a Clinical Research Associate or Clinical Research Professional (ACRP, SOCRA, or equivalent) preferred.

Principal Responsibilities

1. Directs and leads the development, implementation, and management of clinical trials processes in compliance with SOPs and relevant regulations; liaise with Clinical Research Manager (CRM) to ensure successful clinical trials conduct. 2. Identifies, tracks and analyzes barriers in current clinical trials processes, and recommends project management process improvements to the AD, Clinical Operations and broader CTO Leadership Team. 3. Organizes and project manages multiple projects and clinical trials, across internal and external teams from start-up to close-out. Acts as an expert resource and the primary liaison between the site and internal/external stakeholders to ensure timely study launch, administrative study maintenance, and closeout in accordance with local, state, and federal regulations, as well as contractual obligations. 4. Collaborates with CRM and Principal Investigator (PI) on assessment and implementation of oncology trials for the research team. Including identifying study activation timelines and metrics, resolving potential discrepancies and/or barriers to enrollment prior to study activation, assessing trial acuity for resourcing purposes, and project managing deliverables across teams to meet deadlines. 5. Works closely with leadership, internal constituents, ancillary committees, External Sponsors, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs) to resolve site-level barriers to activation and improve protocol activation timelines. 6. Designs, develops, and executes communication systems to ensure effective and transparent exchange of information between project stakeholders, including the sponsor, regulatory team, clinical research operations team, pre-award team, contracting team, and Clinical Research Support Laboratory (CRSL). Ensures potential risks and issues related to administrative management of clinical studies are identified, managed, and/or escalated as appropriate to AD Clinical Operations 7. Effectively manages project budgets to ensure financial targets are met through regular reviews of costs and project resources. 8. Coordinates site qualification and site initiation visits. May present information to sponsors and other key stakeholders. 9. Responsible for evaluating and scoring protocols in a staffing acuity tool as part of study activation. 10. Works closely with leadership, internal constituents, ancillary committees, Industry Sponsors, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs) to resolve site-level barriers to activation and improve protocol activation timelines. 11. Determines and provides final approval for local study activation by ensuring all appropriate regulatory and institutional approvals are met, appropriately documented and communicated. 12. Performs other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant academic/scientific field and a minimum of four years of experience in clinical research or an equivalent combination of education or experience.

title: Communications and Engagement Coordinator
description:
We are a values-focused organisation who put the people we support first. Established in 1982 by a group of local parents seeking respite and accommodation for their now adult children, we have expanded exponentially because our participants value and trust our services.

At Community Living Options, we are dedicated to providing an inclusive environment where people are valued and supported. We welcome applicants with lived experience, all abilities, cultural backgrounds, genders, sexualities, ages, and spiritualities.

About the Role

CLO is seeking a creative, strategic, and socially minded Communications & Engagement Coordinator to lead and coordinate our internal and external communications, stakeholder engagement, brand management, and digital presence.

Reporting to the Chief Strategy and Specialist Services Officer, this role plays a key part in strengthening CLO's reputation, promoting our services, supporting organisational growth, and ensuring our communications reflect our commitment to human rights, disability rights, inclusion, and participant voice.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong strategic communication and stakeholder engagement capability with excellent graphic design, content creation, and digital marketing skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and deliver communication and engagement initiatives aligned with CLO's Strategic Plan, organisational objectives, values, and commitment to disability rights and inclusion.
  • Lead the implementation of consistent, accessible, and engaging communications across all channels, including social media, website, newsletters, publications, marketing campaigns, and stakeholder communications.
  • Manage and strengthen CLO's brand identity, ensuring all communications and visual assets align with organisational standards, tone of voice, and strategic priorities.
  • Produce high-quality graphic design and communication materials including reports, presentations, annual reports, newsletters, capability statements, promotional materials, social media content, and digital assets.
  • Provide communication and engagement support to the Chief Strategy and Specialist Services Officer, including executive communications, strategic projects, organisational announcements, tenders, funding submissions, and business development initiatives.
  • Develop compelling stories and content that amplify participant voice, showcase organisational impact, and strengthen stakeholder engagement.
  • Build and maintain positive relationships with stakeholders across the disability, community, government, and corporate sectors, representing CLO at events, forums, consultations, and networking opportunities.
  • Manage CLO's digital communications, including social media platforms, website content, recruitment marketing, and digital campaigns, using data and insights to maximise engagement and reach.
  • Monitor communication performance, analyse metrics, and provide recommendations that improve engagement, brand awareness, and organisational outcomes.
  • Collaborate with leaders and teams across the organisation to ensure consistent messaging, effective information sharing, and a culture of inclusion, respect, and dignity.
  • Lead, support, and coach the Marketing and Communications Officer to deliver high-quality communication outcomes and build capability.

To Thrive, You Will Have

  • Demonstrated experience in communications, stakeholder engagement, marketing, public relations, or a similar role.
  • Strong strategic communication capability with experience developing and delivering communication plans, campaigns, and engagement initiatives.
  • Outstanding written communication skills, including experience preparing executive communications, reports, newsletters, publications, stakeholder updates, and marketing content.
  • Advanced graphic design skills with proficiency in Canva and Adobe Creative Suite, particularly InDesign, and the ability to create professional, accessible, and visually engaging communication materials.
  • Experience managing social media platforms, websites, digital communications, and online marketing campaigns.
  • Ability to translate complex information into clear, engaging, and accessible content for diverse audiences.
  • Experience using communication analytics and performance data to evaluate effectiveness and inform future communication strategies.
  • Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to engage, influence, and collaborate with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.

  • Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • NDIS Worker Screening Check and Working with Children Check, or willingness to obtain
  • Tertiary qualifications in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or a relevant field
  • Must satisfy all visa requirements to work in Australia

  • Ongoing training and development support
  • Salary packaging benefits (up to $15,899 p.a. tax‑free)
  • Discounted gym membership and health insurance

Our Values

  • Trust: We are open and honest. We act with integrity.

title: Medical Coding and Billing Assistant 1
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview

Under the direction of Yale Medicine Administration (YMA) Coding and Billing, the Coding and Billing Assistant 1 is responsible for reviewing all aspects of charge submission for patient clinical services based on coding, documentation review, quality assurance, and compliance guidelines. Reviews charge submissions for compliance with established coding guidelines, all YMA policies and protocols, third party reimbursement policies, Federal payer regulations, and HIPAA guidelines. Performs effective workflow processes to file complete, accurate and timely billing of professional charges, while maintaining productivity to meet lag day expectations. May review and analyze documented medical services to verify accurate documentation and coding of services performed.

Required Skills and Abilities

1. General/intermediate knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, HCPCs and modifier coding, medical terminology, human anatomy, and digital coding resources and software. Ability to analyze and interpret evaluation and management documentation guidelines as well as procedures and applicable coding guidelines.
2. Demonstrated ability with an electronic health record and practice application systems, electronic data entry, and web-based applications and websites. Intermediate proficiency with MS Word, Excel, Outlook (emails and calendars).
3. Demonstrated knowledge of Federal payer regulations, third party payers, HIPAA rules, reimbursement policies and procedures. Proven ability to interpret and apply guidelines.
4. Demonstrated strong interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills. Ability to effectively communicate with team members to resolve questions regarding collaboration and assignments. Communicate effectively with providers, following escalation processes with analytics team and manager.
5. Demonstrated ability to work independently; organize and prioritize own work with minimal supervision; ability to work in a fast-paced environment meeting timely deadlines while maintaining productivity and quality standards. Ability to work effectively as a team member with common goals.

Preferred Education, Experience and Skills

1. Previous Epic experience; experience within an academic medical environment or large multi-specialty practice; CPC certification preferred.

Principal Responsibilities

1. Performs work queue resolution of medical billing charge sessions by reviewing clinical documentation to confirm diagnostic (ICD-10) and procedural (CPT/HCPCS) codes and modifiers, based on charge review edits for Yale Medicine patient clinical services filed to charge review work queues. May perform manual charge entry for non-Epic services. With an ability to navigate within the Professional Billing applications, ensures that all charge review edits are appropriately resolved in charge review work queues utilizing claim judgement and critical thinking skills. Draws valid conclusions to support decisions. 2. May verify all information required to submit a clean claim including provider, place of service, date of service, bill area, all codes and special billing procedures that may be defined by a payer, contract or YMA. Ensures compliance with Teaching Physician guidelines within an academic medical practice. 3. Pends charge sessions to seek corrective action for services not meeting documentation requirements in accordance with YMA policies and procedures. Establishes and cultivates productive relationships among staff to support a positive team environment and professional interactions. Maintains professional and technical knowledge by participating in educational workshops and reviewing professional publications. 5. May perform other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience Four years of related work experience, two of them in the same job family at the next lower level, and high school level education; or two years of related work experience and an Associate’s degree, or an equivalent combination of experience and education. Required License(s) or Certification(s) Certified Professional Coder Apprentice (CPC-A) through AAPC organization. Must maintain certification through annual education requirements and achieve CPC status within 2 years. Preferred Licenses or Certifications Certified Professional Coder (CPC) Physical Requirements Ability to push, pull, and lift in excess of 20 pounds as well as travel around the medical school campus.

Or simply to concentrate on improving the quality of life for the patients who walk through the door.   • Pay Range $45-$50/hr Depending on Experience + Bonus Potential
  • Company paid malpractice insurance

Responsibilities:

  • Consult with patients by reviewing health and medical histories; questioning, observing, and examining patients; and reviewing x-rays, as indicated.
  • Evaluate patients’ neuromusculoskeletal systems and the spine using chiropractic diagnosis to determine neuromusculoskeletal and spine related conditions.
  • Perform manual adjustments to the spine, or other articulations of the body, in order to correct the musculoskeletal system, where necessary.
  • Educate patients on the quality of life benefits of routine chiropractic care. Provide a recommended course of treatment.
  • Maintain accurate case histories of patients.
  • Obtain and record patients' medical histories, as indicated.
  • Arrange for diagnostic x-rays to be taken, when medically necessary.
  • Analyze x-rays to locate the sources of patients' difficulties and to rule out fractures or diseases as sources of problems.
  • Patient chiropractic care and education
  • Building positive doctor-patient relationships
  • Maintaining accurate and timely patient records
  • Sales of membership packages

Qualifications needed:

  • 4-year bachelor’s degree from an accredited college
  • A Doctor of Chiropractic degree from an accredited chiropractic college
  • Passing scores for Parts I, II, III, and IV from NCBE
  • A recent NBCE SPEC exam is an acceptable alternative for Part IV
  • Valid DC license in the applicable state
  • Fully eligible for Malpractice Insurance in the applicable state

About The Joint Chiropractic

The Joint Corp. revolutionized access to chiropractic care when it introduced its retail healthcare business model in 2010. Today, it is the nation’s largest operator, manager and franchisor of chiropractic clinics through The Joint Chiropractic network. The company is making quality care convenient and affordable, while eliminating the need for insurance, for millions of patients seeking pain relief and ongoing wellness. With more than 700 locations nationwide and nearly 11 million patient visits annually, The Joint Chiropractic is a key leader in the chiropractic industry. Ranked number one on Forbes’ 2022 America's Best Small Companies list, number three on Fortune’s 100 Fastest-Growing Companies list and consistently named to Franchise Times “Top 400+ Franchises” and Entrepreneur’s “Franchise 500®” lists, The Joint Chiropractic is an innovative force, where healthcare meets retail. For more information, visit www.thejoint.com.

Business Structure

The Joint Corp. is a franchisor of clinics and an operator of clinics in certain states. In Arkansas, California, Colorado, District of Columbia, Florida, Illinois, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Tennessee, Washington, West Virginia and Wyoming, The Joint Corp. and its franchisees provide management services to affiliated professional chiropractic practices.

You are applying to work with a franchisee of The Joint Corp. If hired, the franchisee will be your only employer. Franchisees are independent business owners who set own terms of employment, including wage and benefit programs, which can vary between franchisees.

Job Description:

Title: Director - Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Location: North America - Remote

Reports to: Vice President - FP&A

J.D. Power is a global leader in consumer insights, advisory services and data & analytics. A pioneer in the use of big data, artificial intelligence (AI) and algorithmic modeling capabilities to understand consumer behavior, J.D. Power has been delivering incisive industry intelligence on customer interactions with brands and products for more than 50 years. The world's leading businesses across major industries rely on J.D. Power to guide their customer-facing strategies.

The Role:

We're seeking a strategic and operationally driven finance leader to serve as the Director of FP&A within J.D. Power. In this role, you will oversee the company's financial planning, forecasting, and analysis processes, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy and operational execution. Working closely with the Vice President - FP&A, CFO, executive leadership, and business unit leaders, you will provide actionable insights that drive growth, improve profitability, and strengthen financial discipline across the organization.

This is a highly visible role requiring deep expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, and performance management, as well as the ability to translate complex financial data into clear, strategic recommendations. A proven track record of leading FP&A teams, influencing executive decision-making, and driving measurable business outcomes is essential.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role:

As the Director of FP&A, you will be the driving force behind financial planning and analysis that fuels J.D. Power's growth and operational excellence. By leading the budgeting and forecasting process, delivering insightful performance reporting, and partnering with business leaders to optimize resource allocation, you will ensure the company's financial strategy is executed with precision. Your work will connect financial insights to strategic decisions-delivering measurable outcomes, enabling growth initiatives, and providing critical guidance that shapes the company's future direction.

What You'll Be Doing in This Role:

Accelerate the financial performance of J.D. Power by:

• Strategic Planning & Forecasting: Lead annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-range planning processes in partnership with executive leadership.

• Performance Reporting: Deliver timely, accurate, and insightful reporting on company performance, KPIs, and trends.

• Business Partnering: Collaborate with business unit leaders to translate operational strategies into financial outcomes and drive accountability.

• Capital Allocation: Provide analysis and recommendations on investments, resource allocation, and growth initiatives.

• Scenario Modeling: Develop and maintain robust financial models to support decision-making and risk management.

• Executive Support: Prepare board-level presentations, investor materials, and executive reports that clearly communicate financial performance and outlook.

• Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing FP&A team, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

• Process Improvement: Drive enhancements in financial systems, reporting tools, and analytical capabilities.

Qualifications of this Role:

• Bachelor's degree required; MBA, CPA, or CFA preferred.

• 10+ years of progressive finance experience, with at least 5 years in FP&A leadership roles.

• Proven track record of influencing executive decision-making through financial insights.

• Strong expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, and performance management.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex data.

• Experience with ERP systems, BI tools, and advanced Excel/financial modeling.

• Willingness to travel occasionally to support global teams and attend executive meetings.

Bilingual Front Office Clerk - Montrose (Job Overview)

Welcome to Legacy Community Health, where you'll be the warm, welcoming face and voice that greets our patients, helping them feel at ease from the moment they walk through our doors or pick up the phone. As a Bilingual Front Office Clerk, you're not just an employee; you're an integral part of our mission to provide quality healthcare to the community.

  • Dynamic Work Environment: Enjoy the variety of floating between all our clinic locations.

Key Responsibilities

Minimum Qualifications

  • Frequently required to sit, occasionally stand, walk, talk, lift up to 25 pounds, bend, twist, climb, and reach.

About Legacy Community Health

As the largest Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) in Southeast Texas, Legacy Community Health has been delivering comprehensive, high-quality, and affordable health care for nearly 40 years. With more than 50 clinics across the Greater Houston and Gulf Coast region, we continue to grow strategically and invest in our communities. By innovating how care is delivered, we've stayed at the forefront of connecting our communities to health—every day, in every way. At Legacy, we know our success is powered by our people. We're always looking for talented, passionate individuals who want more than a job—they want a meaningful career that makes a real impact. Explore our open positions and see if a career at Legacy is right for you.

At Legacy Community Health, our mission—Driving healthy change in our communities—guides everything we do. To fulfill this mission, every team member is expected to embody the following core attributes in their daily work, regardless of role or department:

Approachable & Collaborative

We bring our expertise without ego. In a collaborative healthcare environment, humility fosters trust and teamwork. Our employees value diverse perspectives, seek input from others, and are unafraid to acknowledge when they need help. We stay grounded in our purpose: to serve patients and communities with compassion and humility.

Driven & Committed

We are driven by a deep commitment to excellence in patient care and organizational improvement. Our employees take initiative, embrace challenges, and go the extra mile to support our mission. Whether improving patient outcomes, streamlining processes, or stepping up in times of need, we are always striving to drive healthy change—within ourselves, our teams, and the communities we serve.

They communicate clearly and respectfully with patients, families, and colleagues, building trust and fostering a safe, inclusive environment for all.

title: Associate Dara Analytics
description:
Career Category

Engineering

Job Description

ABOUT AMGEN

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Role Description:

The Associate, Data Strategy & Governance will be responsible for analyzing, monitoring, and improving the quality of enterprise data across data platforms, migration programs, and business processes.

This role will perform advanced data profiling and validation, identify data anomalies and quality gaps, lead the investigation of data defects, and partner with business and technology teams to implement sustainable remediation solutions. The individual will also contribute to the development of enterprise data quality standards, controls, metrics, and reusable practices.

The successful candidate will bring strong analytical and technical capabilities, hands-on experience with enterprise data quality tools, and the ability to work independently across multiple stakeholders and complex data environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform in-depth data profiling and analysis to proactively identify data anomalies, inconsistencies, completeness issues, and data quality gaps.

  • Translate data analysis findings into actionable recommendations for data cleansing, remediation, enrichment, and preventive controls.

  • Define, document, and implement data quality rules, validation checks, thresholds, and monitoring requirements based on business and technical requirements.

  • Collaborate with Data Engineers and platform teams to embed automated data quality checks within data ingestion, transformation, and migration pipelines.

  • Document data quality issues, remediation actions, root causes, business impacts, and resolution status in a clear and traceable manner.

  • Develop comprehensive data quality reports, dashboards, metrics, and insights for business and technology stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the development and continuous enhancement of enterprise data quality standards, best practices, methodologies, templates, and reusable artifacts.

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual data validation, reconciliation, profiling, and reporting processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

  • Support data migration and transformation programs by validating source-to-target data, reconciliation results, and business-critical data attributes.

  • Promote consistent adoption of data quality practices across projects, platforms, and data domains.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline.

  • Typically, 3-5 years of professional experience in Data Quality, Data Management, Data Engineering, Data Governance, or a related area.

  • Hands-on experience performing data profiling, data validation, data quality rule implementation, data remediation, and data quality issue management.

  • Experience using enterprise data quality tools such as SODA, Collibra Data Quality, Ataccama, Informatica Data Quality, or equivalent platforms.

  • Proficiency in SQL, including experience writing and optimizing complex queries for large-scale datasets.

  • Experience working with cloud and modern data platforms, including Amazon S3 and Databricks.

  • Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, validation, automation, or data quality rule development.

  • Experience performing root-cause analysis and resolving complex data quality defects across integrated data environments.

  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical findings clearly and concisely to both technical and business audiences.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing advanced data quality capabilities such as data observability, anomaly detection, automated data monitoring, or augmented data quality.

  • Experience applying artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities to data profiling, rule recommendation, issue detection, or data quality remediation.

  • Working knowledge of the Databricks platform, including notebooks, workflows, Delta Lake, or Unity Catalog.

  • Experience developing data quality dashboards or reports using Power BI.

  • Experience with Collibra Data Catalog, data governance workflows, business glossaries, metadata management, or data lineage.

  • Experience working in the life sciences, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry.

Core Competencies

  • Drives Results: Takes ownership of deliverables and consistently produces accurate, timely, and high-quality outcomes.

  • Manages Ambiguity: Effectively analyses incomplete or complex information and develops practical approaches to resolve data challenges.

  • Decision Quality: Uses data, analysis, and sound judgement to make well-informed recommendations.

  • Collaborates: Builds effective relationships across business, data, engineering, governance, and project teams.

  • Communicates Effectively: Presents complex data quality findings in a clear, concise, and stakeholder-appropriate manner.

  • Cultivates Innovation: Identifies opportunities to automate processes and apply modern data quality capabilities.

  • Ensures Accountability: Maintains clear ownership, documentation, traceability, and follow-through for data quality issues.

  • Instils Trust: Demonstrates integrity, transparency, reliability, and attention to detail.

Expected Outcomes

  • Improved accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of enterprise data.

  • Earlier identification and resolution of data defects within migration and data engineering pipelines.

  • Increased automation of data profiling, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring activities.

  • Consistent implementation of enterprise data quality standards and reusable controls.

  • Clear visibility of data quality risks, root causes, remediation actions, and business impacts.

  • Stronger collaboration between business, data governance, engineering, and technology teams.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request and accommodation.

title: Operationeel Buyer Interim
description:
This is how you make impact

As an Operational Buyer, you play a key role in ensuring the continuity of our operations by securing the timely and cost-effective supply of goods and services. You are responsible for executing day-to-day purchasing activities in line with established procedures, quality standards, budgets and business requirements.

In this role, you manage purchase orders, coordinate closely with suppliers, monitor delivery performance and support inventory availability. You proactively identify and resolve issues related to lead times, shortages, pricing or quality, working collaboratively with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers to achieve the best possible outcome.

You continuously balance business needs, supplier performance and operational priorities to ensure materials and services are available when needed, contributing directly to efficiency, customer satisfaction and overall business success.

This is what you bring to the team

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, enjoys solving problems, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. You know how to balance priorities while maintaining a high level of quality and service.

We also ask for:

· MBO+/Bachelor's degree level of working and thinking, preferably in Logistics, Procurement, or Business Administration.

· Strong communication skills in Dutch and English; German is considered an advantage.

· Good proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

· Preferred qualification: NEVI 1 (Netherlands).

Interested?

We are looking for an independent contractor (ZZP), not through an agency, who is available for an assignment of approximately 3 to 6 months.

If this opportunity sounds interesting, we'd love to hear from you! Please apply with your CV and a short motivation outlining your experience and suitability for the assignment. We kindly ask you to include your availability, expected hourly rate, and any additional information that may help us assess your application.

Your daily responsibilities include

· Process purchase order suggestions for orders/order forms and approved requisitions into purchase orders in the ERP system, taking account of price, delivery lead time and packaging unit, based on existing contracts with preferred suppliers.

· Ensure accurate and timely order placement to meet operational needs.

· Monitor and track order statuses, ensuring on-time deliveries.

· Handle order modifications, cancellations or escalations when needed.

· Check and process order confirmations from suppliers.

· Come up with alternative products and/or suppliers in consultation with Senior Buyer in case of shortages.

· Put rescheduling messages and cancellations into effect. If necessary, adjust priorities in consultation with Planning.

· Deal with invoice discrepancies within competence/authority.

· Arrange logistic handling of problems (including quality problems).

RESULT AREA’S

· Continuity : No production stoppages due to timely availability of materials

· Quality: Delivered goods meet the agreed specifications

· Cost control: Orders are placed within agreed price arrangements and budgets

· Delivery reliability: Suppliers deliver according to the agreeds deadlines

· Availability of materials in accordance with the agreed terms of delivery

· Provide material availability information

· Complain timely about discrepancies.

· Solve problems with material or alternatively, escalate timely (in line with escalation model).

· Ensure that NPIs are followed up timely.

title: Controller
description:
BUILT FROM GRIT. POWERING WHAT’S NEXT.

In 2016, we launched Conductor Power to compete harder, move faster, and step boldly into renewable energy. Today, under second-generation leadership, every member of our team has been intentionally chosen for their skill, dedication, and shared vision. Together, we combine proven high-voltage expertise with forward-focused Solar EPC and electrical services - setting the pace for the next era of utility innovation. And we’re just getting started.

Now, we’re building what’s next.
And we’re looking for you.

Why This Role Matters

At Conductor Power, you won’t just take a job - you’ll help power communities, strengthen infrastructure, and advance America’s renewable energy future.

From substations to solar EPC projects, our work is critical, complex, and built to last.

Job Summary:

Conductor Power is seeking an experienced, hands-on Controller to lead the day-to-day accounting and financial operations of a growing, multi-entity organization. Reporting directly to the CFO, the Controller will lead the accounting team and be responsible for the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of the Company's financial information. This role will oversee the monthly and annual close process, financial reporting, daily treasury and cash management, multi-entity and intercompany accounting, consolidations, tax compliance support, internal controls, and construction/project accounting.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting knowledge with a hands-on, business-minded approach. This individual will be comfortable working in the details while also improving processes, developing the accounting team, strengthening financial controls, and helping build scalable infrastructure to support the Company's continued growth. This position may be performed remotely; however, candidates located near Baxter, Minnesota, or able to spend meaningful time at the Company's headquarters are preferred.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

The Controller is responsible for the direct supervision, leadership, and development of a team of two accounting professionals. This includes assigning and prioritizing work, providing guidance and support, monitoring performance and workload, conducting performance feedback and evaluations, and supporting professional development. The Controller will foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team while ensuring accounting responsibilities are completed accurately and timely.

Duties/Responsibilities:

Accounting Operations & Financial Close

  • Lead and manage the day-to-day accounting operations for Conductor Power and related entities.
  • Manage, develop, and provide leadership to Senior Accountants and support staff while helping build a scalable and high-performing accounting function.
  • Own and continuously improve the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close process, including management of the close calendar, account reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, and financial reporting.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of entity-level and consolidated financial information.
  • Oversee core accounting processes, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, accruals, and other balance sheet accounts.

Multi-Entity Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Lead accounting activities within a multi-entity environment, including intercompany accounting, reconciliations, settlements, eliminations, and consolidated reporting.
  • Support financial reporting requirements for management, ownership, lenders, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain strong balance sheet management practices and ensure timely and accurate account reconciliations.

Treasury, Cash & Financing

  • Lead daily treasury and cash management activities, including cash positioning, banking activity, liquidity monitoring, and support for cash forecasting.
  • Support accounting and reporting for debt, lines of credit, investments, and other financing activities in partnership with the CFO.

Construction & Project Accounting

  • Lead and support construction and project accounting, including work-in-progress, percentage-of-completion accounting, project costs, revenue recognition, job margins, and estimates to complete.
  • Partner closely with Operations, Project Management, Procurement, Project Controls, and other business leaders to ensure accurate project financial information and identify opportunities for improved processes and controls.

Tax, Controls & Compliance

  • Support sales and use tax, gross receipts tax, and other state and local tax compliance requirements.
  • Work with the CFO and external tax advisors to support federal and state income tax compliance and reporting within an S-Corporation and multi-entity environment.
  • Establish, maintain, and improve accounting policies, procedures, internal controls, and financial processes.

Systems, Process Improvement & Leadership

  • Serve as a key finance leader in improving and optimizing the Company's ERP and financial systems, reporting capabilities, and accounting workflows.
  • Partner with the CFO and leadership team on special projects, process improvements, and other strategic Finance initiatives.
  • Develop and strengthen accounting processes, controls, reporting capabilities, and infrastructure to support continued organizational growth.

Powering You Forward

  • Medical insurance
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Life, AD&D insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Time Off

Extras that Make a Difference: Weekly Cell Phone Allowance; Eligible for CP's Bonus Program

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience.
  • Prior experience in a Controller, Assistant Controller, Accounting Manager, or similar accounting leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and improving the monthly financial close process and preparing or reviewing financial statements.
  • Experience working in a multi-entity environment with intercompany accounting, reconciliations, and/or consolidated financial reporting.
  • Experience leading and developing accounting professionals.
  • Experience with daily cash management and treasury operations.
  • Experience with sales and use tax, gross receipts tax, or other multi-jurisdictional indirect tax requirements.
  • General understanding of corporate income tax and entity structures, including S-Corporation environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CPA or other advanced accounting credentials.
  • Construction, engineering, project-based, or similar industry accounting experience.
  • Direct experience with work-in-progress and percentage-of-completion accounting.
  • Experience with NetSuite or another modern cloud-based ERP system.
  • Experience participating in an ERP implementation, optimization, enhancement, or significant finance systems improvement initiative.
  • Experience supporting a growing organization with multiple legal entities and increasingly complex financial reporting requirements.

Physical Requirements:

  • Primarily sedentary work when working in the office. Occasional lifting, carrying, walking, and standing; frequent hand/eye coordination to operate computer keyboard and office equipment; vision for reading, recording, and interpreting information; speech communication and hearing to maintain communication with employees and other team members.
  • When visiting a job site, the ability to move around project sites, which may involve walking, climbing stairs, and navigating uneven terrain.

Travel:

  • This position may be performed remotely within the United States. Candidates located near Baxter, Minnesota are encouraged to work from Conductor Power's headquarters on a regular basis.
  • Candidates located outside the Baxter area may be required to travel to the Company’s headquarters as needed to support business priorities and the Company’s growth.
  • Occasional travel to project and job sites may be required to better understand the Company's operations, build relationships with operational teams, and identify opportunities for financial and process improvement.

Ready to Build What’s Next?

If you’re driven, dependable, and ready to power something bigger than yourself - we want to hear from you.

title: Sociaal Psychiatrisch Verpleegkundige (SPV) Dichtbijteam Gouda
description:
Een bijzonder moment om in te stappen

Wil jij als SPV werken op het snijvlak van psychiatrie, het sociaal domein en de leefwereld van de cliënt?

In september start GGZ Rivierduinen in Gouda met een nieuwe manier van werken. Binnen onze Dichtbijteams brengen we ambulante psychiatrie, specialistische poliklinische zorg, ouderenpsychiatrie en jeugdexpertise samen.

We brengen de zorg dichter bij de cliënt en organiseren deze integraal, herstelgericht en in verbinding met het netwerk.

Voor het Dichtbijteam Gouda zoeken we een Sociaal Psychiatrisch Verpleegkundige (SPV) die graag outreachend werkt, makkelijk verbinding maakt en energie krijgt van complexe situaties.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. Het ene moment ben je bij een cliënt thuis, het volgende moment overleg je met een huisarts, gemeente of andere ketenpartner. Daarna bespreek je met collega's wat er nodig is om de behandeling verder vorm te geven.

Welke uitdaging ga je aan?

Als SPV begeleid en behandel je cliënten met ernstige en complexe psychische problematiek. Je werkt zoveel mogelijk in de leefomgeving van de cliënt en helpt hen om, binnen hun mogelijkheden, de regie over hun leven terug te krijgen en te behouden.

Je kijkt daarbij verder dan de psychiatrische klachten alleen.

Wat speelt er thuis? Hoe gaat het met wonen, werk, financiën en daginvulling? Wie zijn belangrijk voor de cliënt? Welke ondersteuning is al aanwezig en waar zijn nog verbindingen nodig in het netwerk?

Jij houdt het overzicht en brengt mensen en organisaties bij elkaar en bent daarmee een belangrijke verbindende schakel tussen de cliënt, diens netwerk, het sociaal domein en de verschillende zorgprofessionals.

Dit ga je doen als SPV:

  • Je behandelt cliënten met complexe en veelzijdige psychische problematiek, waarbij somatische, cognitieve, systeem- en sociaal-maatschappelijke factoren vaak een rol spelen;

  • Je begeleidt cliënten gedurende het volledige zorgproces, van netwerkintake en diagnostiek tot behandeling en afronding;

  • Je combineert behandeling, zorgcoördinatie, consultatie en netwerkcontacten in een afwisselende en veelzijdige functie;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega's in een multidisciplinair team en draagt actief bij aan het behandelbeleid;

  • Je neemt deel aan de crisisdienst buiten kantoortijden.

  • Je neemt deel aan de crisisdienst, die buiten kantooruren wordt uitgevoerd.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een SPV die graag zelfstandig en outreachend werkt en energie krijgt van complexe situaties. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar wat er achter de hulpvraag zit, kunt goed luisteren en weet tegelijkertijd wanneer er actie nodig is. Je bent een echte netwerker en vindt het vanzelfsprekend om verschillende mensen en organisaties met elkaar te verbinden.

Verder beschik je over:

  • een diploma hbo-Verpleegkunde;

  • een (bijna) afgeronde opleiding tot Sociaal Psychiatrisch Verpleegkundige (SPV);

  • een geldige BIG-registratie als verpleegkundige;

  • een rijbewijs en de beschikking over een auto.

Ervaring met ambulant werken is mooi meegenomen, maar vooral jouw nieuwsgierigheid, verbindende vermogen en motivatie om dichtbij cliënten te werken vinden we belangrijk.

Waar ga je werken?

Je gaat werken in het nieuwe Dichtbijteam Gouda. Verschillende expertises werken hier nauw samen. We kijken naar de cliënt als geheel: psychische klachten, dagelijks leven, persoonlijke doelen, relaties, netwerk en mogelijkheden.

De zorg vindt plaats waar deze het meest passend is: op een locatie van GGZ Rivierduinen, bij de cliënt thuis of op een andere plek in de leefomgeving.

Met het Dichtbijteam willen we zorg dichter bij cliënten organiseren, versnippering verminderen en expertise beter verbinden. Wil je meer weten over onze Dichtbijteams? Klik dan op deze link: Dichtbijteams - Werken bij GGZ Rivierduinen

Wat krijg je van GGZ Rivierduinen?

  • Direct een vast dienstverband voor 24 tot 36 uur per week, afhankelijk van jouw wensen;

  • Een maandelijkse beloning tussen de € 4.544,- en € 5.901,- op basis van een 36-urige werkweek (FWG 60 conform CAO GGZ);

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering 8,33% van het bruto jaarsalaris;

  • 8.33% vakantietoeslag, 166 vakantie-uren en 35 LFB-uren per jaar (bij een fulltime dienstverband);

  • Reis- en onkostenvergoeding;

  • Een pensioenregeling bij pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn;

  • Meerkeuze systeem arbeidsvoorwaarden (bijvoorbeeld voor de aankoop van een elektrische fiets of het kopen van extra verlofdagen);

  • Keuze uit twee aantrekkelijke collectieve ziektekostenverzekeringen;

  • Jaarlijks een balansbudget van maximaal €1000,- , om te zetten naar extra verlofuren of uit te betalen als bruto loon; Indien ingezet voor opleiding, bedraagt het €1.400 op voltijdsbasis.

  • Opleiding en ontwikkeling via onze Rivierduinen Academie waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt tot het volgen van zorginhoudelijke scholingsprogramma's voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Meer weten?

Je bent van harte welkom. Een nieuwe baan kies je niet zomaar. Daarom vinden we het belangrijk dat jij een goed beeld krijgt van de functie, het team en onze organisatie. Heb je vragen of wil je eerst vrijblijvend kennismaken voordat je solliciteert? Neem hiervoor contact op met Dennis van Putten, manager algemene zaken via 06-48142141of stuur een mail naar d.vanputten@rivierduinen.nl.

Heb je vragen over de procedure? Neem gerust contact op met Kimberley van Beugen, recruiter, via 06 13318415 of k.vanbeugen@rivierduinen.nl.

title: Evidence Synthesis and Global Education Liaison Librarian
description:
Position Highlights

Application review will begin on October 12, 2026.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Research & Instruction Services, the Research & Evidence Synthesis Liaison Librarian will establish, coordinate and anchor RIT Libraries’ new evidence synthesis service by providing expert methodological guidance, protocol development and reproducible search strategies for large-scale literature reviews. This position will support the academic and grant-writing needs of faculty, graduate students, and staff through expert consultations, advanced instruction, comprehensive literature searches and end-to-end project workflow support across multiple disciplines and colleges.

This position will collaborate with colleagues across RIT Libraries and campus to design and deliver instruction, workshops, and consultations related to data literacy and responsible uses of AI in research and scholarship with an emphasis on conceptual understanding, appropriate tool selection, and responsible practice. The position will maintain awareness of evolving research, teaching, and publishing trends across disciplines and translate that awareness into responsive library services, instructional offerings and resource development.

This position also provides reference, research services, outreach and instruction to students, staff and faculty at RIT’s global campuses including RIT Dubai, RIT Croatia and RIT Kosovo by building collaborative partnerships across global campuses to ensure equitable access to research tools and instruction. The position will develop topical and subject specific guides and incorporate innovative technologies and instructional technologies to enhance student learning and student success.

Additional responsibilities include:

  • Provide end-to-end project management and methodological guidance for systematic reviews, scoping reviews, protocols, grant proposals and evidence-based guidelines.

  • Design, execute, and promote high-quality comprehensive, reproducible, database-specific search strategies, including gray literature sources.

  • Co-author, collaborate, or serve as a consultant on interdisciplinary research projects and grant proposals.

  • Guide researchers on the ethical use of AI tools and LLMs in literature reviews, research, and scholarly publishing.

  • Ensure best practices for the documentation, reporting, and transparency. Mentor and train library colleagues in evidence synthesis methods, search standards and best practices.

  • Stay current with emerging developments in evidence synthesis, open scholarship, research data management, AI applications and dissemination strategies.

  • International travel to the global campuses (approximately one trip per year on a rotating basis) may be required.

  • Occasional weekend and non-traditional shifts will be required to accommodate time zone differences.

Additional Skills needed for this position

  • Expertise in research methodology.

  • Demonstrated experience with conducting primary research.

  • Expertise in evidence synthesis search methodologies, guidelines, and standards (ex., those recommended by Cochrane, Campbell, the Collaboration for Environmental Evidence, PRISMA, ROSES).

  • Familiarity with evidence synthesis project management tools such as: Covidence, DistillerSR, Rayyan, or others.

  • Demonstrated experience designing and executing complex, multi-database search strategies.

  • Familiarity with citation management tools (e.g., Zotero, EndNote).

  • Knowledge of ethical AI use and reproducible research practices.

  • Experienced with the application of AI/LLMs in research workflows.

  • Strong pedagogical and cross-cultural communication skills to deliver engaging training and outreach across multi-campus, diverse populations.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Assists students and university community members fulfill their research needs at service points
  • Serves as a liaison for programs to promote two-way communications regarding library services, policies, and user concerns
  • Provides informed selection, maintenance, and weeding of books, serials, databases, and other appropriate materials based on the curricular and research needs of the colleges of the programs listed
  • Collaborates with faculty to provide curricular support and instructional sessions that support pedagogy and learning outcomes
  • Develops relevant subjection and course-specific guidance and tutorials to assist students
  • Stays current of new and emerging tools and technologies
  • Other duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Knowledge of major online information services
  • Knowledge of data administration principles and practices
  • Skill in assessing and integrating appropriate complex technologies into the collection and instruction programs
  • Skill in organizational and time management
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to audiences with a wide range of technical skills
  • Demonstrated initiative, creativity, and a strong commitment to teaching, learning, collaboration, and public service
  • Ability to work independently or to collaborate productively across multidisciplinary teams, colleges, and academic programs
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

Minimum Education & Experience

  • MS/MLS from ALA-Accredited Institution or Master's degree in related field
  • 2 years of relevant experience
  • An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered

Job Level Overview

Specialized Contributor Level 2 - A fully functional role requiring established knowledge of the profession or field of work. Responsible for completing substantive assignments and projects. Problems are varied and non-routine, and resolution requires exercising judgment, analysis, advisement, creativity, and understanding broader sets of issues. title: Psychiatrisch verpleegkundige poli Ouderen Voorhout
description:
Welke uitdaging ga je aan?

Ben jij een betrokken en zelfstandige professional die graag het verschil maakt voor ouderen met psychiatrische kwetsbaarheden? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Voor de Dagbehandeling Ouderen in Voorhout zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste verpleegkundige of GGZ-agoog.

De Dagbehandeling Ouderen biedt specialistische behandeling aan ouderen met uiteenlopende psychiatrische problematiek. Samen met een multidisciplinair team ondersteun je cliënten bij het versterken van hun zelfredzaamheid, het vergroten van hun kwaliteit van leven en het behouden van regie over hun dagelijks functioneren.

In een warme en professionele omgeving begeleid je groepen en individuele cliënten. Je hebt oog voor de unieke levensfase en levensgeschiedenis van iedere cliënt en sluit aan bij hun persoonlijke behandeldoelen. De behandeling richt zich onder andere op het bieden van structuur, psycho-educatie, herstelondersteuning, het versterken van copingvaardigheden en het bevorderen van sociale contacten. Zo draag je bij aan een veilige en stimulerende omgeving waarin cliënten kunnen werken aan hun herstel en welzijn.

En verder?

  • Begeleid en ondersteun je cliënten binnen het dagbehandelingsprogramma;

  • Lever je een actieve bijdrage aan het opstellen, uitvoeren en evalueren van behandelplannen;

  • Begeleid je groepsactiviteiten en therapeutische onderdelen van het programma;

  • Werk je nauw samen met collega's, naasten en ketenpartners rondom de cliënt;

  • Denk je mee over de verdere ontwikkeling en kwaliteit van de zorg binnen de dagbehandeling ouderen.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent een betrokken en enthousiaste zorgprofessional met affiniteit voor ouderenpsychiatrie. Je begeleidt graag groepen, hebt oog voor de individuele cliënt en draagt bij aan een veilige en herstelgerichte behandelomgeving. Met jouw professionele en positieve houding ondersteun je cliënten bij het vergroten van hun welzijn en zelfredzaamheid.

Verder beschik je over:

  • een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Verpleegkunde (met BIG-registratie) of Social Work (GGZ-agoog);

  • affiniteit met ouderen en de GGZ;

  • Werk je graag met groepen en beschik je over goede communicatieve vaardigheden;

  • ervaring met groepsbehandeling een pré.

Waar ga je werken?

Bij de polikliniek Ouderen in Voorhout wordt de ouderendoelgroep behandeld met psychiatrische ziektebeelden waarbij levensfaseproblematiek, cognitieve problematiek en/of somatische co-morbiditeit een rol speelt. De poli is goed gepositioneerd in de regio met locaties in Leiden, Voorhout, Lisse en Katwijk, waardoor wij een duurzame samenwerking hebben opgebouwd met onze ketenpartners.

Binnen de poli Ouderen van GGZ Rivierduinen werken we samen met o.a. psychiaters, psychologen, vak-therapeuten en verpleegkundigen. Om de juiste zorg te bieden aan alle cliënten werken we op basis van gelijkwaardigheid en vertrouwen. Het uitgangspunt van al onze behandelingen is om samen met de cliënt te werken aan de weg naar herstel. Als het gezien de ziekte en de leeftijd niet meer mogelijk is om volledig te herstellen, willen we cliënten zo goed mogelijk in staat stellen om de regie over hun leven te behouden.

Wat krijg je van GGZ Rivierduinen?

  • Een jaarcontract voor 24 uur per week, met zicht op een vast dienstverband;

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.560- en €4.716,- bruto op basis van een 36-urige werkweek (FWG 50 conform CAO GGZ, afhankelijk van opleiding);

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering 8,33% van het bruto jaarsalaris;

  • 8,33% vakantietoeslag, 166 vakantie-uren en 35 LFB-uren per jaar (bij een fulltime dienstverband);

  • Reis- en onkostenvergoeding;

  • Een pensioenregeling bij pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn;

  • Meerkeuze systeem arbeidsvoorwaarden (bijvoorbeeld voor de aankoop van een elektrische fiets of het kopen van extra verlofdagen);

  • Keuze uit twee aantrekkelijke collectieve ziektekostenverzekeringen;

  • Jaarlijks een balansbudget van maximaal €1000,- , om te zetten naar extra verlofuren of uit te betalen als bruto loon; Indien ingezet voor opleiding, bedraagt het €1.400 op voltijdsbasis;

  • Opleiding en ontwikkeling via onze Rivierduinen Academie waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt tot het volgen van zorginhoudelijke scholingsprogramma's voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Meer weten?

Heb je vragen of wil je meer informatie? Neem gerust contact op met Tessa Hagendijk, recruiter via 06 57422913 of stuur een mail naar t.hagendijk@rivierduinen.nl

Goed om te weten; onze sollicitatieprocedure omvat een referentiecheck en bij indiensttreding vragen we om een verklaring omtrent het gedrag (VOG).

GGZ Rivierduinen

GGZ Rivierduinen biedt geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz) aan mensen van alle leeftijden met ernstige psychische klachten en hun naasten. Onze 2.100 collega’s helpen zo’n 15.000 cliënten in de regio’s Alphen aan den Rijn, Duin- en Bollenstreek, Gouda, Leiden, Leidschendam en Zoetermeer. We hebben onder andere poliklinieken, wijkteams, acute zorg, klinieken, verblijfsafdelingen, dagbesteding en een specialistische afdeling voor eetstoornissen.

Onze bevlogen medewerkers zijn het kloppende hart van Rivierduinen. Daarom geven we je de ruimte om werk te doen dat bij je past. Wil je doorgroeien? Met opleidingen en onderzoek neem je zelf de regie over je ontwikkeling. Jouw vakkennis is onmisbaar in de samenwerking met cliënten, hun naasten, collega’s en ketenpartners. Zo maak jij het verschil!

title: URGENT: Adobe Enterprise Architect L1 (100% Remote) (LATAM ONLY)
description:
About the Engagement

AllShore Talent is supporting a large Adobe implementation initiative requiring experienced professionals across Content Supply Chain, Experience Platform & Digital Marketing, and Program & Delivery workstreams.

This is a high-priority, multi-resource engagement supporting complex Adobe implementations across enterprise environments.

Resources will work as part of distributed delivery teams supporting architecture, implementation, integration, configuration, data, marketing technology, analytics, operations, and program delivery.

Because of the scale and pace of the program, candidates should be comfortable working within cross-functional teams, collaborating remotely, and contributing quickly within established project environments.

Due to the critical nature and urgency of this hire, we are unable to accommodate extended notice periods, such as 30 days.

If you are not immediately available or cannot start within a short timeframe, please let the recruiter know whether you would be able to engage on a part-time basis while completing your notice period. For example, you may be able to support 20 hours per week during morning hours until you are available to transition to full-time.

Please be as specific as possible about your availability so we can determine whether an interim arrangement may be feasible.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly senior Enterprise Architect to support Adobe Professional Services engagements across complex enterprise environments.

This is a strategic, client-facing architecture role for professionals operating at the Senior Enterprise Architect, Lead Architect, MSA Architect, Principal Architect, or equivalent level.

The ideal candidate has strong experience leading digital transformation, enterprise architecture, MarTech, DXP, or cloud-native programs and is comfortable advising senior customer stakeholders, including CMOs, CIOs, CTOs, and other executive leaders.

Strong Adobe Experience Cloud experience is highly preferred, but Adobe certification is not required. We are also open to senior architects from adjacent DXP, MarTech, and cloud-native environments where the architecture experience is clearly transferable.

This is a long-term opportunity supporting client engagements that may run 1 to 3 years.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead enterprise architecture across large-scale digital transformation initiatives.

  • Define current-state, future-state, and multi-year architecture roadmaps.

  • Translate business objectives into scalable enterprise technology strategies.

  • Architect solutions across Adobe Experience Cloud, DXP, MarTech, cloud, data, CRM, content, identity, and enterprise platforms.

  • Design composable, API-first, microservices-based, and cloud-native architectures.

  • Lead architecture from discovery and solution design through implementation and delivery.

  • Define integration patterns across Adobe and external enterprise systems.

  • Establish architecture standards, governance models, technical guardrails, and reusable patterns.

  • Advise senior customer stakeholders on architecture decisions, trade-offs, and recommended paths forward.

This role is to support a new factory in Prince George, VA (onsite) startup manufacturing large form-factor equipment. Amgen requires that all individuals applying for an undergrad internship or a co-op assignment at Amgen must meet the following criteria:

  • Interest or coursework in NLP, time-series analysis, or statistical modeling
  • Familiarity with version control tools (e.g., Git) and collaborative coding practices

title: Sr. Director, Oncology and AP, Supply Chain Operations
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives. Apply today!

Labcorp is seeking a Senior Director, Oncology & AP Supply Chain Operations to lead the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of end-to-end supply chain operations supporting Anatomic Pathology (AP), Molecular Diagnostics, and Oncology testing services.

This leadership role oversees the flow of specimens, reagents, consumables, and laboratory materials across patient service centers, pre-analytical operations, histology, cytology, molecular diagnostics, and genomic testing environments, ensuring operational excellence, quality, regulatory compliance, and reliable support for precision oncology programs.

This is an exciting opportunity for a supply chain leader who understands the critical role laboratory operations play in delivering timely, accurate patient results. We welcome professionals with backgrounds in histotechnology, cytotechnology, anatomic pathology, molecular diagnostics, laboratory operations, logistics, or healthcare supply chain management who are passionate about transforming complex operational networks into scalable, efficient, and patient-focused solutions.

Work Schedule

This is a full‑time, exempt (salaried) position assigned typically Monday through Friday, with occasional evening, weekend, and on-call responsibilities. This hybrid schedule includes a minimum of three in-office days per week in Burlington, NC supporting both collaboration and flexibility. Up to 50% travel, including domestic and international. Primarily office-based with occasional work in laboratory environments.

Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan. Employees who are regularly scheduled to work a 7 on/7 off schedule are eligible to receive all the foregoing benefits except PTO or FTO. For more detailed information, please click here.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute strategic plans for Oncology and AP supply chain operations, including process standardization across patient services, pre-analytics, logistics, and laboratory supply chain functions.
  • Ensure an optimized specimen supply chain from collection through result reporting by improving people, processes, systems, and financial performance.
  • Influence supply chain operational strategy and financial performance while ensuring key business objectives and targets are achieved.
  • Lead the development and utilization of operational analytics, forecasting models, and performance dashboards to identify risks, optimize specimen flow, and improve service levels.
  • Oversee operational due diligence and integration activities for mergers and acquisitions within the AP and oncology space.
  • Drive organizational effectiveness through talent development, succession planning, employee engagement, and leadership development initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with quality systems, regulatory requirements, and industry standards supporting laboratory operations.
  • Partner across laboratory, operational, commercial, and executive leadership teams to drive enterprise-wide improvements and innovation.
  • People leader of up to 5 direct reports

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Clinical Laboratory Science, Supply Chain, Business, Biological Sciences, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience leading laboratory, healthcare, supply chain, logistics, or related operations, including at least 2 years at the Director level with responsibility for leading leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • 2+ years of experience supporting oncology, molecular diagnostics, precision medicine, anatomic pathology, or related laboratory operations.
  • 2+ years of direct or indirect People Leadership experience – talent development, performance management, etc.
  • Demonstrated experience driving operational excellence, process improvement, financial performance, organizational change, compliance, and quality initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (MBA, MHA, MS, or related discipline).
  • Histotechnologist (HT/HTL) or Cytotechnologist (CT) background with a strong interest in operational leadership, supply chain strategy, or laboratory logistics.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting histology, cytology, anatomic pathology, oncology, molecular diagnostics, or genomic testing workflows.
  • 3+ years of experience in diagnostics, healthcare, laboratory operations, supply chain, logistics, or other complex operational environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end specimen, reagent, consumable, or laboratory material supply chains.
  • 2+ years of experience utilizing Lean, Six Sigma, ISO, or other continuous improvement methodologies to improve operational performance.
  • Demonstrated success influencing stakeholders and leading large-scale cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of AP laboratory operations, specimen lifecycle management, quality systems, and regulatory requirements.

Additional Job Standards

  • Strategic leadership with the ability to translate vision into measurable results.
  • Strong analytical, financial, and problem-solving capabilities with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Expertise in supply chain operations, laboratory operations, and regulatory compliance.
  • Ability to lead through change, drive innovation, and manage complex operational environments.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence across all organizational levels.
  • Commitment to fostering inclusive, high-performing teams.

title: Meetings & Membership Coordinator
description:
Raybourn Group International Meetings & Member Services Coordinator

Raybourn Group International (RGI) is looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused membership coordinator to join our Indianapolis office. This role serves as a key point of contact, helping members access resources, manage their accounts, and stay engaged. You will also support various programs, process orders, assist with reporting, and provide general administrative support.

Why Join Us?
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, handling a variety of responsibilities, and making a meaningful impact in a member-focused organization. If you’re looking for a role where no two days are the same and where you can build relationships while keeping operations running smoothly, we’d love to hear from you!

We are proud of our employee-driven culture at RGI and have been named as Best Places to Work in Indiana for five consecutive years!

RGI helps nonprofit organizations, trade groups, and professional societies run smoothly and grow. Instead of hiring their own staff, these organizations hire us to handle important tasks like planning events, managing finances, organizing membership programs, marketing, and social media. We also help with big-picture planning, leadership support, and professional development programs. Our team takes care of the day-to-day operations so our clients can focus on their mission and serving their members.

This position requires in-office work so fully remote staff will not be considered. Staff may work up to two days per week at home. Overnight travel (by plane or car) may be required to attend a multi-day annual conference (one week a year or less).

Key Responsibilities:

Events and Webinars

  • Coordinate all aspects of registration system including set-up, managing registrations, and assisting attendees before and during meetings.
  • Coordinate logistics for virtual and in-person events, including food & beverage, hotel logistics, AV, etc.
  • Work with volunteers to secure and confirm conference speakers and collect speaker information and session materials. Communicate with speakers regarding AV and logistics.
  • Serve as host and moderator for online webinars.
  • Regularly communicate with exhibitors and sponsors regarding logistics, registratiosn, and other exhibitor/sponsor benefits.
  • Maintain event supply inventory.
  • Prepare reports and track event-related information.
  • Manage registration and onsite operations for annual conference and in-person workshops.

Member Support

  • Welcome new members and guide them through the onboarding process.
  • Respond to member questions by phone and email.
  • Keep membership records updated in the database.
  • Track member engagement and help with special recognition programs.
  • Assist with certification and accreditation program administration.
  • Assist members with accessing and using association programs, resources, and technology platforms.

Administrative Support

  • Provide basic bookkeeping support, including invoicing and reporting.
  • Help prepare for volunteer meetings by organizing materials and managing follow-ups.
  • Assist with general office and team support tasks.

Who You Are:

  • Friendly and helpful with strong customer service skills.
  • Comfortable with technology and learning new tools.
  • Good at keeping track of details and juggling multiple tasks.
  • Able to communicate clearly and professionally in writing and on the phone.
  • Experienced with administrative tasks and using data to support your work.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience working with nonprofit associations or membership-based organizations.
  • Customer service experience.
  • Meeting planning experience.
  • Familiarity with customer or membership databases.

Travel and Work Schedule: Daily work hours are 8 a.m. – 5 p.m. This is a hybrid position that will work in the office 3 days a week and may work from home up to 2 days per week.

This position will also provide onsite support at two annual conferences. This requires working longer hours and the ability to stand and walk for extended periods during events and move materials weighing up to 25 pounds. Travel to association events in Indiana is required, up to 7 days per year. Facilitation and set-up of in-person events may require arriving before 7 am or working until 6 p.m (3-4 times per year).

While it is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, management reserves the right to modify, add or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.
