title: Security Associate
description:
Title: Security Associate

Reports to: Store Manager

Status: Hourly Non-Exempt

Position Summary:

The Security Associate helps maintain a safe and welcoming environment for employees, customers, and company property. This position serves as a visible deterrent to theft and unsafe behavior by monitoring store entrances, conducting regular patrols of the sales floor and parking lot, observing suspicious activity, documenting incidents, and promptly reporting concerns to store management and law enforcement when appropriate.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • · Provide a highly visible security presence at the front entrance and throughout the store.
  • · Monitor front and side entrances to help deter merchandise push-outs and other theft-related activity.
  • · Conduct routine patrols of the sales floor, exterior walkways, and parking lot to identify safety and security concerns.
  • · Observe, document, and promptly report suspicious activity, theft, vandalism, or safety hazards to store management.
  • · Monitor surveillance cameras and security equipment to assist with loss prevention and incident investigations.
  • · Complete accurate incident reports and maintain daily activity logs.
  • · Assist with emergency situations by following company emergency procedures and directing customers and employees when necessary.
  • · Work closely with store management and law enforcement during investigations when appropriate.
  • · Promote a safe, professional, and customer-friendly environment while maintaining excellent customer service.
  • · Follow all company policies regarding theft deterrence, safety, and the appropriate level of response to security incidents.

Performance Expectations

A successful associate will:

  • · Maintain a visible presence to deter theft and promote a safe shopping environment.
  • · Protect company assets while delivering exceptional customer service.
  • · Follow all company policies, procedures, and legal requirements.
  • · Build positive relationships with store associates and management.
  • · Respond professionally to incidents with safety as the top priority.
  • · Accurately document and report all incidents in a timely manner.

This position requires professionalism, integrity, sound judgment, and the ability to balance security responsibilities with outstanding customer service in a fast-paced retail environment.

Qualifications:

  • · Previous experience in security, military, law enforcement, loss prevention, or a related field is strongly preferred.
  • · Strong observational skills, attention to detail and situational awareness.
  • · Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in stressful situations.
  • · Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • · Basic computer skills and the ability to operate surveillance and security systems.
  • · Ability to walk, stand, and patrol for extended periods and work both indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • · High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • · CPR, First Aid, or other security-related certifications are a plus.

Benefits:

  • · Competitive pay
  • · Comprehensive benefits package
  • · Paid Time Off and holiday pay for full-time employees
  • · Employee discount
  • · Flexible scheduling

Offer Description

Applications are invited for a temporary post of a Research Data/ML Engineer within UCD School of Politics and International Relations, Connected\Politics Lab, RINN AI UCD.

The Research Data/ML Engineer will lead the retrieval, evaluation and machine-learning research that determines the accuracy and trustworthiness of the answers produced by the EURVISTA platform and will operate and extend the platform's live data pipelines. The post exists to provide dedicated specialist expertise in retrieval optimisation and language-model evaluation that cannot be delivered by the project's development team alone.

The post holder will design and optimise the retrieval architecture, evaluate embedding models, benchmark query-response accuracy against a target above 90%, calibrate confidence scoring and implement hallucination mitigation. They will also prototype and validate statistical and predictive models over the platform's legislative datasets and operate and extend daily automated ingestion across European Parliament, Council of the EU and European Commission sources.

The post reports to the Principal Investigator and works alongside a Senior Full-Stack Developer and a Junior Developer (UI/UX). The role carries no supervisory or budgetary responsibility.

Applications must be submitted by the closing date and time specified. Any applications which are still in progress at the closing time of 12:00 noon (Local Irish Time) on the specified closing date will be cancelled automatically by the system. UCD are unable to accept late applications.

UCD do not require assistance from Recruitment Agencies. Any CV's submitted by Recruitment Agencies will be returned.

Machine learning, Natural language processing, Large language models, Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Embeddings and vector search, Python, Data engineering and ETL, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain

  • A primary degree in computer science, data science, machine learning, statistics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Excellent communication skills (oral, written, presentation).
  • Excellent organisational and administrative skills, including a proven ability to work to deadlines.

Candidates must demonstrate an awareness of equality, diversity, and inclusion (EDI).

title: Health Plan Health Coach
location: Saint Agnes Medical Center - Fresno, California
description:
Employment Type:

Full time

Shift:

Description:

Reporting to the Director CVHP Operations, CVHP Operations, this position is responsible for working closely with health plan member clients, physicians, pharmacists, and physician office staff, via phone, internet, in person and/or through group seminars, and distribution of health education materials to promote wellness. The incumbent is responsible for advising and counseling on the important requirements for a healthy lifestyle, working with clients to identify health risk factors and manage chronic illness, and motivate individuals to realize their optimum health potential. This position also advises and counsels on the important requirements of Medicare STARS, Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS), and Hierarchical Condition Categories (HCC) with provider staff to identify health risk factors and gaps in quality of care. The incumbent will interface with clients using motivational interviewing and reflective listening skills in order to develop an understand of barriers to meeting health related goals, develop a client specific wellness plan, set goals for health improvement, and monitor goal attainment. The incumbent will coordinate services with other health-related departments and organizations for optimal patient care and satisfactory outcomes.

REQUIREMENTS

1. Bachelor’s degree in Nursing, Health Education, or related field is required. High school diploma or equivalent and current licensure as a Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) in the State of California and three (3) years of experience as an LVN may substitute for the degree requirement.
2. Three (3) years of experience working in health promotion, chronic illness management, or other clinical population health field is required. Experience in an ambulatory care setting is preferred.
3. Knowledge of specific disease and lifestyle related topics such as smoking cessation, weight management, nutrition, pre/post-natal care, stress reduction and chronic conditions is required.
4. Proficiency in compilation of statistical reporting, computer skills (spreadsheets, word processing, database), and effective written and verbal communication skills are required.
5. Demonstrated ability to function independently, strong organizational skills and flexibility are required.
6. Ability to develop positive working relationships with a wide variety of individuals is required.
7. Experience in quality and/or data analysis is required.
8. Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish is required.
9. Experience with Electronic Health Record preferred.
10. Certification from an accredited professional wellness coach training program is preferred.

Pay Range $29.25 - $40.95

title: Production Planner II
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

** On-site at our Prince George, VA facility. **

This role is to support a new factory in Prince George, VA (onsite) startup manufacturing large form-factor equipment. The product will be large (shipping container size), heavy (50+ tons), and complex. This position will be part of the core factory startup and onboarding team responsible for building the operations and manufacturing staff, fitting out the building, and creating the process flow/work instructions/etc. from the ground up. Skills to include: panel and point to point wire assembly, Medium Voltage, Low Voltage, and High Power Electronic assemblies.

Work Authorization: This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.

Job Summary
The Production Planner II is responsible for developing and executing an achievable two-week production schedule to support customer demand, ensure material readiness, and meet on-time delivery goals. This role works closely with the Master Planner, Manufacturing, Purchasing, and Inventory teams to optimize production flow and minimize disruptions.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain production schedules aligned with the Master Production Schedule (MPS).
  • Release and manage planned orders to support production requirements.
  • Monitor material readiness and identify shortages through regular clean-to-start reviews.
  • Partner with Purchasing to expedite materials and resolve supply issues impacting production.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing and the Master Planner to adjust schedules, optimize run quantities, and minimize changeovers.
  • Support on-time delivery through effective schedule management and production follow-up.
  • Coordinate readiness reviews for new product introductions and engineering changes.
  • Manage ECN, deviation, and purge processes.
  • Maintain planning-related data, documentation, and packout systems.
  • Ensure shipments are routed correctly and support sales order maintenance as required.
  • Develop a strong understanding of product flow and manufacturing operations.
  • Participate in regular meetings and cross-functional discussions to support production objectives.
  • Follow all company safety, security, and operational procedures.

Qualifications

  • HS Diploma required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 2-5 years of production planning, manufacturing planning, or scheduling in manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with SAP and ERP/MRP systems; knowledge of production planning and material planning processes
  • Strong communication, collaboration, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across Planning, Manufacturing, Purchasing, and Operations teams.
  • Production Planner experience, electronics manufacturing experience, understanding of manufacturing processes and production flow, and APICS/CPIM certification or inventory control experience are highly preferred.

The pay range for this role is $65,500 - $117,900. Job-related, non-discriminatory factors used to determine the actual offered rate include qualifications and experience, geographic location, education, external market data, and consideration of internal equity.

Position Overview
Accenture is seeking an experienced Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) / AWS Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain automated AWS data pipelines supporting analytics, KPI reporting, and business intelligence.
This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong experience with AWS data services, Python, SQL, ETL, and API integrations. The engineer will integrate data from multiple enterprise applications and APIs, transform and model that data within AWS, and make it available for KPI reporting and dashboards.
The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering capabilities with enough business intelligence experience to understand how the data will ultimately be consumed by business stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable AWS data pipelines.
  • Develop automated ETL/ELT processes using AWS services.
  • Integrate data from multiple REST APIs, SaaS applications, and enterprise systems.
  • Work with Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Redshift and/or Athena, Lambda, and IAM.

  • Build integrations with platforms such as Jira, Smartsheet, Qualtrics, or similar systems.
  • Develop analytical datasets supporting operational reporting and business KPIs.
  • Design and maintain dashboards using Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, Power BI, or similar BI tools.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to define KPIs, reporting requirements, and data definitions.
  • Implement data quality, monitoring, security, and access-control practices.
  • Apply data governance principles including IAM, security, access controls, and data-retention policies.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline, API integration, performance, and data-quality issues.
  • Document data sources, integrations, transformations, dependencies, and reporting logic.
Required Qualifications
  • 5–8 years of Data Engineering, Business Intelligence Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related experience.
  • Strong hands-on AWS data engineering experience.
  • Strong experience with Amazon S3 and AWS Glue/ETL.
  • Experience with Amazon Redshift and/or Athena.
  • Experience with AWS Lambda and IAM.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Strong Python development skills for data engineering and automation.
  • Proven experience building automated data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating multiple REST APIs or SaaS applications.
  • Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, pagination, error handling, and automated ingestion.
  • Experience defining or supporting business KPIs and analytical datasets.
  • Experience with Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, Power BI, or comparable BI/dashboard technology.
  • Understanding of data governance, security, access controls, and retention requirements.
  • Ability to work onsite in Redmond, WA, five days per week.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Direct API integration experience with Jira, Smartsheet, or Qualtrics.
  • Experience with multiple BI platforms, including Tableau, QuickSight, or Power BI.
  • Experience consolidating data from multiple enterprise systems into centralized analytical datasets.
  • Experience working in large enterprise or consulting environments.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into technical data solutions.

title: Information Security Engineer (Cloud) - Contract
description:
Numeris is Canada’s most trusted and authoritative source for broadcast measurement and consumer behaviour data. As well, the industry leading intelligence provider to broadcasters, advertisers, and agencies. We have been recognized for over 75 years as providing the gold standard in audience intelligence.
We have great people who do exceptional work. We take pride in building an environment of continuous learning and career advancement opportunities. Our teams are collaborative, curious, and dedicated to creating quality experiences. We love what we do, enjoy each other’s company, and support initiatives to give back to our communities. We are looking for people to help us shape the future of Numeris, and have a lot of fun along the way.

Numeris is seeking a hands-on Cloud Security Engineer to build, configure, tune, and operate our security technologies, with a primary focus on Microsoft 365 E5.

This is a deeply technical role, not a deployment coordination or project management position. You will work directly in the platforms, investigate security events, write queries and automation, troubleshoot controls, and continuously improve our security capabilities across Microsoft 365, Azure, and AWS.

What you will do

  • Engineer Microsoft Security Controls

    • Build, configure, and tune Microsoft Entra ID controls, including Conditional Access, identity governance, privileged access, and authentication security.
    • Review access requests, exclusions, and security exceptions from a technical risk perspective.
    • Configure and maintain Microsoft Intune security baselines, compliance policies, endpoint controls, and automated workflows.
    • Operate and optimize Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Identity, Office 365, and Cloud Apps.
    • Configure and tune Microsoft Purview DLP, information protection, and compliance controls.
    • Troubleshoot control failures, integration issues, and gaps in security coverage.

      • Detect and Respond to Threats

      • Write and maintain KQL queries, Microsoft Sentinel detections, analytics rules, dashboards, and workbooks.
      • Build automated response playbooks and SOAR workflows.
      • Perform alert triage, technical investigations, containment, remediation, and post-incident analysis.
      • Analyze logs, endpoint activity, identity events, email threats, and cloud activity.
      • Participate in a rotating on-call schedule for security incidents and escalations.

        • Manage Vulnerabilities and Cloud Risk

        • Operate vulnerability scanning and security assessment tools.
        • Analyze findings, prioritize risks, and verify that remediation is effective.
        • Monitor Azure and AWS for misconfigurations, excessive permissions, compliance gaps, and emerging threats.
        • Configure and improve Cloud Security Posture Management capabilities.
        • Work directly with infrastructure teams to resolve technical security issues.

          • Automate and Improve

          • Use PowerShell and/or Python to automate repetitive security tasks and operational workflows.
          • Integrate security platforms and improve the quality of security data and alerts.
          • Test new features and determine how they can strengthen security operations.
          • Work with vendors when specialized technical support or platform expertise is required.
          • Conduct technical security assessments of third-party architectures and services.
          • Administer KnowBe4 phishing simulations and security awareness campaigns.

What you have

  • Required Experience

    • At least five years of hands-on experience in security engineering, cloud security, security operations, or a related technical role.
    • Demonstrated experience directly configuring and operating Microsoft 365 E5 security technologies in an enterprise environment.
    • Strong experience with security monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, and vulnerability management.
    • Experience writing KQL queries and developing Microsoft Sentinel detections.
    • Experience automating security tasks using PowerShell and/or Python.
    • Experience securing and monitoring AWS environments.
    • Experience implementing or operating a Cloud Security Posture Management solution.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

      • Technical Expertise

      • Microsoft Entra ID
      • Microsoft Intune
      • Microsoft Defender suite
      • Microsoft Sentinel and KQL
      • Microsoft Purview
      • Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance
      • Azure and AWS security
      • AWS IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, and AWS Config
      • PowerShell and/or Python
      • Incident response and vulnerability management

        • Preferred Certifications

        One or more of the following would be an asset:

        • Microsoft SC-200, SC-300, or SC-100
        • CISSP
        • AWS Certified Security – Specialty

What's in it for you?

  • Be part of an evolutionary journey in the audience measurement and data space; work on exciting projects, add value & make a positive impact to our Company.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package (Health, Dental, Vision and Personal Spending Account - employer paid premiums).

  • Flexible Work location (on-site offices in Toronto and Montreal, remote – work from home, hybrid as required per role).

  • Continuous learning and development via Percipio, our Learning Management System.

  • Be part of additional programs such as MentorMe, which helps our employee’s network, and grow within the organization.

  • Leadership Training offerings for new and emerging leaders.

  • Culture of great teams, coworkers and supportive leadership.

  • Perkopolis: Participation in a program that provides exclusive discounts on products and services to employees. Perks include shopping discounts, movie tickets, services, event/show tickets and much more!
Values

Stronger Together:

We succeed through collaboration with each other and with the industry. Unity drives our impact.

Innovation with Intent:

We embrace change and challenge convention. Our innovation is purposeful, driven by insights, guided by strategy, and focused on delivering meaningful future-proofed solutions.

People First:

We prioritize the well-being, growth and voices of our people. We actively listen, support development, and create space where everyone can succeed.

Excellence in Motion:

We pursue continuous improvement in everything we do, from our processes to our time to market. With a growth mindset and a commitment to excellence, we bring solutions to life with precision and purpose.

title: Intern – Financial Analytics & Technology
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a Financial Analytics & Technology Intern to join our Financial Analytics Team.

Work Schedule:

Days/Hours: Monday–Friday / 40 hours per week

Job Responsibilities:

  • Deliver a defined summer project focused on analytics, automation, business intelligence, process improvement, or emerging technology.

  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and business insights.

  • Develop visualizations, dashboards, presentations, or reporting solutions that support decision-making.

  • Partner with financial analysts, business leaders, and technical teams to understand business requirements.

  • Evaluate opportunities to improve efficiency through automation, technology, or AI-enabled solutions.

  • Support projects involving operational and financial analytics, business intelligence, data quality, process improvement, and reporting optimization.

  • Explore automation opportunities, AI, and emerging technology use cases.

  • Present project results and recommendations to department leadership at the conclusion of the internship.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Current enrollment in a Bachelor’s degree program.

  • Working towards a degree in Business Analytics, Finance, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

Additional Job Standards:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience with Excel and data analysis through coursework, projects, or previous internships.

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a professional environment.

  • Experience with SAS, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, Python, or similar analytical tools is preferred.

  • Interest in automation, artificial intelligence, or emerging technologies is preferred.

  • Experience completing academic, research, or team-based projects is preferred.

  • Interest in pursuing a long-term career in analytics, business intelligence, finance, or technology.

Join Labcorp’s 2027 Global Internship Program and take the first step toward a meaningful career in healthcare innovation! We’re looking for motivated students to be part of a dynamic 11-week paid internship where you’ll work on impactful projects and gain real-world experience, all while supporting our mission to improve health and improve lives.

Internship 2027 Dates: June 1, 2027–August 13, 2027

About the Team:

The Financial Analytics organization partners with Finance, Revenue Cycle Management, Operations, and Technology teams to transform data into actionable business insights. Team members develop reporting solutions, dashboards, analytical models, process improvements, automation tools, and business intelligence capabilities that support operational and financial decision-making across the enterprise.

As a member of the Financial Analytics team, the intern will gain hands-on experience using data, analytics, automation, and emerging technologies to address business needs while collaborating with financial analysts, business leaders, and technical teams across the organization.

About the Program:

As a Labcorp intern, you’ll be immersed in hands-on work that complements your academic background. In addition to your project work, you’ll gain valuable exposure to Labcorp’s global business, culture, and leadership through:

  • Enterprise-wide learning experiences that introduce you to key business functions across Labcorp

  • Leadership exposure and visibility, including direct interaction with senior leaders

  • An immersive, in-person intern event designed to connect you with peers and deepen your understanding of our mission

  • Senior leader speaker sessions offering insights into strategy, innovation, and career growth

  • Continuous opportunities to connect and grow, from intern cohort communication channels and LinkedIn Learning resources to professional development sessions and storytelling opportunities that highlight your internship journey

  • Connection to Labcorp’s inclusive culture through engagement with our employee resource groups (ERGs) and values-driven community initiatives

  • Dedicated mentoring connections to guide your growth, provide career advice, and support your internship journey

Internship Details:

  • Duration: 11 weeks, full-time

  • Dates of Internship: June 1, 2027–August 13, 2027

  • Compensation: Paid internship; relocation assistance available for qualified candidates

  • Eligibility: Preferred candidates are rising juniors and seniors (December 2027 through June 2029 graduation) who are currently enrolled in a relevant degree program; however, all current students pursuing related studies are encouraged to apply.

  • This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Apply now to launch your career and create real impact for patients worldwide. #FutureofLabcorp

Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan. Employees who are regularly scheduled to work a 7 on/7 off schedule are eligible to receive all the foregoing benefits except PTO or FTO. For more detailed information, please click here.


Labcorp is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer:

Labcorp strives for inclusion and belonging in the workforce and does not tolerate harassment or discrimination of any kind. We make employment decisions based on the needs of our business and the qualifications and merit of the individual. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), family or parental status, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, personal appearance, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic. Additionally, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.


We encourage all to apply

title: Performance & Engagement Analyst
description:
About Ameren Services (B&CS)

Ameren Services provides administrative support and services to Ameren Corporation and its operating companies, subsidiaries and affiliates. Ameren Services includes a wide range of skill sets and roles, from finance and legal experts to digital and cyber specialists, plus those charged with ensuring environmental compliance and operational safety. Together, we help execute a strategy that enables Ameren to deliver superior long-term value to customers, shareholders and the environment.

Our benefits include:

  • Medical coverage on date of hire

  • 100% employer paid cash balance pension plan

  • 401(k) with company match fully vested on date of hire

  • Minimum of 15 days paid vacation and 12 paid holidays

  • Paid parental leave and family caregiver leave

Visit our Benefits & Perks Page for more information on benefits provided to regular full-time employees. ​

About The Position

The Business Planning and Performance Execution team serves as a strategic partner to leaders across Ameren Utilities, helping translate strategy into execution. The team provides performance insights through scorecards, leads function- and segment-level strategic business planning efforts, coordinates complex cross-functional initiatives, and drives leader and coworker engagements that strengthen collaboration and alignment. Working across functions and segments and partnering with Corporate Strategy, the team enables informed decision-making, enterprise alignment, and successful execution of Ameren's strategic priorities.

As part of this team, the Performance and Engagement Analyst supports Ameren Utilities scorecard reporting, leader and coworker engagements, and strategy execution initiative tracking by compiling information, preparing analyses, coordinating activities, maintaining documentation, and supporting recurring processes.

The role performs defined assignments within established frameworks, identifies issues and trends, and escalates exceptions as appropriate. The position develops increasing independence and professional expertise while contributing to accurate reporting, effective engagements, and successful initiative execution.

Key responsibilities include:

Performance Management and Reporting

  • Compile, validate, and maintain KPI and scorecard data, investigating discrepancies and escalating unresolved data-quality issues.

  • Execute monthly performance reporting processes. Prepare recurring performance reports, standard analyses, and supporting materials accurately and on schedule.

  • Analyze assigned metrics to identify trends, exceptions, and potential performance drivers.

  • Coordinate follow-up with metric owners and maintain documentation of actions, decisions, and reporting changes.

  • Assist with benchmarking and comparative analysis for issues of defined or moderate scope.

  • Identify and suggest practical improvements to assigned reporting tools, templates, and processes.

Leader and Coworker Engagements

  • Support execution of Ameren Utilities leader and coworker engagement activities within established plans and frameworks.

  • Coordinate schedules, logistics, materials, communications, and action tracking for assigned efforts.

  • Compile and summarize feedback, identify recurring themes, and support development of follow-up actions.

  • Build productive working relationships with team members, leaders, and stakeholders.

Strategy Execution Initiatives

  • Support status tracking, documentation, and reporting for assigned strategic initiatives.

  • Gather and organize data, conduct standard analysis, and identify risks, issues, and dependencies for escalation.

  • Maintain assigned schedules, trackers, decision logs, action items, and supporting documentation.

  • Contribute to process improvements and special projects using established methods and guidance.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required. Two or more years of relevant professional experience. Or advanced degree with 1 or more years of relevant professional experience. Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications required. Demonstrated experience preparing reports, analyzing data, coordinating meetings or projects, and managing multiple deadlines.

In addition to the above qualifications, the successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Ability to organize, analyze, and interpret information accurately while completing defined assignments within established processes.

  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify discrepancies, trends, and issues requiring follow-up.

  • Ability to prepare clear reports, summaries, presentation materials, and supporting documentation.

  • Ability to collaborate productively with team members, metric owners, leaders, and other stakeholders.

  • Ability to coordinate activities, maintain accurate trackers and records, and meet multiple established deadlines.

  • Ability to apply established methods, identify practical process improvements, and escalate exceptions appropriately.

  • Ability to work independently on routine assignments while seeking guidance for new, complex, or unfamiliar work.

  • Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, adaptability, learning agility, and commitment to delivering high-quality work products.

Additional Information

This role requires in person participation, including supporting and participating in meetings and strategic engagements in the AHQ St. Louis and Collinsville, IL offices on a frequent basis.


Ameren’s selection process includes a series of interviews and may include candidate testing and/or an individual aptitude or skill-based assessment. Specific details will be provided to qualified candidates.

#LI-Hybrid

Compensation Range:

$71,100.00 - $110,200.00

At Ameren, base salary is one component of a competitive compensation package for employees. Our pay ranges are broad to allow for movement within our organization and to accommodate different skill sets and levels of expertise. We take into consideration a variety of factors including, but not limited to, skills, abilities, experience, education, credentials, and internal equity when determining the base salary offered. Roles are eligible for additional rewards including annual incentive payments based on individual and company performance.

title: Specialist Cloud Engineer – AWS
description:
Career Category

Information Systems

Job Description

ABOUT AMGEN:

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting edge of innovation.

Job Description

Specialist Cloud Engineer – AWS

In this role as a Specialist Cloud Engineer – AWS at Amgen, you will design, develop, and support cloud-native operations and solutions that enable scalable, reliable, and secure cloud platforms. You will work closely with Cloud Engineering, Cloud Operations, Automation, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to build innovative solutions, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the developer and user experience across Amgen's cloud ecosystem.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Cloud Engineering & Operations

  • Design and implement AI/GenAI-powered cloud solutions, leveraging intelligent agents and workflow automation to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.
  • Build, manage, and support cloud platforms and services, ensuring they are secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, CloudFormation, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implement automation, observability, and AIOps capabilities to improve platform reliability, monitoring, and engineering productivity.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues, support incident resolution, and perform root cause analysis to enhance service stability.
  • Work closely with security and engineering teams to implement IAM, encryption, governance, and compliance controls with a security-first mindset.
  • Contribute to cloud modernisation and continuous improvement initiatives by applying operations/engineering best practices, automation, and technical problem-solving.
  • Support AWS FinOps activities, including cost optimisation, resource utilisation reviews, budgeting inputs, forecasting support, and cloud spend visibility.
  • Ensure cloud platforms comply with enterprise standards for security, risk controls, reliability, and operational excellence.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree and 6 to 8 years of experience in cloud operations, with at least 3 years of hands-on technical ownership in AWS cloud engineering OR
  • Bachelor’s degree and 8 to 10 years of experience in cloud operations, with at least 4 years of hands-on technical ownership in AWS cloud engineering OR
  • Diploma and 10 to 12 years of experience in cloud operations, with at least 5 years of hands-on technical ownership in AWS cloud engineering OR
  • Deep expertise in AWS services (EC2, S3, SCPs, RDS, Lambda, Control Tower, Landing Zone, R53, EKS, IAM, VPC, etc.).
  • Expertise in implementing solution for cloud operations work leveraging AI, Agents, Workflows etc..
  • Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation frameworks.
  • Experience in SRE principles including observability, MTTR, SLIs/SLOs, and incident response.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native application deployment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in building and operating large-scale AWS platforms, with expertise in AI and agent-based solutions leveraging Amazon Bedrock, Agent Core, and modern cloud automation frameworks.
  • Strong experience implementing enterprise cloud solutions, with hands-on expertise in cloud security, compliance controls, risk controls, and operational excellence frameworks.
  • Proven expertise in building automation, monitoring, observability, and AIOps solutions within AWS environments to drive platform reliability, reduce operational toil, and accelerate engineering delivery.
  • Strong understanding of AWS FinOps principles and cloud financial optimisation practices, including cost analysis, budgeting inputs, forecasting support, chargeback/show back models, and cloud spend visibility.
  • Strong experience supporting and operating enterprise-scale AWS and GCP environments, with deep technical expertise in AWS cloud services, architecture, security, automation, and operational best practices.

Professional Certifications:

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect (preferred)

Soft Skills:

  • Critical thinking and technical analysis
  • Strong technical judgement and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellence in cross functional collaboration
  • Outstanding communication skills
  • Ability to support incident response and high-priority technical issue resolution
  • Clear technical communication and stakeholder collaboration skills

Shift Information: This is an onsite position requiring flexibility to support a global operating model. The successful candidate must be willing to work outside standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and on-call shifts, as required to support 24x7 cloud operations and critical business priorities.

title: Network Assurance Technician
description:
WOW! is currently hiring a Network Assurance Technician to work on-site, 2nd shift (3pm -11:30 pm, Sunday - Thursday) in our Columbus, OH data center!

The Network Assurance Center (NAC) Technician is responsible for maintaining the stability and performance of the WOW! network. This role operates as a key escalation point within the Network Operations Center to independently investigate and resolve complex network issues detected through enterprise monitoring systems or escalated from internal support teams. This role performs in-depth analysis, executes troubleshooting procedures, and coordinates resolution efforts as needed utilizing advanced network management tools and monitoring platforms.

Let us tell you about the perks!

  • Be part of a company whose core values include respect, integrity, spirit of service, and accountability!

  • Competitive Compensation- depending on experience

  • Annual merit increases – recruiter will share more!

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, and 401k with a company match

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and tuition reimbursement.

  • Significant discounts on broadband packages for employees residing in our service areas.

What You'll be doing:

Include but are not limited to the following:

  • Monitor and assess network health across a complex infrastructure that includes RF, IP, and Optical technologies supporting Video, Voice, and High-Speed Data (HSD) services for residential and commercial customers.

  • Execute advanced troubleshooting procedures to isolate faults and determine the most effective path to service restoration across diverse platforms and technologies.

  • Manage and lead resolution of network-impacting events, ensuring timely communication, accurate documentation, and appropriate escalation per standard operating procedures.

  • Process and resolve NOC trouble tickets in a timely manner, maintaining high-quality ticket documentation and driving incidents through to resolution.

  • Contribute to knowledge management by updating existing process documentation and assisting in the development of new procedures that enhance operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and provide clear handoffs between shifts to maintain continuity of operations.

  • Other duties as assigned

What YOU need is:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Minimum Required Education and Experience

  • Shift: 2nd Shift Either Sun-Thurs or Tues-Sat, from 2pm-10:30pm CST

  • Note: There will be a 2–4-week training period on other shifts to become familiar with the workload and type of work on other shifts.

  • Associate degree in Information Technology, Networking, Telecommunications, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience is preferred. High school diploma is required.

  • 1-3 years of experience in a Network Operations Center or similar technical operations environment.

  • Prior Tier 1 or equivalent experience with demonstrated progression in technical troubleshooting and incident management responsibilities.

  • Certifications (Preferred): CompTIA Network+, Cisco CCNA, ITIL Foundation.

Skills and Abilities to be Successful in this Role

  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of IP, RF, and Optical networks; experience with L2/L3 protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF); familiarity with DOCSIS, CMTS, SNMP, and monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Netcool, Wireshark).

  • Problem-Solving: Proven ability to analyze system alerts, isolate root causes, and resolve complex issues independently during overnight hours.

  • Communication: Clear and professional verbal/written communication; skilled in documenting incidents and coordinating with cross-functional team

Physical Demands/Working Conditions: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Regularly required to talk and hear

  • Required to use hands to type, handle objects and paperwork

  • Required to use close vision and be able to focus

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including overnights, weekends, holidays, and on-call rotations based on operational requirements.

title: Application Tester
description:
As an Application Tester, you play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our enterprise applications. You safeguard the user experience by meticulously testing software packages and deployments, identifying issues before they impact our operations. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and directly contributes to the seamless functioning of our IT infrastructure, empowering our teams to achieve their goals with confidence.

This is an onsite position with work to be performed at the VA facility located in Albany, New York.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Identifies, documents, and tracks software defects, collaborating with development and packaging teams for efficient troubleshooting and defect resolution.
  • Utilizes various packaging tools such as Admin Studio, Flexera, SCCM, App-V, MSIX, and MSI packaging to understand package structure and test integrity.
  • Validates the correct implementation of transforms (MST) for customized application configurations.
  • Develops and executes test cases for applications that incorporate scripting (PowerShell, VBScript).
  • Ensures applications are prepared for enterprise deployment and ongoing patch management processes.
  • Contributes to the creation and maintenance of product technical documentation.
  • Applies strong problem-solving skills to complex technical challenges during the testing lifecycle.
  • Participates actively in an Agile Delivery environment, contributing to sprints and continuous improvement.
  • Tests integrations and applications built with Microsoft Power Apps, SharePoint, and ServiceNow.

  • Applies expert knowledge of QA Testing methodologies and best practices.
  • Possesses strong abilities in troubleshooting and defect resolution.
  • Understands and utilizes packaging tools including Admin Studio, Flexera, SCCM, App-V, MSIX, and MSI packaging.
  • Works with transforms (MST) for application customization.
  • Applies knowledge of scripting (PowerShell, VBScript) for testing and automation.
  • Familiarity with concepts of enterprise deployment and patch management.
  • Exhibits excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Contributes to product technical documentation.
  • Operates effectively within an Agile Delivery framework.
  • Must have application and testing experience for windows client operating systems
  • Able to obtain a public trust clearance.

Education & Experience:

  • Minimum years of experience is 2 years
  • Demonstrates experience in application testing, quality assurance, or a related IT role.
  • Works effectively with various software and system environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Power Apps, SharePoint, or ServiceNow is a plus.
  • Holds a Microsoft or packaging-related certification.
